name: Abolition of the Discretionary Quotas in Housing Schemes Act, 2013

metadata.title: The Abolition of the Discretionary Quotas in Housing Schemes Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes all discretionary quotas in housing schemes within the public sector to ensure fair, equitable, and transparent allotments. It applies specifically to the Islamabad Capital Territory and overrides any inconsistent laws or regulations.

name: Abolition of the Punishment of Whipping Act, 1996

metadata.title: The Abolition of the Punishment of Whipping Act, 1996
metadata.repeals: The Whipping Act, 1909
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the punishment of whipping under any law in force, except where it is awarded as hadd according to the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It also remits any unexecuted sentences of whipping existing at the time of its commencement.

metadata.title: The Acceding State (Property) Order, 1961
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Federal Government's authority to decide disputes regarding the devolution and distribution of property belonging to acceding states or their rulers. It outlines procedures for recovering money or attaching other properties, designating specific officials like Deputy Commissioners and District Magistrates to execute these orders.

metadata.title: The Abandoned Properties (Management) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management of certain abandoned properties belonging to specified persons who ceased to be citizens of Pakistan after December 16, 1971. It establishes a Board of Trustees and appoints an Administrator to take possession of, manage, and recover damages related to these properties.

name: Access to the Media (Deaf) Persons Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Access to the Media (Deaf) Persons Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act ensures that deaf persons have access to information in all matters of public importance through Pakistan sign language on broadcast media. It establishes a National Policy Board and mandates the appointment of Pakistan sign language interpreters by the Government and private media houses within specified timeframes.

name: Acting as Agents of Moallims (Prohibition) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Acting as Agents of Moallims (Prohibition) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits persons from acting as agents, attorneys, or representatives of Moallims during the Haj season. It also forbids soliciting appointments for specific Moallims and establishing offices to secure personal advantage in this context.

metadata.title: The Administrator General's Act, 1913
metadata.amends: Law relating to the office and duties of Administrator General
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the office, duties, powers, and liabilities of the Administrator General in Pakistan. It establishes the appointment process, defines the scope of administration for various estates, outlines fee structures, and provides for the audit of accounts.

name: Admiralty Jurisdiction of High Courts Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Admiralty Jurisdiction of High Courts Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to Courts of Admiralty in Pakistan. It defines specific terms such as 'ship', 'goods', and 'territorial waters' and grants jurisdiction to High Courts over various maritime causes, including claims for damage, salvage, towage, and crew wages.

name: Agha Khan University Examination Board Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Agha Khan University Examination Board Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Agha Khan University Examination Board to conduct examinations at various academic levels up to higher secondary. It grants the Board autonomy to develop and administer tests in multiple languages while following national curricula, aiming to improve educational options for people in Pakistan.

name: Agricultural Census Act, 1958 (Repealed by Act XiV of 2011 s.3(w.e.f 31-05-2011))

metadata.title: The Agricultural Census Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taking of an agricultural census in Pakistan to comply with decisions by the Food and Agricultural Organization of the United Nations. It establishes the appointment of census officers, defines the scope of information to be collected regarding land, crops, livestock, and other matters, and outlines procedures for access to premises and penalties for non-compliance.

name: Agricultural Development Bank of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Agricultural Development Bank of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reorganization and conversion of the Agricultural Development Bank of Pakistan into a public limited company incorporated under the Companies Ordinance, 1984. It facilitates the transfer and vesting of all assets, liabilities, contracts, and proceedings from the existing bank to the newly formed company while ensuring the continuation of its business operations.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the import, manufacture, formulation, sale, distribution, and use of pesticides in Pakistan. It establishes a framework for pesticide registration, labeling requirements, and the powers of inspectors to ensure compliance with safety standards.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the grading and marking of agricultural produce to ensure quality standards. It establishes rules for grade designations, authorizes specific bodies to mark articles, and prescribes penalties for unauthorized or incorrect marking as well as counterfeiting.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Cess Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of a cess on specific agricultural products exported from Pakistan. It establishes the rate of duty, defines the scope of articles subject to the tax, and grants powers to the Federal Government to vary rates or exclude certain articles via notification.

metadata.title: The Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act amends and extends the Northern India Takkavi Act, 1879 to various provinces. It provides for the extension of loan facilities to owners and occupiers of arable land for purposes such as relief from distress or purchasing seed and cattle.

metadata.title: The Air University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Air University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its governing bodies, constituent units managed by the Pakistan Air Force, and various administrative authorities.

name: AirCraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Aircraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the removal of danger to aircraft safety caused by bird-attracting sites near airfields. It empowers the Federal Government to issue orders requiring owners of specific facilities, such as tanneries or slaughter-houses, to take measures to avoid attracting birds within a specified radius of runways.

metadata.title: The Airports Security Force Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and regulation of the Airports Security Force. Its primary purpose is to ensure the security of all aerodromes, airports, aircraft, and civil aviation installations while maintaining law and order within these limits.

metadata.title: The Akhuwat Institute Kasur Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Akhuwat Institute Kasur as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's structure, including its Chancellor, Patron, Board of Directors, and various authorities responsible for governance and academic functions.

metadata.title: The Al-Karam International Institute Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Al-Karam International Institute as a body corporate in the private sector with its main campus at Bhera. It grants the institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy to promote special studies and manage its own property and personnel.

metadata.title: The Allama Iqbal Open University Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of an Allama Iqbal Open University at Islamabad as a specialized educational institution. It outlines the university's powers, functions, officers, authorities, and the framework for its statutes, regulations, and rules.

metadata.title: The Allied Health Professionals Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Allied Health Professionals Council in Pakistan to set uniform standards for basic and higher qualifications in various Allied Health disciplines. It consolidates laws regarding the registration of professionals, regulates education and practice, and provides for the maintenance of registers and licensing rights.

metadata.title: The Allopathic System (Prevention of Misuse) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prevents the misuse of the allopathic system of medicine by prohibiting unqualified persons from using the title 'doctor' or displaying unauthorized medical degrees. It restricts surgical operations, the prescription of certain drugs, and the sale of patent medicines without proper labeling.

metadata.title: The Alternative Dispute Resolution Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a framework for alternative dispute resolution (ADR) to ensure inexpensive and expeditious justice in civil matters. It mandates courts to refer eligible cases to ADR processes, such as mediation or arbitration, before formal litigation proceeds, unless specific exceptions apply. The legislation also defines key terms like 'Neutral' and 'ADR Centre', outlines the composition of neutral panels, and provides for the appointment of neutrals by courts.

name: Alternative Energy Development Board Act, 2010 (Repealed by Act No.XXVI of 2023)

metadata.title: Alternative Energy Development Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Alternative Energy Development Board (AEDB) as an autonomous body to implement policies and projects in alternative or renewable energy technologies. The Board aims to facilitate the development of such energy sources to achieve sustainable economic growth through technology transfer.

metadata.title: The Anand Marriage Act, 1909
metadata.summary: This Act removes doubts regarding the legal validity of the Anand marriage ceremony commonly practiced among Sikhs. It declares such marriages solemnized according to Sikh customs as good and valid in law, while excluding non-Sikh couples and those within prohibited degrees of relationship.

metadata.title: The Anti Narcotics Force Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of the Anti Narcotics Force to inquire into and investigate offences relating to narcotics and narcotic trafficking. It outlines the force's functions, including prosecution, asset tracing, and coordination with other enforcement agencies.

metadata.title: The Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of terrorism and sectarian violence in Pakistan. It establishes Anti-terrorism Courts to ensure the speedy trial of heinous offences related to these crimes.

metadata.title: The Anti Dumping Duties Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Anti Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act reforms and repeals the Anti Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000 to provide a framework for investigating dumping and injury regarding goods imported into Pakistan. It establishes procedures for levying anti-dumping duties, conducting investigations, and appealing decisions to an Appellate Tribunal.

name: Anti-Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000 (Repealed by Act XIV of 2015)

metadata.title: The Anti-Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the imposition of anti-dumping duties in Pakistan to offset injurious dumping. It provides a legal framework for investigating and determining dumping and injury regarding goods imported into the country, including provisions for provisional measures, price undertakings, and appeals.

metadata.title: Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of money laundering and combating the financing of terrorism. It also establishes mechanisms for the forfeiture of property derived from or involved in these activities, along with related matters.

metadata.title: The Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes special courts and anti-rape crisis cells to ensure the expeditious redressal of rape and sexual abuse crimes against women and children. It provides for efficacious procedures, speedy trials, evidence guidelines, and victim protection measures throughout Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Antiquities Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The law relating to the preservation and protection of antiquities
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the law concerning the preservation and protection of antiquities in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'antiquity', 'immovable antiquity', and 'dealer', and establishes powers for the Director General of Archaeology regarding custody, acquisition, and regulation of these items.

metadata.title: The Apostille Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the Hague Convention on abolishing the requirement of legalization for foreign public documents within Pakistan. It establishes competent authorities to issue apostille certificates and sets out provisions regarding fees, indemnity, and the power to make rules.

name: Apprenticeship Ordinance, 1962 (Repeal by Act I of 2019,s.18)

metadata.title: The Apprenticeship Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the promotion, development, and regulation of systematic apprenticeship programmes in industries. It also aims to secure minimum standards of skill by defining roles for employers, apprentices, and competent authorities.

metadata.title: The Arbitration (International Investment Disputes) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act implements the International Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of other States within Pakistan. It establishes procedures for registering arbitration awards in High Courts, grants them force equivalent to court judgments, and defines the Government's obligations and exemptions under the Convention.

metadata.title: The Arbitration Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to arbitration in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for arbitration agreements, the appointment of arbitrators, court powers regarding awards, and procedures for setting aside or enforcing arbitral decisions.

name: Archival Material (Preservation and Export Control) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Archival Material (Preservation and Export Control) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and control of the export of archival material of national significance in Pakistan. It defines archival material, establishes an Advisory Committee, regulates the purchase and donation of such materials, and restricts exports to those authorized by a Director's license.

metadata.title: The Area Study Centres Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Area Study Centres within universities in Pakistan. It outlines the functions, governance structure, and funding mechanisms for these centres to facilitate research on contemporary societies affecting national interests.

metadata.title: The Armed Forces (Emergency Duties) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act enables the imposition of duties on the Armed Forces in connection with vital services during an emergency. It empowers the Federal Government to declare specific services as vital and mandates obedience to commands related to those services.

name: Armed Forces Civil General Transport Companies and Requisition of Civil Transport Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Armed Forces Civil General Transport Companies and Requisition of Civil Transport Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the raising of civil general transport companies and the requisition of civil transport for the Armed Forces. It allows these actions to be taken at short notice, even prior to a formal declaration of emergency, to meet logistical requirements.

metadata.title: The Arms Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to arms, ammunition, and military stores in Pakistan. It establishes provisions regarding the manufacture, import, export, transport, and possession of these items, including requirements for licenses and penalties for breaches.

metadata.title: The Arya Marriage Validation Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act recognizes and removes doubts regarding the validity of intermarriages among Arya Samajists. It declares that such marriages are not invalid based on caste differences or previous religious affiliations, overriding contrary provisions of Hindu Law.

metadata.title: The Asaan Karobar Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to modernize and simplify the regulatory regime for business, trade, and investment in Pakistan. It creates the Asaan Karobar Technical Unit and the Pakistan Regulatory Registry to review and eliminate cumbersome regulatory requirements.

metadata.title: The Asian Development Bank Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance implements the international agreement for the establishment and operation of the Asian Development Bank. It grants the Bank legal status, immunities, and exemptions within Pakistan while defining financial obligations and the role of the State Bank as depository.

metadata.title: The Assets Declaration Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the voluntary declaration of undisclosed assets, sales, and expenditure held in Pakistan or abroad. It establishes the mechanism for taxing these declared items and includes provisions to encourage a compliant economy for economic revival.

metadata.title: The Associated Cement (Vesting) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the vesting of the Associated Cement undertakings in the State Cement Corporation of Pakistan Limited. It transfers all associated rights, properties, assets, liabilities, and obligations from the Federal Government to the newly formed Corporation.

name: Associated Press of Pakistan (Taking over) Ordinance, 1961(Repeal by ordinance 20 of 2002,s.23))

metadata.title: The Associated Press of Pakistan (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Central Government to take over the Associated Press of Pakistan Limited due to its administrative and financial breakdown. It provides for the immediate dissolution of the company, the transfer of all assets and liabilities to the government, and the appointment of officials to manage the undertaking.

name: Associated Press of Pakistan Corporation Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Associated Press of Pakistan Corporation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reconstitution of the Associated Press of Pakistan as a public information medium. It aims to streamline operations, improve professionalism, and grant greater autonomy to enable international cooperation and build trust.

name: Auditor General´s (Functions, Powers, Terms and Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Auditor General's (Functions, Powers and Terms and Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance determines the terms and conditions of service, term of office, powers, and functions of the Auditor General of Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President under emergency provisions due to the suspension of the National Assembly and Senate.

metadata.title: The Auqaf (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: The Auqaf (Federal Control) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Auqaf (Federal Control) Act, 1976. It transfers the administration and management of waqf properties from the federal Administrator-General to the respective Provincial Governments or authorities.

metadata.title: The Bahria University Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Bahria University at Islamabad as a fully autonomous body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Pro-Chancellor, Rector, and various governing bodies like the Board of Governors. The document outlines the university's purposes, which include the promotion of knowledge, technology, instruction, training, research, and service.

metadata.title: The Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 1891
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law of evidence specifically regarding bankers' books. It establishes that certified copies of entries in a banker's book are admissible as prima facie evidence in all legal proceedings.

metadata.title: The Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the business, capital, and operations of banking companies in Pakistan. It establishes the powers of the State Bank for supervision, licensing, and resolution of failing banks, while also defining provisions for Islamic banking and winding-up procedures.

metadata.title: The Banking Tribunals (Validation of Orders) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain orders, judgments, decisions, proceedings, and recoveries made by the Banking Tribunal under the Banking Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 1992. It applies to actions taken before the commencement of this Act that were purportedly exercised under the authority of the said 1992 Act.

metadata.title: The Banks (Nationalization) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the nationalization of banking business in Pakistan by transferring ownership and control of all banks to the Federal Government. It defines specific types of banks included or excluded from nationalization and outlines provisions for compensation, management, and the adaptation of existing laws.

name: Banks (Transfer of Assets and Liabilities) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Banks (Transfer of Assets and Liabilities) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transfer of certain assets and liabilities from the Eastern Mercantile Bank Limited and the Eastern Banking Corporation Limited to the National Bank of Pakistan. It establishes the legal framework for this transfer, including the vesting of undertakings, the continuation of pending contracts and proceedings, and the evaluation of transferred entities.

metadata.title: The Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits holding property in Benami (nominee) names and restricts the right to recover or transfer such property. It establishes a mechanism for the adjudication and confiscation of Benami properties, along with defining the powers of authorities and penalties for offenses.

metadata.title: The Benazir Income Support Programme Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Benazir Income Support Programme as a body corporate to provide financial assistance and social protection to economically distressed persons and families. It outlines the programme's objectives, including enhancing the financial capacity of the poor, implementing targeted policies for underprivileged groups, and reducing poverty through equitable wealth distribution.

metadata.title: The Bills of Lading Act, 1856
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to bills of lading by ensuring that rights and liabilities under a bill of lading vest in the consignee or endorsee when property passes. It clarifies that such documents serve as conclusive evidence of shipment against the master, even if goods were not actually laden, provided there is no fraud or default by the signer.

name: Biological and Toxin Weapons Convention (Implementation) Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Biological and Toxin Weapons Convention (Implementation) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production and Stockpiling of Bacteriological (Biological) and Toxin Weapons and on their Destruction, 1972. It establishes prohibitions on biological weapons, regulates their import and export, and creates mechanisms for oversight and enforcement within Pakistan.

name: Births, Deaths and Marriages Registration Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Births, Deaths and Marriages Registration Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the voluntary registration of certain births and deaths among specific classes of persons. It also establishes General Registry Offices to maintain registers of births, deaths, and marriages, including those registered under previous Acts like the Christian Marriage Act, 1872.

metadata.title: The Board of Investment Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Board of Investment (BOI) as an apex agency to promote, encourage, and facilitate both local and foreign investment in Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Board, including ex-officio and non-official members, and outlines its functions, powers, and administrative structure.

name: Boilers Act, 1923(Repeal by Ord. 52 of 2001, s,610)

metadata.title: The Boilers Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to steam-boilers. It establishes provisions for registration, inspection, penalties for illegal use, and the constitution of a Boilers Board.

metadata.title: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: law relating to boilers and pressure vessels
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to boilers and pressure vessels in Pakistan. It provides for the regulation, use, construction, installation, and repair of these items while prescribing uniform rules and regulations.

metadata.title: The Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the bonded labour system in Pakistan to prevent economic and physical exploitation of the labour class. It declares all agreements, customs, and contracts related to bonded labour void and extinguishes the liability to repay any bonded debt.

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act regulates irrigation, navigation, and drainage within the territories to which it extends, specifically the Punjab. It grants the Provincial Government control over water for public purposes and establishes rules regarding compensation, water rates, and penalties related to canal usage.

name: Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority to oversee the cultivation, extraction, refining, manufacturing, and sale of cannabis plant derivatives. It regulates these activities for medicinal, industrial, and other public uses while defining key terms such as 'cannabis', 'derivative', and 'cultivation'.

metadata.title: The Cantonments (House-Accommodation) Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act further amends and consolidates the law relating to the provision of house-accommodation for military officers in cantonments. It defines key terms such as 'Brigade area', 'Cantonment Board', and 'military officer', and establishes procedures for the appropriation of houses, including liability, conditions, and lease procedures.

metadata.title: The Cantonments (Requisitioning of Immoveable Property) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Federal Government to requisition immovable property within Cantonment limits for purposes other than those of the Cantonment Boards during an emergency. It outlines the procedures for releasing property, determining compensation amounts, and imposing penalties for non-compliance or providing false information.

metadata.title: The Cantonments Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act defines and delimits cantonment areas and establishes the administrative framework for their management. It creates Cantonment Boards, outlines election procedures, and grants powers to the Federal Government regarding oversight and control. Additionally, it provides comprehensive provisions for taxation, property management, and the regulation of spirituous liquors within these areas.

name: Cantonments Local Government (Elections) Ordinance, 2002 (LXXIX of 2002) (Repealed by Act No. XLVII of 2023)

metadata.title: The Cantonments Local Government (Elections) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conduct of local government elections in cantonments to ensure grassroots participation. It establishes linkages and fiscal arrangements between Cantonment Local Governments and the District Government within the spirit of the Cantonment Act, 1924.

name: Cantonments Ordinance, 2002 (CXXXVII)(Repealed by Act No. XLVII of 2023)

metadata.title: The Cantonments Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the framework for cantonment administration, local government structures, and citizen community boards within Pakistan. It outlines powers regarding public safety, sanitation, property management, and the conduct of local government elections.

metadata.title: The Cantonments Pure Food Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions to prevent the adulteration of food within cantonments in Pakistan and covers related matters. It defines various food terms, establishes authorities and inspectors for enforcement, sets penalties for offenses, and outlines procedures for food analysis and seizure.

metadata.title: The Cantonments Rent Restriction Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of rents for certain classes of buildings located within cantonment areas in Pakistan. It also establishes provisions regarding the eviction of tenants from these properties and matters connected therewith.

name: Capital Development Authority (Abatement of Arbitration Proceedings) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Capital Development Authority (Abatement of Arbitration Proceedings) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the annulment of certain references to arbitration and the abatement of specific arbitration proceedings involving the Capital Development Authority. It declares that arbitration clauses in agreements entered into before its commencement are abrogated and any pending proceedings or awards under such agreements shall be of no effect.

metadata.title: The Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Capital Development Authority to manage arrangements for the planning and development of Islamabad. It outlines the authority's constitution, powers regarding land acquisition and scheme execution, financial provisions, and penalties for non-compliance.

name: Capital of the Republic (Determination of Area) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The Capital of the Republic (Determination of Area) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance determines the specific area of Islamabad as the Capital of the Republic. It defines the boundaries by specifying a total area of approximately three hundred and fifty square miles within the district of Rawalpindi.

name: Capital Territory Local Government Ordinance, 1979(Repealed by Act,X at 2015)

metadata.title: The Capital Territory Local Government Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: Order and the Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961 (XLIV of 1961)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of Local Government institutions in the Capital Territory. It defines various terms related to local governance, elections, and administrative roles within the rural areas of the territory.

name: Capital University of Science and Technology Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Capital University of Science and Technology Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Capital University of Science and Technology at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various authorities like the Academic Council. The legislation also outlines the powers, purposes, and operational framework for the university and its constituent units.

metadata.title: The Carriage by Air Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Montreal Convention and other international conventions concerning carriage by air. It consolidates existing laws and applicable international conventions related to international carriage by air within the country.

name: Carriage of Goods by Sea Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Carriage of Goods by Sea Act, 1925
metadata.amends: Carriage of Goods by Sea Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the carriage of goods by sea in Pakistan, incorporating rules from an international convention. It establishes responsibilities and liabilities for carriers under bills of lading while modifying specific articles related to sailing ships and bulk cargoes.

metadata.title: The Carriers Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act defines the rights and liabilities of common carriers regarding the transport of property. It establishes limits on carrier liability for goods exceeding a specific value unless declared otherwise and outlines conditions for recovering money paid for carriage in cases of loss or damage.

metadata.title: The Caste Disabilities Removal Act, 1850
metadata.summary: This Act extends the principle of Section 9 of Regulation VII, 1832 to all territories under the Government of the East India Company. It declares that any law or usage inflicting forfeiture of rights or property due to a change in religion or loss of caste shall cease to be enforced in the Courts of the East India Company and those established by Royal Charter.

metadata.title: The Cattle-trespass Act, 1871
metadata.repeals: Repealed by the Repealing Act, 1938 (I of 1938)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to trespasses by cattle in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for pounds, pound-keepers, procedures for seizing and feeding impounded cattle, and mechanisms for compensation or penalties related to illegal seizures or damages caused by animals.

metadata.title: The Central Depositories Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and regulates the operation of book-entry systems for the transfer of securities by central depository companies in Pakistan. It defines key terms related to accounts, issuers, and central depositories while outlining their powers, duties, and liabilities.

name: Central Excise Duty on Sugar (Validation) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Central Excise Duty on Sugar (Validation) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy and collection of central excise duty on enhanced rates for stocks of sugar held by mills on June 7, 1975. It declares such duties validly levied and collected, making unpaid amounts recoverable under existing provisions.

metadata.title: The Central Law Officers Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Central Law Officers, including Additional, Deputy, and Assistant Attorneys General. It confers upon them the right of audience in all courts in Pakistan and deems them to be public prosecutors competent to institute proceedings on behalf of the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Centres of Excellence Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Centres of Excellence in universities to conduct high-level teaching and research. It outlines the functions of these centres, the composition of their Boards of Governors, and the appointment and duties of Directors.

name: Chairman and Members of Federal Land Commission (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Chairman and Members of Federal Land Commission (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain orders passed by the Chairman or a Member of the Federal Land Commission prior to its commencement. It deems these orders validly passed and effective, notwithstanding any contrary court decisions, based on specific regulations regarding property distribution in Dir, Swat, and Chitral.

name: Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Chairman of the Senate and the Speaker of the National Assembly. It details specific financial benefits including salary rates, equipment allowances, transport provisions, official residence rights, and medical facilities.

metadata.title: The Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act provides for more effectual control over the administration of charitable and religious trusts. It enables interested persons to apply to a Court for directions regarding trust particulars, audits, and expenditure in suits against trustees.

metadata.title: The Charitable Endowments Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the vesting and administration of property held in trust for charitable purposes. It establishes the office of Treasurer of Charitable Endowments and outlines the procedures for applying for orders to vest such properties in the Treasurer.

metadata.title: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collection) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation, administration, and accounting of collections of charitable donations. It also aims to prevent frauds associated with such collections.

metadata.title: The Chartered Accountants Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of the profession of accountants in Pakistan. It establishes the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan and defines its structure, including the Council, regional committees, and registers of members.

metadata.title: The Chemical Fertilizers (Development Surcharge) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of a development surcharge on chemical fertilizers produced or held in stock by companies and stockists. It establishes definitions for terms like 'differential margin' and 'maximum sale price', outlines procedures for exemptions and refunds, and mandates that the surcharge be treated as an expenditure allowable for income-tax purposes.

metadata.title: The Chemical Weapons Convention Implementation Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect in Pakistan to the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production, Stockpiling and use of Chemical Weapons signed at Paris on January 13, 1993. It was promulgated by the President under emergency provisions because the National Assembly and Senate were suspended.

name: Chief Election Commissioner (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Chief Election Commissioner (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Chief Election Commissioner (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Chief Election Commissioner of Pakistan. It stipulates that the Commissioner shall receive the same benefits as a Judge of the Supreme Court, with specific provisions for those previously serving as Chief Justice of Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to restrain the solemnisation of child marriages in Pakistan. It defines a 'child' and 'child marriage', prescribes punishments for adults marrying children, parents/guardians facilitating such marriages, and those who solemnise them, and grants courts the power to issue injunctions against arranged child marriages.

metadata.title: The Children (Pledging of Labour) Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the making of agreements to pledge the labour of children and forbids the employment of such children. It defines key terms like 'child' and 'guardian' and establishes penalties for parents, guardians, or others who make or enforce these illegal agreements.

name: China Pakistan Economic Corridor Authority Act, 2021

metadata.title: China Pakistan Economic Corridor Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the China Pakistan Economic Corridor Authority as a body corporate to plan, facilitate, and monitor activities related to the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor. It defines the Authority's composition, management structure, financial provisions, and powers while outlining its reporting line to the Prime Minister.

metadata.title: The Christian Marriage Act, 1872
metadata.repeals: The Christian Marriage Act, 1869
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the solemnization, registration, and licensing of marriages for Christians in British India. It establishes procedures for obtaining certificates, publishing notices, and registering marriages performed by clergy or Marriage Registrars, while also defining penalties for false declarations and unauthorized solemnization.

name: Church of Scotland Kirk Sessions Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Church of Scotland Kirk Sessions Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the incorporation of Kirk Sessions of the Church of Scotland within Pakistan as bodies corporate with perpetual succession. It grants these sessions the power to hold and dispose of property and establishes that a notification by the Federal Government serves as conclusive proof of their constitution.

metadata.title: The Cigarettes (Printing of Warning) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance mandates the printing of legible health warnings in both English and Urdu on cigarette packets and advertisements. It prohibits the manufacture, sale, or possession of cigarettes without these required warnings and establishes penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Civil Commotion Compensation Fund (Repeal) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Civil Commotion Compensation Fund Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Civil Commotion Compensation Fund Ordinance, 1971. It mandates that insurers pay outstanding surcharges and amounts into the established fund and directs all remaining funds to the Federal Consolidated Fund.

metadata.title: The Civil Aviation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control of aircraft manufacture, possession, use, operation, sale, import, and export in Pakistan. It also establishes regulations for air transport services and the development of aerodromes.

metadata.title: The Civil Defence Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: Ordinance, (VIII of 1951)
metadata.summary: This Act provides the legal framework to secure civil defence for Pakistan against hostile attacks and calamities. It grants the Federal Government powers to make rules regarding the constitution, discipline, and duties of Civil Defence Services, as well as measures for fire prevention, evacuation, and property requisition.

metadata.title: The Civil Pioneer Force Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes a Civil Pioneer Force for service in Pakistan to secure defense and public safety. It provides for the organization, control, and discipline of the force, including the constitution of units, duties of personnel, and procedures for trial of offenses.

metadata.title: The Civil Servants (Validation of Rules) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain rules made under the Civil Servants Act, 1973 that were issued before its commencement. It also deems all orders, proceedings, acts, and appointments taken under those validated rules to have been validly made from the beginning.

metadata.title: The Civil Servants Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment of persons to and the terms and conditions of service for individuals in the service of Pakistan. It establishes definitions, tenure rules, and provisions regarding appointments, promotions, transfers, pay, leave, and pension.

name: Civil Services (Qualification for appointment as High Court Judge) Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Civil Services (Qualification for Appointment as High Court Judge) Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes that the Civil Service of Pakistan constitutes a civil service for specific purposes under Article 92 (originally Article 193) of the Constitution. It aims to achieve uniformity in national interest regarding the qualification requirements for appointment as a High Court Judge.

metadata.title: The Claims for Maintenance (Recovery Abroad) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the United Nations Convention on the Recovery Abroad of Maintenance in Pakistan. It designates agencies for transmitting and receiving requests, establishes that the Convention provisions have the force of law, and empowers the Federal Government to make rules and amend the schedule.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the formation of co-operative societies to promote thrift and self-help among agriculturists, artisans, and persons of limited means. It establishes provisions for the registration of societies, defines the rights and liabilities of members, regulates property and funds, and outlines procedures for dissolution and winding up.

name: Coal Mines (Fixation of Rates of Wages) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Coal Mines (Fixation of Rates of Wages) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the fixation of minimum rates of wages for labour employed in coal mines and related matters. It empowers the Provincial Government to set these rates via notification and ensures that workers receive at least the specified wage, without affecting existing higher agreements.

name: Coasting-Vessels Act,(XIX of 1838)(Repeal by 52 of 2001 s.610 & sch (pp-1-5)))

metadata.title: The National Tariff Commission Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Tariff Commission to advise the Federal Government on tariff measures, protection for indigenous industries, and export promotion. It defines the commission's composition, functions, funding sources, and administrative procedures for conducting inquiries and making recommendations.

metadata.title: The Coconut Committee Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of a cess on copra consumed in mills within Pakistan. It establishes the authority of the Federal Government to fix excise duty rates, mandates monthly returns from mill owners, and outlines procedures for assessment and recovery of unpaid duties.

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This document outlines the comprehensive code governing civil procedure in Pakistan, establishing rules for the jurisdiction of courts, the institution of suits, and the execution of decrees. It also details provisions regarding incidental proceedings, appeals from original and appellate decrees, and special cases involving the government or foreign entities.

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Code of Criminal Procedure enacted in 1898, establishing the framework for criminal courts and offices in British India. It details the powers of various judicial officers, procedures for arrest and summons, and the classification of offences.

metadata.title: The Commercial Documents Evidence Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Law of Evidence specifically regarding certain commercial documents. It establishes that statements of facts in scheduled documents are themselves relevant facts and allows courts to presume the genuineness and accuracy of specific shipping, aviation, and trade-related documents.

metadata.title: The Companies (Appointment of Legal Advisers) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Legal Advisers to companies in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'company' and 'Legal Adviser', sets limits on the number of companies an advocate or firm can advise, and establishes penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Companies (Appointment of Trustees) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management of the affairs of certain companies by appointing a trustee when it is in the public interest. It vests the company's assets and liabilities in the appointed trustee and prohibits unauthorized transfers or charges on those assets.

metadata.title: The Companies Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act governs the incorporation, management, and regulation of companies in Pakistan. It covers preliminary provisions, court jurisdiction, powers of the Securities and Exchange Commission, company formation, share capital issues, and prospectus requirements.

name: Companies Ordinance, 1984 (Repealed by Act XIX of 2017)

metadata.title: The Companies Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This document outlines the preliminary provisions, jurisdiction of courts, and authority powers regarding corporate law in Pakistan. It details the procedures for company incorporation, including the formation of memorandums and articles of association, as well as regulations on share capital, prospectus issuance, and deposit collection.

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the participation of workers in the profits of companies and establishes matters ancillary thereto. It mandates the creation of a Workers Participation Fund by eligible companies, outlines the constitution and management of a Board of Trustees to administer this fund, and sets penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Competition Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Competition Commission of Pakistan to maintain and enhance competition in all spheres of commercial and economic activity. It provides legal provisions to ensure free competition, enhance economic efficiency, and protect consumers from anti-competitive behavior.

name: Compulsory Service in the Armed Forces Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Compulsory Service in the Armed Forces Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the compulsory service in the Armed Forces of essential persons and ex-servicemen. It defines liability to be called up, procedures for call-up notices, and exemptions for sole surviving children of those killed in action.

name: Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act mandates the compulsory teaching of the Holy Quran for Muslim students in educational institutions within the Islamabad Capital Territory and those owned by the Federal Government. It specifies that recitation (Naazrah Quran) is required for grades I to V, while translation is required for grades VI to XII.

name: COMSATS Institute of Information Technology Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The COMSATS Institute of Information Technology Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the COMSATS Institute of Information Technology as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the powers and functions of the Institute, including providing instruction in computer technology, admitting students, conferring degrees, and managing property.

metadata.title: The COMSATS University Islamabad Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act upgrades the COMSATS Institute of Information Technology in Islamabad to the status of COMSATS University Islamabad. It establishes the university's structure, including its principal seat at Islamabad and the authority to establish additional campuses within or outside Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Conciliation Courts to enable people in Pakistan to settle certain disputes through conciliation. It defines the jurisdiction of these courts, their composition, and the specific cases referable to them under Parts I and II of the Schedule. The document also outlines procedures for enforcement, witness summoning, and contempt of court.

name: Constitution of the Islamic  Republic of Pakistan

metadata.title: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document outlines the fundamental structure and governance of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. It establishes the rights of citizens, defines the roles of the President, Parliament, and Federal Government, and sets out the principles of policy for the state.

metadata.title: The Contempt of Court Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the exercise of powers by courts to punish for contempt in Pakistan. It defines various types of contempt, including civil, criminal, and judicial, and establishes the jurisdiction of superior courts to handle such cases.

metadata.title: The Contract Act, 1872
metadata.summary: This Act defines the formation, performance, and discharge of contracts under Indian law. It establishes rules regarding competent parties, free consent, voidable agreements, and specific types of contracts such as contingent ones.

metadata.title: The Control of Employment Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the collection of information regarding employment in industrial undertakings and the availability of persons for such work. It establishes mechanisms for the control and distribution of employment, including the creation of a Manpower Council and a Manpower Board to manage these functions during an emergency.

metadata.title: The Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends laws relating to narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, and controlled substances in Pakistan. It regulates the production, processing, trafficking, and forfeiture of assets derived from illicit traffic, while also providing for the treatment and rehabilitation of addicts.

name: Controller General of Accounts (Appointment Functions and Powers) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Controller-General of Accounts (Appointment, Functions and Powers) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the separation of accounting functions and the appointment of a Controller General of Accounts in Pakistan. It transfers accounting duties from the Auditor General to the newly appointed Controller General, who is responsible for maintaining accounts, authorizing payments, and establishing internal financial control principles.

metadata.title: The Co-operative Farming Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the formation, working, and promotion of co-operative farming and allied agro-based industries based on self-help and mutual aid. It establishes a framework for registering societies, managing committees, distributing profits, and setting up district, provincial, and national co-operative councils.

metadata.title: The Cooperative Societies (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the repayment of unsecured or insufficiently secured loans taken from Cooperative Banks and other Cooperative Societies. It mandates specific timelines for partial repayment and securing the remaining balance through mortgage, pledge, or assignment.

metadata.title: The Copyright Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for copyright protection in Pakistan, defining ownership, terms of protection, and rights for authors, performers, and producers. It outlines civil remedies for infringement, penalties for unauthorized use, and provisions regarding international copyright relations.

metadata.title: The Corporate and Industrial Restructuring Corporation Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Corporate and Industrial Restructuring Corporation to manage non-performing assets of banks and financial institutions. It provides for the acquisition, restructuring, rehabilitation, management, disposition, and realization of these distressed assets to assist the business sector.

metadata.title: The Corporate Rehabilitation Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the rehabilitation and re-organisation of distressed corporate entities to encourage economic growth. It establishes the legal framework for appointing administrators, confirming plans of rehabilitation, and granting powers to High Courts regarding insolvency cases.

metadata.title: The Corporate Restructuring Companies Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and regulates corporate restructuring companies in Pakistan. It provides for the licensing of these companies to acquire, manage, restructure, and resolve non-performing assets of financial institutions, as well as to reorganize distressed commercial entities.

metadata.title: The Corporation Employees (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance invests the President with special powers regarding persons in Corporation service. It allows for the removal or reversion of specific employees appointed between January 1, 1972, and July 5, 1977, without notice in the public interest.

metadata.title: The Cost and Management Accountants Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the profession of cost and management accountants in Pakistan. It establishes the Institute of Cost and Management Accountants of Pakistan, defines its structure including the Council and Register, and outlines penalties for unauthorized practice.

metadata.title: The Costs of Litigation Act, 2017
metadata.amends: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908; Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to regulate costs in legal proceedings. It introduces provisions for awarding actual litigation costs to successful parties, imposing fees for adjournments caused by non-appearance, and establishing rules for special costs against false averments.

metadata.title: The Cotton Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to promote international trade in cotton within Pakistan. It establishes a Cotton Board with specific functions and powers to supervise dealings, requisition factories, and regulate contracts for export.

metadata.title: The Cotton Cess Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the creation of a fund dedicated to the improvement and development of cotton growing, marketing, and manufacture. It establishes the Pakistan Central Cotton Committee to manage this fund and outlines provisions for the imposition, collection, and application of the cotton cess.

metadata.title: The Cotton Cloth Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government to appoint Controllers to ensure a cheap supply of cotton cloth manufactured in the country for poorer classes. It grants Controllers authority to regulate manufacture, distribution, and sale, fix prices based on production costs, and issue orders regarding standard cloth specifications.

metadata.title: The Cotton Cloth and Yarn (Contracts) Ordinance, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the maximum prices that may be charged for cotton cloth and yarn sold under contracts. It ensures that sales made after a specific order do not exceed fixed maximum retail prices or previous transfer prices, allowing buyers to recover any excess amounts paid.

name: Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better regulation of cotton ginning and cotton pressing factories in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for maintaining specific registers, marking bales, and outlines penalties for non-compliance or false entries.

name: Cotton Ginning Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Cotton Ginning Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Cotton Ginning Control and Development Act, 1976 (LIX of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Cotton Ginning Control and Development Act, 1976. It provides for the return of establishments to their previous management, ensures the continuance in service of employees, and outlines provisions regarding compensation and prohibitions on operations.

metadata.title: The Cotton Industry (Statistics) Act, 1926
metadata.repeals: The Cotton Duties Act, 1896 (II of 1896)
metadata.summary: This Act mandates the regular submission of monthly returns regarding quantities of cotton goods manufactured and cotton yarn spun in mills. It grants authorized officers the power to inspect mills, examine records, and publish statistical statements while defining penalties for falsifying records or refusing to deliver returns.

metadata.title: The Cotton Standardization Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Cotton Standards Institute as a body corporate to promote quality control of cotton. It defines the institute's management structure, including the constitution of its Board and the appointment of officers and staff.

metadata.title: The Cotton Transport Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the restriction and control of cotton transport by rail to maintain the quality and reputation of cotton grown in specific areas. It empowers the appropriate Government to issue notifications prohibiting the import of cotton into designated protected areas without a license.

metadata.title: The Countervailing Duties Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act reforms and repeals the Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001 to provide a legal framework for imposing countervailing duties in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for investigating subsidies on imported goods, determining injury to the domestic industry, and implementing provisional or definitive measures.

name: Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001(Repealed by Act XIII of 2015)

metadata.title: The Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the imposition of countervailing duties to offset injurious subsidies on imported goods in Pakistan. It provides a legal framework for investigating subsidies, determining injury to domestic industries, and imposing provisional or definitive duties.

metadata.title: The Court-fees Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for levying and collecting court fees in High Courts, subordinate courts, and public offices within Pakistan. It details the specific fees payable on documents filed in various jurisdictions, including original, appellate, and extraordinary civil and criminal cases.

metadata.title: The COVID-19 (Prevention of Hoarding) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of hoarding of scheduled articles during the emergent situation caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. It defines key terms such as 'dealer' and 'hoarding', establishes offences with specific punishments including imprisonment and fines, and grants officers powers to search premises and seize contraband without a warrant.

metadata.title: The Credit Bureaus Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the incorporation and functioning of credit bureaus in Pakistan. It establishes the legal framework for collecting, maintaining, and disseminating credit information regarding debtors of banks, financial institutions, and other lenders to facilitate efficient credit distribution.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law Amendment (Special Court) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Special Courts composed of High Court judges to try specific offences affecting the security, integrity, or sovereignty of Pakistan. It outlines the powers and procedures for these courts, including the requirement that formal charges be read immediately upon the accused's appearance.

metadata.title: The Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1908
metadata.repeals: The Indian Criminal Law Amendment Repealing Act, 1922 (V of 1922)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the speedy trial of certain offences and prohibits associations dangerous to public peace. It defines unlawful associations, outlines procedures for declaring them unlawful by Federal or Provincial Governments, and prescribes penalties for members and managers of such associations.

name: Customs Act, 1969 (Same as on the official website of FBR dated 30-06-2025)

metadata.title: The Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for customs administration in Pakistan, including the appointment of officers and their powers. It regulates the levy, exemption, and repayment of customs duties on imported and exported goods. The legislation also covers prohibitions on trade, warehousing licenses, and procedures for the arrival and departure of conveyances.

metadata.title: The Cutchi Memons Act, 1938
metadata.repeals: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1942 (XXV of 1942)
metadata.summary: This Act provides that all Cutchi Memons shall be governed by Muslim Law in matters of succession and inheritance. It includes provisions for savings regarding rights acquired before the Act's commencement and specifies its repeal by a later act.

metadata.title: The Cutting of Trees (Prohibition) Act, 1992
metadata.repeals: The Cutting of Trees (Prohibition) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the cutting, felling, or damaging of trees near the external frontiers of Pakistan without prior written approval from an authorized officer. It establishes specific zones adjacent to the frontier and sets minimum tree density requirements for each zone before any cutting is permitted.

metadata.title: The Daanish Schools Authority Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Daanish Schools Authority to regulate and manage Daanish Schools for providing quality education to destitute children and other segments of society. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Authority, including its role in curriculum prescription, scholarship awards, and student welfare.

metadata.title: The Daanish University Islamabad Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Daanish University, Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's powers, functions, and structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies like the Senate.

metadata.title: The Dangerous Cargoes Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the safety of ports regarding the transit, working, and storage of dangerous cargoes. It grants specific powers to the Federal Government, Fortress Commander, and Chief of the Naval Staff to manage emergencies, control vessels, and enforce safety measures.

metadata.title: The Dar-ul-Madina International University Islamabad Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Dar-ul-Madina International University as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's officers, authorities, and powers to acquire property and conduct academic programs.

metadata.title: The Day Care Centres Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the facility of day care centres in both public and private establishments. It mandates that establishments with at least seventy employees must ensure the establishment of such centres to benefit their employees.

metadata.title: The Decorations Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conferment of decorations by the President to recognize gallantry, meritorious service in the Armed Forces, academic distinction, or distinction in sports and nursing. It establishes restrictions on the creation and acceptance of foreign decorations and outlines penalties for contravention.

metadata.title: The Defamation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal provisions regarding defamation and related matters in Pakistan. It defines various terms such as broadcasting, editor, and publisher, and establishes that false statements injuring a person's reputation are actionable without proof of special damage.

metadata.title: Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Defence Housing Authority Islamabad as a body corporate to carry out land development schemes and projects. Its primary purpose is to provide housing and welfare benefits for bereaved families of martyrs, war injured, disabled, and other personnel of the defence forces of Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Defence Services (Inquiry) (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a uniform procedure for inquiring into the conduct of Defence Service members serving outside their primary organization or unit. It defines key terms such as 'board of inquiry' and 'commanding officer', outlines the composition and convening process for these boards, and details the submission of findings to the Chief of Staff for action under service law.

metadata.title: The Defense Forces of Pakistan Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Defense Forces Headquarters and defines the powers and functions of the Chief of the Defense Forces. It provides for multidomain integration, operational cohesion, and ensures that its provisions override any inconsistent laws or regulations previously in force.

name: Degree Awarding Status to Dawood College of Engineering and Technology, Karachi Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Degree Awarding Status to Dawood College of Engineering and Technology, Karachi Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act grants degree awarding status to Dawood College of Engineering and Technology, Karachi. It reconstitutes the college as a body corporate with perpetual succession and establishes its academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

metadata.title: The Dekkhan Agriculturists' Relief Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to agriculturists in the Dekkhan region by regulating suits, mortgages, and insolvency proceedings. It establishes specific procedures for subordinate judges, village munsifs, and conciliators to protect debtor-farmers from harsh legal practices like imprisonment or arbitrary attachment of property.

metadata.title: The Delimitation of Constituencies Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the delimitation of territorial constituencies for elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies in Pakistan. It establishes the powers, procedures, and functions of the Election Commission regarding constituency boundaries and seat allocation.

metadata.title: The Deposit Protection Corporation Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Deposit Protection Corporation as a subsidiary of the State Bank of Pakistan. It provides for the management, control, and operation of the Corporation to protect eligible depositors and maintain public trust in the financial system.

name: Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Deputy Chairman of the Senate and the Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly. It details specific financial benefits including salary rates, equipment allowances, transport provisions, official residence rights, and medical facilities.

metadata.title: The Destruction of Records Act, 1917
metadata.repeals: The Destruction of Records Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the destruction or other disposal of documents held by courts, revenue officers, and other public officials. It empowers specific authorities to make rules for disposing of documents deemed not to have sufficient public value for preservation.

metadata.title: The Development of Industries (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: The Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1972. It provides for the dissolution of the Board, the winding-up of its affairs, and the transfer of its assets, liabilities, and employees to the Federal Government or specified corporations.

metadata.title: The Development of Industries (Government Control) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters connected with the development of industries under government control in Pakistan. It declares that such development is expedient in the public interest and empowers the appropriate Government to regulate new or existing undertakings.

metadata.title: The Digital Nation Pakistan Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transformation of Pakistan into a digital nation by leveraging digital technologies and robust Digital Public Infrastructure. It establishes the National Digital Commission and the Pakistan Digital Authority to provide strategic direction, governance, and operational oversight for accelerating sustainable economic development and modernizing public service delivery.

metadata.title: The Digital Presence Proceeds Tax Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act enforces a new tax on foreign vendors with significant digital presence in Pakistan, taxing proceeds from supplies of digitally ordered services or goods. It establishes definitions for key terms like e-commerce and payment intermediaries, outlines charging rates, and sets forth reporting requirements and penalties for non-compliance.

name: Diplomatic and Consular Officers (Oaths and Fees) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Diplomatic and Consular Officers (Oaths and Fees) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration of oaths and affirmations by diplomatic and consular officers in foreign countries. It also prescribes the fees leviable for certain official duties performed by these officers and establishes penalties for taking excessive fees or forging seals.

metadata.title: The Diplomatic and Consular Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Diplomatic and Consular Privileges Ordinance, 1972 (XV of 1972)
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, 1961, and the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations, 1963. It grants force of law to the provisions of these Conventions while establishing restrictions on privileges and powers for the Federal Government to amend schedules or issue certificates regarding entitlement.

name: Diplomatic Immunities (Common wealth Countries Representatives), Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Diplomatic Immunities (Commonwealth Countries Representatives) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act declares and confers specific immunities on representatives in Pakistan from Commonwealth Countries and certain other persons. It defines the scope of immunity for chief representatives, their staff, and family members, while also providing rules for granting consular immunity and procedures for waiving these rights.

name: Diplomatic Immunities (Conferences with Common wealth Countries) Act, 1963

metadata.title: The Diplomatic Immunities (Conferences with Commonwealth Countries) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act provides for conferring certain immunities on representatives of Commonwealth countries and their official staffs attending conferences in Pakistan. It establishes the reciprocal conditions for application, mandates the compilation and publication of lists by the Secretary to the Government of Pakistan, and defines the scope of immunity from suit and legal process as well as inviolability of residence and premises.

metadata.title: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the employment, rehabilitation, and welfare of disabled persons in Pakistan. It establishes a National Council to formulate policies and coordinate efforts across provincial councils while defining key terms such as 'disabled person' and 'establishment'.

metadata.title: The Discontinuance of Medical Reimbursement Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act discontinues the reimbursement of medical expenses for government servants and employees of public corporations and statutory bodies in Pakistan. It applies to all such employees regardless of whether they serve the Federation, a Province, or are on deputation, and it overrides any existing laws, rules, or contracts regarding these claims.

metadata.title: The Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act, 1939
metadata.repeals: The Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act, 1939 (as amended by the Repealing and Amending Act, 1942)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and clarifies provisions of Muslim law regarding suits for the dissolution of marriage by women married under that law. It specifically addresses the legal effects of a married Muslim woman renouncing Islam on her marriage tie and lists specific grounds upon which a woman may obtain a decree for dissolution.

metadata.title: The Disturbed Areas (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Disturbed Areas (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers special powers upon Magistrates, police officers, and Armed Forces personnel in designated disturbed areas to maintain public order. It grants authority to use force, including lethal force if necessary, to disperse unlawful assemblies or arrest suspects without a warrant.

metadata.title: The Divorce Act
metadata.amends: law relating to Divorce and Matrimonial Causes
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to divorce and matrimonial causes for persons professing the Christian religion. It confers jurisdiction upon certain courts to grant relief, make decrees of dissolution or nullity of marriage, and handle related matters such as alimony and custody.

metadata.title: The Dock Labourers Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Geneva Convention concerning the protection against accidents of workers employed in loading and unloading ships. It establishes inspectors, defines key terms like 'processes' and 'worker', and grants the Federal Government powers to make regulations regarding safety measures, machinery conditions, and working environments.

metadata.title: The Dock Workers (Regulation of Employment) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the employment of dock workers to ensure efficient performance of work and speedy transit of goods. It empowers the Federal Government to make schemes for worker registration, defines obligations for employers and workers, and mandates the transfer of dock worker funds to the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Domestic Violence (Prevention and Protection) Act, 2026
