metadata.summary: This Act establishes an effective system for the protection, relief, and rehabilitation of women, men, transgender individuals, children, and vulnerable persons against domestic violence. It defines domestic violence to include physical, psychological, and sexual abuse within a domestic relationship and outlines powers for courts to issue protection and residence orders.

metadata.title: The Dormant Funds (Administration) Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration and proper utilization of certain dormant funds raised by public subscriptions and donations. It vests these funds, along with accrued interest and profits, in the President for specific relief purposes or causes.

metadata.title: The Dourine Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of the spread of dourine in horses. It establishes a framework for the registration of breeding horses, the appointment of inspectors and veterinary practitioners, and grants powers to inspect, segregate, castrate, or destroy infected animals.

metadata.title: The Dowry and Bridal Gifts (Restriction) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act imposes restrictions on the value of dowry, bridal gifts, and presents given in connection with marriages in Pakistan. It also limits total marriage expenditure and mandates declarations regarding these costs to be submitted to a Registrar.

metadata.title: The Dramatic Performances Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government to prohibit public dramatic performances deemed scandalous, defamatory, seditious, or obscene. It outlines procedures for serving prohibition orders, penalties for disobedience, and grants police warrants to enter premises suspected of hosting prohibited performances.

metadata.title: The Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan to coordinate and enforce regulations regarding therapeutic goods. It aims to bring harmony in inter-provincial trade and regulate the manufacture, import, export, storage, distribution, and sale of drugs and medical devices.

metadata.title: The Drugs Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the import, export, manufacture, storage, distribution, and sale of drugs within Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'drug', 'adulterated drug', and 'counterfeit drug' while outlining the administration and enforcement mechanisms.

metadata.title: The Drugs and Medicines (Indemnity) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides indemnity to Government servants and other persons for acts done in pursuance of a specific notified order regarding drugs and medicines. It ensures that no legal suit, prosecution, or proceeding can be instituted against them for actions taken under that order.

metadata.title: The Dyslexia Special Measures Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for special measures regarding the education of children suffering from dyslexia and associated disorders. It establishes rights to inclusive education, mandates identification procedures, requires instructional accommodations, and outlines provisions for special educators and therapists.

name: Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority (ERRA) as an autonomous body corporate to manage post-disaster recovery. It outlines the Authority's functions, including damage assessment, infrastructure reconstruction, and resettlement planning for areas affected by earthquakes.

metadata.title: The Easements Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to easements and licenses in Pakistan. It establishes rights for owners or occupiers of land to do or prevent certain actions regarding other lands, covering topics such as acquisition, transfer, disturbance, and extinction of these rights.

metadata.title: The Ehtram-e-Ramazan Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to observe the sanctity of the month of Ramazan in Pakistan. It prohibits fasting individuals from eating, drinking, or smoking in public places and restricts the serving of food during fasting hours. Additionally, it mandates the closure of cinema houses and theatres from sunset until three hours thereafter.

metadata.title: The Elections Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for elections to the National Assembly, Provincial Assemblies, and Senate in Pakistan. It outlines the powers of the Election Commission, procedures for delimiting constituencies, preparing electoral rolls, conducting polls, managing election expenses, and resolving election disputes.

name: Electoral Rolls Act, 1974(Repeal by No.F.8(9)/2017 dated 23-10-2017)

metadata.title: The Electoral Rolls Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preparation and revision of electoral rolls for elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies. It establishes definitions, procedures for registration officers, and mechanisms for handling claims and objections regarding voter enrollment.

metadata.title: The Electricity Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the supply and use of electrical energy in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for granting licenses, managing transmission lines, defining consumer rights, and imposing penalties for offenses related to electricity theft or misuse.

metadata.title: The Electricity Control Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides the Federal Government with powers to control the production, distribution, use, and consumption of electrical energy throughout Pakistan during an emergency. It authorizes the issuance of orders to regulate or prohibit specific activities related to electricity and establishes penalties for non-compliance while granting immunity for actions taken in good faith under these orders.

metadata.title: The Electronic Transactions Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recognition and facilitation of documents, records, information, communications, and transactions in electronic form. It also establishes a framework for the accreditation of certification service providers to ensure the authenticity and integrity of electronic data.

metadata.title: The Elephants' Preservation Act, 1879
metadata.repeals: Repealing and Amending Act, 1930 (VIII of 1930)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation of wild elephants by prohibiting their killing, injuring, or capture except under specific circumstances or with a license. It grants powers to the Provincial Government and local officials to issue licenses, declare main roads, and regulate fees associated with these activities.

metadata.title: The Emigration Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: The Emigration Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Emigration Act, 1922 with certain modifications to regulate the emigration of Pakistani citizens for employment or self-employment abroad. It establishes the Director-General and Protector of Emigrants, outlines their functions, regulates overseas employment promoters, and defines offences related to unlawful emigration and fraud.

metadata.title: The Employees Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a cost of living allowance to employees in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'undertaking' to establish who is covered by these provisions.

metadata.title: The Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the law relating to old-age benefits for persons employed in industrial, commercial, and other organizations. It establishes provisions for compulsory insurance, contributions by employers and the government, and various benefit schemes including old-age pensions and survivor's pensions.

metadata.title: The Employees' Social Insurance Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance introduces a scheme of social insurance to provide benefits to certain employees or their dependants in cases of sickness, maternity, employment injury, or death. It also covers matters ancillary to these benefits.

metadata.title: The Employers' Liability Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act declares that certain defences shall not be raised in suits for damages regarding injuries sustained by workmen in Pakistan. It establishes specific conditions under which an employer cannot claim the common employment defence or argue that a workman assumed risks without full knowledge.

metadata.title: The Employment (Record of Services) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the compulsory maintenance of service records for persons in certain classes of employment within specified areas. It mandates that employers produce, maintain, and hand over service books to employees upon termination of service, while also defining exemptions and penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Employment of Children Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children in specific occupations and processes listed in its Schedule. It also regulates the working hours, periods, and safety conditions for children employed in other establishments.

metadata.title: The Enemy Agents Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the trial and punishment of enemy agents and persons committing offences with the intent to aid the enemy. It establishes Special Judges appointed by the Federal Government to try such cases throughout Pakistan, outlining their jurisdiction, procedure, and sentencing powers.

name: Enemy Property (Continuance of Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: The Enemy Property (Continuance of Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of specific emergency provisions from the Defence of Pakistan Rules regarding trading with enemies and controlling enemy firms. It ensures that these rules and related orders remain in force even after the Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1965 ceases to have effect, while allowing for modifications and delegations of power.

name: Enemy Property (Continuance of Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Enemy Property (Continuance of Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of certain provisions of the Defence of Pakistan Rules regarding trading with enemies and enemy firms. It ensures that these rules and related orders remain in force despite the repeal of the Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971.

metadata.title: The Enforcement of Shari'ah Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the supremacy of Shari'ah as the supreme law of Pakistan and mandates that all laws be interpreted in light of Islamic principles. It outlines provisions for the teaching of Shari'ah, the Islamization of education and economy, and ensures the protection of fundamental rights while safeguarding the traditions of non-Muslim citizens.

name: Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act protects and secures the rights of ownership and possession of properties owned by women in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a mechanism for women to file complaints with an Ombudsman regarding illegal deprivation of their property, enabling the restoration of title or possession without necessarily proceeding through a civil court initially.

name: Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897 (Repeal by W.P. Act. XXXVi of 1958))

metadata.title: The Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Act 36 of 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better prevention of the spread of dangerous epidemic diseases by empowering provincial and federal governments to take special measures. It allows authorities to prescribe temporary regulations, inspect travelers, segregate suspected cases, and penalize those who disobey orders made under the Act.

metadata.title: The Equity Participation Fund (Repeal) Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the compulsory registration of essential personnel at Employment Exchanges established by the Government of Pakistan. It defines essential personnel and employment exchanges, outlines the liability to register for individuals and employers, and details the procedures for obtaining registration certificates.

metadata.title: The Esso Undertakings (Vesting) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the vesting of certain undertakings of Esso Eastern Inc. in Pakistan into the Federal Government. It defines the scope of these undertakings, which include assets related to purchasing, storing, and distributing petroleum products, while excluding natural gas and crude oil businesses.

name: Establishment of Special Court (Overseas Pakistanis Property) Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Establishment of Special Court (Overseas Pakistanis Property) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes special courts within the Islamabad Capital Territory to adjudicate petitions regarding the immovable properties of overseas Pakistanis. It defines key terms such as 'Overseas Pakistani' and outlines the powers, appointment, and tenure of judges for these specialized courts.

name: Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking (Repeal) Act, 2018 (Act No_XXVI of 2018)

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking (Repeal) Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking Act, 1977. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of cooperative Banking Act, 1977(Repeal by Act XXVi of 2018 s.2)

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of a Federal Bank for Cooperatives and regulates cooperative banking in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'Bank', 'cooperative bank', and 'borrower' while outlining the powers, functions, and governance structure of the newly established entity.

name: Establishment of the Office of Federal Tax Ombudsman Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of Federal Tax Ombudsman Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Office of the Federal Tax Ombudsman to diagnose, investigate, and redress injustices caused by maladministration in tax laws. It defines the appointment, tenure, powers, and functions of the Ombudsman and their staff while outlining procedures for handling complaints regarding tax assessments, refunds, and duties.

name: Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Office of the Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) to diagnose, investigate, and redress injustices caused by maladministration. It outlines the appointment process, tenure, powers, and conditions of service for the Mohtasib and their staff.

metadata.title: Esta-Code (Edition-2021)
metadata.summary: This document is the consolidated administrative manual known as Esta-Code, published by the Pakistan Public Administration Research Centre (PPARC) in 2021. It compiles all current rules and regulations regarding civil services structure, recruitment, appointments, leave, transfers, and discipline within the Government of Pakistan.

name: Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Act, 1956; Pakistan Rehabilitation Act, 1956; Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Act, 1957; Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958; Displaced Persons (Land Settlement) Act, 1958; Scrutiny of Claims (Evacuee Property) Regulation, 1961; Price of Evacuee Property and Public Dues (Recovery) Regulation, 1971
metadata.summary: This Act repeals several laws and regulations relating to evacuee property and the rehabilitation of displaced persons. It provides for the transfer of available urban and rural properties to the Provincial Government and outlines procedures for the disposal of residual work regarding documentation and financial recoveries.

name: Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and disposal of evacuee properties attached to charitable, religious, or educational trusts or institutions. It establishes the Evacuee Trust Property Board to exercise general supervision and control over these properties.

name: Ex-Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan (Appointment to Federal Posts) Ordinance, 1983.

metadata.title: The Ex-Employees of the former Government of East Pakistan (Appointment to Federal Posts) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of former employees of the Government of East Pakistan to posts under the Federal Government. It establishes rules regarding their seniority and pension eligibility based on service rendered under the former government.

name: Ex-Government Servants (Employment with Foreign Governments) (Prohibition) Act, 1966

metadata.title: The Ex-Government Servants (Employment with Foreign Governments) (Prohibition) Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits ex-Government servants from seeking or taking up employment with foreign governments or agencies without prior written permission. It defines key terms such as 'ex-Government servant', 'foreign agency', and 'foreign Government' to clarify the scope of the prohibition.

metadata.title: The Excise (Spirits) Act, 1863
metadata.summary: This Act provides special provisions for levying excise duty on spirits used exclusively in arts, manufactures, or chemistry. It mandates that such spirits must be rendered unfit for human consumption before removal from a licensed distillery and establishes rules for ascertaining this condition.

name: Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967

metadata.title: The Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967
metadata.repeals: Act XXXII of 1947
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an excise duty on specific minerals to finance measures promoting the welfare of labour in the mining industry. It establishes a fund for housing and general welfare, creates boards to manage these funds, and outlines provisions for collecting duties and granting aid to mine owners who maintain dispensary services.

name: Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of Fishing) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of Fishing) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of fishing within the exclusive fishery zone of Pakistan. It establishes prohibitions on unlicensed fishing, specific destructive methods like dynamiting, and sets out penalties for contraventions.

name: Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal provisions for the execution of whipping punishments imposed under existing laws in Pakistan. It establishes specific conditions regarding medical examinations, weather constraints, and the specifications of the whip used during execution.

metadata.title: The Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control of exit from Pakistan by certain persons. It empowers the Federal Government to prohibit individuals or classes of persons from leaving the country, even if they possess valid travel documents, without requiring a prior opportunity to show cause.

metadata.title: The Explosive Substances Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act defines explosive substances and establishes punishments for causing explosions, attempting to cause them, or possessing explosives with malicious intent. It also outlines penalties for making explosives under suspicious circumstances and provisions for the forfeiture of property upon conviction.

metadata.title: The Explosives Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, possession, use, sale, transport, and importation of explosives. It defines various explosive substances and establishes powers for licensing, prohibition, inspection, and inquiry into accidents.

name: Export Control on Goods, Technologies, Material and Equipment related to nuclear and Biological Weapons and their Delivery Systems Act, 2004

metadata.title: Export Control on Goods, Technologies, Material and Equipment related to Nuclear and Biological Weapons and their Delivery Systems Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes export controls on goods, technologies, materials, and equipment related to nuclear and biological weapons and their delivery systems. It aims to safeguard national security, fulfill international obligations, and prevent the proliferation of such weapons by regulating exports, re-exports, transshipment, and transit within Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Export Development Fund Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Export Development Fund to strengthen and develop infrastructure for promoting exports. It provides for the administration of the fund by a Board of Administrators and outlines the purposes for which the fund's money can be utilized, including training institutes and market development.

metadata.title: The Export Processing Zones Authority Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Export Processing Zones Authority to plan, develop, and manage industrial zones in Pakistan. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines the constitution, duties, and functions of its Board and Chairman.

metadata.title: The Export Import Bank of Pakistan Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Export-Import Bank of Pakistan as the official export credit agency to support and promote international trade. It provides for the bank's capital, powers, management structure, sovereign support, and regulatory application.

metadata.title: The Extradition Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the extradition of fugitive offenders in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for the surrender of offenders to treaty and non-treaty states, defines key terms such as 'extradition offence' and 'fugitive offender', and outlines the roles of the Federal Government and Magistrates.

metadata.title: The Eye Surgery (Restriction) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prevents non-registered persons from performing eye surgery in Pakistan. It defines specific terms like 'complete blindness' and establishes punishments, including imprisonment and fines, for unauthorized practice or causing partial or complete blindness.

metadata.title: The Factories Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regulating labor in factories. It establishes definitions for workers, sets standards for health and safety, restricts working hours, and outlines penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Fatal Accidents Act, 1855
metadata.summary: This Act provides for suits to recover damages from a wrong-doer when their actionable negligence causes the death of another person. The recovered compensation is intended for the benefit of the deceased's wife, husband, parents, and children, with the court determining the specific shares.

name: Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education as a body corporate. It defines the Board's jurisdiction, composition, powers, and functions regarding intermediate and secondary education institutions within Pakistan.

name: Federal Board of Revenue Act, 2007 (extracted from Finance Act, 2007)

metadata.title: The Federal Board of Revenue Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Board of Revenue as an autonomous organization to enhance tax collection capacity through modern techniques. It re-organizes the Central Board of Revenue into the Federal Board of Revenue and defines its powers, functions, and human resource policies.

name: Federal Constitutional Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 2025

metadata.title: The Federal Constitutional Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 2025
metadata.summary: This Order determines the privileges, allowances, rights regarding leave of absence, and pension for Judges of the Federal Constitutional Court. It establishes rules concerning kinds of leave, leave accounts, aggregate limits, salary rates during leave, and entitlement to pension.

metadata.title: The Federal Court(Repeal) Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Federal Court Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Federal Court Act, 1937. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: Federal Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Act,1969

metadata.title: The Federal Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a benevolent fund for the common benefit of Federal Government employees and certain autonomous bodies. It also provides legal provisions for their group insurance arrangements, including the establishment of an Insurance Fund and rules regarding subscriptions and grants.

name: Federal Excise Act, 2005 (Same as on the official website of FBR dated 30-06-2026)

metadata.title: The Federal Excise Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for levying, collecting, and paying federal excise duties in Pakistan. It outlines procedures for filing returns, determining duty values, handling exemptions, and addressing offences related to tax evasion.

name: Federal Government Employees Housing Authority Act, 2020.

metadata.title: The Federal Government Employees Housing Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Government Employees Housing Authority to plan and develop housing schemes for serving and retired federal government employees. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to acquire land, regulate schemes, and provide public services in specified areas.

name: Federal Government Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Possession) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Federal Government Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Possession) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the speedy recovery of possession of Central Government lands and buildings from outgoing lessees, licensees, and unauthorized occupants. It outlines the powers of authorized officers to enter premises, evict occupants, demolish structures, and recover arrears of rent when leases or licenses expire or are revoked.

metadata.title: The Federal Investigation Agency Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of the Federal Investigation Agency to investigate specific offences connected with matters concerning the Federal Government. It defines the agency's structure, vesting superintendence in the Federal Government and administration in a Director-General appointed by them. The legislation grants members of the Agency powers equivalent to Provincial Police officers regarding search, arrest, and seizure of property throughout Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Federal Judicial Academy Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Judicial Academy as a body corporate to provide proper training for judicial officers and court personnel. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Board of Governors, including policy-making and staff management.

name: Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Act, 2021 (Repealed by Act No.I of 2023)

metadata.title: The Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act re-organizes Federal medical teaching institutes and their affiliated hospitals to provide them with autonomy. It establishes a Board of Governors to manage affairs, defines various roles such as Dean and Hospital Director, and outlines functions related to healthcare services, education, and research.

name: Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salaries, allowances, and privileges applicable to Federal Ministers and Ministers of State in Pakistan. It establishes specific provisions regarding monthly pay, equipment allowances, transport facilities, official residences, and various other benefits connected with their office.

metadata.title: The Federal Ombudsmen Institutional Reforms Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes institutional reforms to standardize and harmonize laws relating to the Federal Ombudsmen institution in Pakistan. It aims to enhance the effectiveness of Ombudsmen by granting them administrative and financial autonomy to provide speedy relief to citizens.

metadata.title: The Federal Prosecution Service, Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Criminal Prosecution Service and defines its functions to institute and conduct criminal proceedings initiated by police or federal agencies. It outlines the administration, appointment qualifications, powers, and duties of prosecutors within the service.

name: Federal Public Service Commission (Validation of Rules) Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Federal Public Service Commission (Validation of Rules) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act validates the rules regulating competitive examinations conducted by the Federal Public Service Commission in 2016 and 2017. It deems these rules, along with their amendments, to have been validly made from the date of their notification, regardless of any defects in approval.

metadata.title: The Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Federal Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Federal Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Federal Public Service Commission Act, 1973 with certain modifications. It establishes the composition, term of office, and functions of the Federal Public Service Commission, including provisions for recruitment examinations and member eligibility.

name: Federal Supervision of Curricula Text-books and Maintenance of Standards of Education Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Federal Supervision of Curricula, Text books and Maintenance of Standards of Education Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes federal supervision over curricula and textbooks to maintain educational standards across Pakistan. It creates a Competent Authority empowered to prepare study schemes, approve manuscripts, and direct amendments or withdrawals of educational materials.

metadata.title: The Federal Universities Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes and restructures universities established by the Federal Government in Pakistan. It aims to provide autonomy while improving governance and management to enhance the quality of higher education.

name: Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences and Technology, Islamabad Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences and Technology, Islamabad Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences and Technology in Islamabad. It defines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies such as the Senate and Syndicate.

metadata.title: The Federal Ziauddin University Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Ziauddin University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while ensuring it remains open to all persons regardless of sex, religion, race, or creed.

metadata.title: The Fee-Charging Employment Agencies (Regulation) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the working of fee-charging and other employment agencies conducted for profit within Pakistan. It establishes a competent authority to issue licenses, define prohibited practices, and impose penalties on unauthorized agencies.

metadata.title: The Ferries Act, 1878
metadata.repeals: Repealing Act, 1938 (I of 1938)
metadata.summary: This Act regulates ferries in certain provinces, including the power to declare, establish, and discontinue public ferries. It also covers management by municipalities or district councils, toll collection, penalties for unauthorized operations, and procedures for compensation.

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: Central Excises Act, 1944; petroleum Products (Development Surcharge) Ordinance 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 2001. It amends the Central Excises Act, 1944 and the petroleum Products (Development Surcharge) Ordinance 1961 to update tax rates and definitions.

metadata.title: The Financial Institutions (Recovery of Finances) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans, Advances, Credits and Finances) Act, 1997
metadata.repeals: The Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans, Advances, Credits and Finances) Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans, Advances, Credits and Finances) Act, 1997 with certain modifications. It establishes Banking Courts to handle suits for the recovery of written-off finances and defines the powers of these courts regarding decrees, asset attachment, and property sales.

metadata.title: The Financial Institutions (Secured Transactions) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the creation of security interests over movable property to secure obligations owed by customers to financial institutions. It also establishes a secured transactions registry and aims to clarify, expand, define, amend, and codify laws relating to security interests over movable property.

name: Fiscal Responsibility and Debt Limitation Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Fiscal Responsibility and Debt Limitation Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reduction of the Federal fiscal deficit and the ratio of public debt to gross domestic product to prudent levels through effective public debt management. It establishes principles for sound fiscal and debt management, mandates specific economic policy statements, and creates a Debt Management Office.

metadata.title: The Fisheries Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters relating to fisheries in Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'fish', 'fixed engine', and 'private water' while prohibiting the destruction of fish using explosives or poisons.

name: Flour Milling Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Flour Milling Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Flour Milling Control and Development Act, 1976 (LVII of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Flour Milling Control and Development Act, 1976. It provides for the return of establishments to their previous management, ensures the continuance in service of employees, and outlines compensation mechanisms for assets transferred.

metadata.title: The Flying Clubs (Appointment of Administrators) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Administrators to manage the affairs of Flying Clubs when the Managing Committee is unable to function properly. It outlines the powers and functions of the Administrator, the process for their termination, penalties for withholding property or obstructing them, and grants indemnity to the Administrator and the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Foreign Assets (Declaration and Repatriation) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the declaration and repatriation of assets and income held outside Pakistan to address non-reporting and under-reporting. It defines various terms related to foreign assets, holders of public office, and government securities, while establishing that its provisions override other laws.

name: Foreign Cultural Associations (Regulation of Functioning) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Foreign Cultural Associations (Regulation of Functioning) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the functioning of foreign cultural associations in Pakistan. It establishes rules regarding their formation, registration requirements, responsibilities, dissolution procedures, and restrictions on government servants becoming members.

metadata.title: The Foreign Currency Accounts (Protection) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides immediate legal protection for holders of foreign currency accounts in Pakistan, ensuring they can operate, sell, withdraw, or transfer funds without restriction. It grants immunity from legal proceedings against the government for actions taken in good faith under this law and establishes that its provisions override conflicting existing statutes.

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange (Prevention of Payments) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Federal Government to prohibit certain payments related to foreign exchange repatriation. It grants the State Bank of Pakistan the power to direct authorized dealers and other persons to deposit specific amounts with the bank and outlines penalties for contravention.

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange (Temporary Restrictions) Act, 1998
metadata.repeals: The Foreign Exchange (Temporary Restrictions) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Act imposes temporary restrictions on dealings in foreign exchange within Pakistan to stabilize the economy. It suspends the right to withdraw or transfer foreign exchange held as of May 28, 1998, without prior permission from the State Bank of Pakistan, while allowing conversion into rupees at the official rate. The legislation also empowers the Federal Government to issue further concessions and financial instruments, repeals a previous Ordinance on the same subject, and preserves existing protections under the Protection of Economic Reforms Act, 1992.

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act regulates certain payments, dealings in foreign exchange and securities, as well as the import and export of currency and bullion. It establishes provisions for authorized dealers, restrictions on dealing in foreign exchange, and powers for the Federal Government to manage these financial matters.

metadata.title: The Foreign Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion and protection of certain qualified foreign investments in Pakistan. It aims to improve the investment climate by offering direct and indirect tax incentives and ensuring the ease of transferring and repatriating foreign investments.

name: Foreign Private Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Foreign Private Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion and protection of foreign private investment in Pakistan. It establishes conditions for approval, defines terms like foreign capital and industrial undertakings, and outlines protections for agreements and repatriation facilities.

metadata.title: The Foreigners Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act confers powers upon the Federal Government regarding the entry, presence, and departure of foreigners in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'foreigner' and establishes the authority to make orders regulating foreign nationals.

metadata.title: The Forest Act, 1927
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to forests, the transit of forest produce, and duties leviable on timber and other forest products. It establishes provisions for reserving forests, managing village and protected forests, regulating timber movement, and defining the powers and indemnity of forest officers.

metadata.title: The Foundation University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Foundation University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, President, and Board of Governors, and outlines its functions, powers, and eligibility criteria for students.

name: Freedom of Information Ordinance, 2002(Repealed by Act XXXIV of 2017))

metadata.title: The Freedom of Information Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for transparency and freedom of information to ensure citizens have improved access to public records. It aims to make the Federal Government more accountable by establishing procedures for requesting information, maintaining records, and declaring certain documents as public records.

metadata.title: The Frontier Corps Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the regulation of Frontier Corps Units in Pakistan. It establishes the powers, constitution, appointment procedures, and disciplinary rules for members and officers of the Frontier Corps.

name: Funds Vesting in the President (Transfer) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Funds Vesting in the President (Transfer) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration of certain funds that vest in the President. It mandates that these specified funds, along with their income and profits, shall vest in the Federal Government and be utilized for their original or similar purposes.

metadata.title: The Futures Market Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the futures market and matters connected therewith. It establishes licensing requirements for futures exchanges, clearing houses, and regulated persons while defining their duties and powers.

metadata.title: The Gas (Theft Control and Recovery) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prosecution of cases involving gas theft and other offenses related to gas supply. It also establishes a specific procedure for the expeditious recovery of amounts due, including fines, penalties, and outstanding sums payable to Gas Utility Companies.

metadata.title: The Gas Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the validation, imposition, levy, and collection of a development cess on natural gas sales in Pakistan. The collected funds are designated for infrastructure projects such as the Iran-Pakistan Pipeline, TAPI Pipeline, and LNG initiatives.

metadata.title: The General Clauses Act, 1897
metadata.amends: General Clauses Act, 1868; General Clauses Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and extends the General Clauses Acts of 1868 and 1887. It provides general definitions, rules of construction for enactments, and provisions regarding orders, rules, and bye-laws made under various laws.

metadata.title: The General Statistics (Reorganization) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reorganization of the statistical system in Pakistan through the merger of certain organizations. It establishes the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics and defines its powers, functions, and governance structure via a Governing Council.

metadata.title: The Geneva Convention Implementing Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act implements Article 28 of the Geneva Convention of 1929 and subsequent conventions regarding the protection of wounded and sick. It prohibits unauthorized use of emblems such as 'Red Cross', 'Red Crescent', and the white cross on a red ground, while defining penalties for contravention.

metadata.title: The Geographical Indications (Registration and Protection) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and effective protection of geographical indications of goods in Pakistan. It establishes a legal framework to recognize these indications for public interest, advance economic reform, and prevent unfair competition within the meaning of TRIPS Article 22.

name: Ghurki Institute of Science and Technology Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Ghurki Institute of Science and Technology Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Ghurki Institute of Science and Technology in the private sector. It defines the institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its structure, including various authorities, officers, and governing bodies.

metadata.title: The Glanders and Farcy Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to glanders and farcy in horses. It empowers Provincial Governments to appoint inspectors, authorize searches for diseased animals, and mandate their destruction or treatment if found infected.

name: Global Climate-Change Impact Studies Centre Act, 2013

metadata.title: The Global Climate-Change Impact Studies Centre Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Global Climate-Change Impact Studies Centre (GCISC) as a body corporate to conduct scientific investigations on climate change. The Centre is tasked with studying impacts on sectors such as water, agriculture, and energy, while collaborating with international entities and advising government agencies on adaptation measures.

metadata.title: The Government Buildings Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the exemption of certain government-owned or occupied buildings from municipal building laws when they are situated within municipality limits. It outlines procedures for objections, suggestions, and inspections regarding the erection, construction, or alteration of such public buildings by the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Government Grants Act, 1895
metadata.summary: This Act clarifies the application of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 regarding land grants made by or on behalf of the Government. It establishes that such government grants are not subject to the provisions of the Transfer of Property Act and must be construed according to their own terms.

name: Government Management of Private Estates Act, 1892

metadata.title: The Government Management of Private Estates Act, 1892
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a rate on private estates managed by the Government to cover supervision and management costs. It defines terms such as 'immoveable property' and 'gross income', grants powers to Provincial Governments to set and vary rates, and validates past levies.

metadata.title: The Government Savings Banks Act, 1873
metadata.amends: law relating to Government Savings Banks
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the payment of deposits in Government Savings Banks. It establishes rules for nominations, payments to minors, lunatics, married women, and estates of deceased persons.

metadata.title: The Government Tenants (North-West Frontier) Act, 1893
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the grant of special tenancies in government lands located in the North-West Frontier. It establishes procedures for issuing statements of conditions, maintaining registers of tenancies, and defining the rights and obligations of tenants, including restrictions on transferring those rights without consent.

metadata.title: The Government Trading Taxation Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act determines the liability of Provincial Governments in Pakistan to taxation regarding trading operations carried on by or on their behalf. It stipulates that such governments are liable for income tax in the same manner as a company would be, particularly when trade is conducted outside the province.

metadata.title: The Guardians and Wards Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to guardians and wards in Pakistan. It establishes the framework for appointing guardians, defining their duties and liabilities, and regulating the management of a ward's property.

metadata.title: The Gun and Country Club Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Gun and Country Club in Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the roles of the Patron-in-Chief, Administrator, and Management Committee, along with their respective powers and functions for managing the club's affairs.

metadata.title: The Gwadar Port Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Gwadar Port Authority to manage the planning, construction, operation, and maintenance of the Gwadar Deep Water Port. It outlines the authority's powers regarding land acquisition, toll collection, financial management, and the appointment of officers.

metadata.title: The Gwadur (Application of Central Laws) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance applies all Central laws in force in the Mekran District to the Gwadur territory, which was ceded to Pakistan on September 8, 1958. It deems these Federal Acts and related instruments to have been in force in Gwadur from that date while repealing corresponding local Gwadur laws.

metadata.title: The Hackney-carriage Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of hackney-carriages in certain municipalities and cantonments. It defines key terms such as 'hackney-carriage' and 'committee', and empowers municipal committees to make rules regarding licenses, vehicle conditions, and fare limits.

metadata.title: The Hajj and Umrah (Regulation) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive framework for regulating and managing Hajj and Umrah activities in Pakistan. It provides for policy formulation, licensing of organizers, quota allotment, complaint disposal mechanisms, and the management of specific funds for these operations.

metadata.title: The Health Services Academy (Restructuring) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act restructures the Health Services Academy into a degree-awarding institute to provide it with autonomy. It aims to improve governance and management while enhancing the quality of higher education in Pakistan.

metadata.title: Health Services Academy Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Health Services Academy in Islamabad as an autonomous body with perpetual succession. It outlines the Academy's functions, including providing instruction and training in health sciences, conducting research, awarding degrees, and affiliating other institutions.

metadata.title: The Heavy Industries (Taxila) Board Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Heavy Industries (Taxila) Board to manage and administer factories under Federal Government control. The Board is tasked with organizing these facilities to meet national defense needs during war and peace while utilizing their commercial potential for civilian requirements.

metadata.title: The High Treason (Punishment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the punishment of persons found guilty of acts involving the abrogation or subversion of a Constitution or high treason. It establishes that such offenses are punishable by death or imprisonment for life and restricts court cognizance to complaints authorized by the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Higher Education Commission Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Higher Education Commission to promote and improve higher education, research, and development in Pakistan. It defines the Commission's structure, including its Chairperson, members, and functions, while granting it corporate status and powers to manage property.

metadata.title: The Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act removes existing disabilities regarding the power of Hindus to dispose of property for the benefit of persons not yet in existence. It applies to both transfers inter vivos and wills, subject to specific limitations found in other acts.

metadata.title: The Hindu Gains of Learning Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act removes doubt regarding the rights of a member of a Hindu undivided family to property acquired through their own learning. It establishes that such gains are the exclusive and separate property of the acquirer, regardless of who imparted the education or if the family supported the acquisition.

metadata.title: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends Hindu Law to prevent the exclusion of certain classes of heirs from inheritance based on disease, deformity, or physical or mental defects. It applies to the whole of Pakistan but excludes persons governed by the Daya-bhaga School of Hindu Law.

metadata.title: The Hindu Marriage Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the solemnization of marriages by Hindu families and addresses matters ancillary and incidental thereto. It establishes conditions for a valid Hindu marriage, outlines registration procedures, and defines penalties for contraventions such as bigamy.

metadata.title: The Hindu Marriage Disabilities Removal Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act removes certain disabilities and doubts under Hindu Law regarding marriages between Hindus. It specifically declares that a marriage is not invalid solely because the parties belong to the same gotra, pravara, or different sub-divisions of the same caste.

name: Hindu Married Women's Right to Separate Residence and Maintenance Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Hindu Married Women's Right to Separate Residence and Maintenance Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act grants Hindu married women the right to claim separate residence and maintenance from their husbands under specific circumstances. It outlines grounds such as the husband's loathsome disease, cruelty, desertion, bigamy, conversion to another religion, or keeping a concubine. The legislation also empowers courts to determine the maintenance amount based on social standing and the husband's financial means.

metadata.title: The Hindu Widows' Re-marriage Act, 1856
metadata.summary: This Act removes legal obstacles preventing Hindu widows from contracting a second valid marriage. It stipulates that the rights of a widow in her deceased husband's property cease upon remarriage and addresses guardianship arrangements for their children.

name: Hindu Women s Rights to Property Act, 1937

metadata.title: The Hindu Women's Rights to Property Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Law to provide better property rights for women, specifically widows, when a Hindu dies intestate. It establishes that widows are entitled to the same share of property as a son under certain schools of Hindu law and defines the nature of the interest devolving on them.

name: House Building Finance Corporation (Repeal) Act, 2018 (Act No_XXV of 2018)

metadata.title: The House Building Finance Corporation (Repeal) Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The House Building Finance Corporation Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the House Building Finance Corporation Act, 1952. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

name: House Building Finance Corporation Act, 1952(Repeal by act XXV of 2018,s.2)

metadata.title: The House Building Finance Corporation Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the House Building Finance Corporation to provide financial facilities for the construction, reconstruction, repair, and purchase of houses. It outlines the corporation's establishment, management structure, powers regarding investments and fund raising, and provisions for accounts and audit.

name: Hyderabad Institute for Technology and Management Sciences Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Hyderabad Institute for Technology and Management Sciences Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Hyderabad Institute for Technology and Management Sciences as a degree-awarding institution located in Hyderabad. It defines the powers, purposes, and structure of the Institute, including its officers, authorities, and staff.

name: Hydrocarbon Development Institute of Pakistan Act,2006

metadata.title: The Hydrocarbon Development Institute of Pakistan Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Hydrocarbon Development Institute of Pakistan as a body corporate to undertake scientific and technological research in the hydrocarbon field. It outlines the Institute's objectives, including assisting in national policy formulation, promoting resource exploitation, and providing consultancy services.

name: Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil Industry (Control and Development) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil Industry (Control and Development) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the operation and future development of the hydrogenated vegetable oil industry in Pakistan. It provides for government powers to take over management, acquire shares, and ensure supplies are maintained at reasonable prices while safeguarding small investors.

metadata.title: The Ibadat International University Islamabad Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Ibadat International University in Islamabad within the private sector. It outlines the university's powers, purposes, jurisdiction, and the structure of its officers and authorities, including the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

name: ICT (Tax on Services) Ordinance, 2001 (Same as on the official website of FBR dated 30-06-2025)

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory (Tax on Services) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of sales tax on services rendered or provided within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes the scope of the tax, specifies applicable rates in a schedule, and outlines provisions regarding registration, record-keeping, and enforcement that align with the Sales Tax Act, 1990.

name: ICT Rights of Persons with Disability Act, 2020

metadata.title: The ICT Rights of Persons with Disability Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act promotes, protects, and ensures the rights and inclusion of persons with disabilities within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a legal framework to guarantee equality before the law, non-discrimination, and access to essential services such as education, employment, and healthcare in line with the Constitution and international treaties.

metadata.title: The Identification of Prisoners Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the taking of measurements and photographs of convicts and other persons involved in criminal proceedings. It defines key terms such as 'measurements' and 'police officer', outlines procedures for non-convicted persons, and grants magistrates the power to order these actions during investigations.

metadata.title: The Illegal Dispossession Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to protect lawful owners and occupiers of immovable properties from illegal or forcible dispossession by property grabbers. It establishes specific offenses regarding unauthorized entry and possession, outlines investigation procedures with strict timelines, and grants courts powers for attachment of property and interim eviction relief.

metadata.title: The Import of Goods (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of a development surcharge on specific goods imported through the Karachi customs-port. The proceeds are intended to reimburse the Karachi Port Trust for expenditures incurred on constructing the Jinnah Bridge over China Creek.

name: Import of Goods (Price Equalization Surcharge) Act, 1967

metadata.title: The Import of Goods (Price Equalization Surcharge) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act levies an additional duty known as the price equalization surcharge on certain imported goods to equalize their prices. It provides for the determination of the highest landed cost, the procedure for collecting the surcharge, and grants powers to the Federal Government to make rules and amend the schedule of specified goods.

metadata.title: The Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act continues the powers of the Federal Government to prohibit, restrict, or control imports into and exports from Pakistan. It establishes a framework for issuing licences, defining offences related to trade practices, and regulating goods brought into or taken out of the country by sea, land, or air.

name: Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 (Same as on the official website of FBR dated 31-06-2026)

metadata.title: Income Tax Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This document serves as the primary legislation governing income tax in Pakistan, establishing the charge of tax on various heads of income including salary, property, business, and capital gains. It outlines specific rules for computation, deductions, allowances, and exemptions applicable to residents and non-residents.

metadata.title: The Indecent Advertisements Prohibition Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the publication and display of indecent advertisements throughout Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'advertisement' and 'indecent', outlines penalties for contravention, and provides powers for confiscation and prosecution of offences committed by companies.

metadata.title: The Indus River System Authority Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Indus River System Authority to regulate and monitor the distribution of water sources in the Indus River system. It provides for the constitution, functions, and administrative structure of the Authority, including the appointment of members from provinces and the federal government.

name: Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968

metadata.title: The Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to amend and consolidate the law relating to industrial employment in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes rules for standing orders covering topics such as classification of workmen, wages, leave, termination, and punishments within industrial and commercial establishments.

name: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reorganization and conversion of the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan into a public limited company known as the Industrial Development Bank Limited. It establishes the legal framework for transferring all assets, contracts, liabilities, and proceedings from the existing bank to the new company while ensuring the continuation of its banking operations.

name: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1961(Repeal by ord.XXXViii of 2009,s.14(w.e.f 17-09-2007 upto 25-03-2010))

metadata.title: The Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan to replace the Pakistan Industrial Finance Corporation. It provides for making credit facilities available expeditiously to industrial concerns in Pakistan and covers related matters.

name: Industrial Relations Act, 2008 (Repealed by Act X of 2012)

metadata.title: Industrial Relations Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and rationalizes the law regarding the formation of trade unions in Pakistan. It also aims to improve relations between employers and workmen while providing mechanisms for dispute resolution.

metadata.title: Industrial Relations Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and rationalizes the law relating to the formation of trade unions and federations. It aims to improve relations between employers and workmen in the Islamabad Capital Territory and trans-provincial establishments.

name: Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2002 (Repealed by Act No IV of 2008)

metadata.title: Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends, consolidates, and rationalizes the law regarding the formation of trade unions and relations between employers and workmen. It provides for the avoidance and settlement of industrial disputes through mechanisms like conciliation, arbitration, and labour courts.

metadata.title: The Industrial Statistics Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the collection of statistics relating to various matters concerning industries and labour welfare. It establishes a statistics authority empowered to call for returns, access records, and restrict the publication of individual data without consent.

metadata.title: The Injured Persons (Medical Aid) Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the immediate medical aid and treatment of injured persons in Pakistan to save lives and protect health during emergencies. It establishes procedures to prevent delays in treatment, restricts police interference during hospitalization, and mandates that consent from relatives is not required for emergency operations.

metadata.title: The Inland Mechanically Propelled Vessels Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act regulates mechanically propelled vessels operating on inland waters in Punjab by establishing requirements for survey certificates and competency licenses for masters and engineers. It also outlines procedures for investigating casualties, protecting passengers and cargo, and prescribing penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The Insolvency Act, 1909
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for insolvency proceedings in the Punjab region, defining the powers of courts and official assignees. It outlines procedures for adjudicating debtors, managing insolvent estates, proving debts, and distributing property among creditors.

metadata.title: The Inspection Agencies (Registration and Regulation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance controls and regulates the business of pre-shipment inspection for goods exported from or imported into Pakistan. It establishes an Authority and a Council to oversee these activities, mandates the registration of inspection companies, and sets penalties for unregistered firms conducting such inspections.

name: Institute For Art and Culture Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Institute for Art and Culture Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Institute for Art and Culture in Pakistan. It defines the institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlining its powers to acquire property and define its internal authorities.

name: Institute of Management, Sciences and Technology Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Institute of Management, Sciences and Technology Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Management, Sciences and Technology as a body corporate in the private sector. It defines the institute's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and Board of Governors, and outlines its powers and functions.

name: Institute Of Science And Technology Bahawalpur Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Institute of Science and Technology Bahawalpur Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Science and Technology, Bahawalpur as a degree-awarding institution. It defines the institute's structure, including its Chancellor, Rector, Board of Governors, and Academic Council, while outlining their respective powers and functions.

metadata.title: The Institute of Space Technology Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Space Technology in Islamabad as a degree-awarding body corporate. It defines the institute's structure, including its Chancellor, Senate, Syndicate, and various authorities, while outlining powers for teaching, examinations, and staff management.

name: Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan as an autonomous body to comprehensively manage intellectual property rights. It provides for the constitution of a Policy Board, defines the powers and functions of the organization and its tribunals, and integrates various IP offices.

metadata.title: Inter-Boards Coordination Commission Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act re-constitutes and re-structures the existing Inter-Boards Committee of Chairmen as the Inter-Boards Coordination Commission (IBCC). The IBCC is established as a body corporate to coordinate examination, assessment, and evaluation matters at secondary and higher secondary levels across Pakistan. It also functions to authenticate local and foreign qualifications, regulate foreign examining bodies, and promote uniformity in academic standards.

metadata.title: The Inter-Governmental Commercial Transactions Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to facilitate commercial transactions under inter-governmental framework agreements between the Federal Government and foreign states. It empowers a designated Cabinet Committee to authorize negotiations, approve agreements, and grant regulatory exemptions to promote economic relations with foreign countries.

metadata.title: The Interest Act, 1839
metadata.summary: This Act extends provisions regarding the allowance of interest in certain cases to territories under the Government of the East India Company. It empowers courts to allow interest on debts or sums payable at a certain time, provided the rate does not exceed the current rate and specific conditions regarding written instruments or written demands are met.

name: International Court of Justice (Review and Re-consideration) Act, 2021

metadata.title: The International Court of Justice (Review and Re-consideration) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the right of review and re-consideration regarding orders and judgments of military courts involving foreign nationals. It empowers High Courts to examine petitions filed by foreign nationals or their representatives concerning convictions or sentences where consular access rights under the Vienna Convention were denied.

metadata.title: The International Development Association Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to an international agreement for the establishment and operation of the International Development Association, specifically regarding Pakistan's participation. It designates the State Bank of Pakistan as the depository for the Association's assets and grants certain provisions of the Agreement the force of law within Pakistan.

metadata.title: The International Finance Corporation Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to an international agreement for the establishment and operation of the International Finance Corporation, allowing Pakistan's participation. It defines key terms, outlines financial provisions involving the Federal Consolidated Fund, designates the State Bank as depository, and grants specific immunities and privileges to the Corporation.

name: International Institute of Science, Arts and Technology Act, 2022

metadata.title: International Institute of Science, Arts and Technology Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the International Institute of Science, Arts and Technology as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's composition, including its Patron, Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Vice-Chancellor, and outlines its powers to acquire property and sue or be sued.

metadata.title: The International Islamic University Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the existing Islamic University into an autonomous International Islamic University with its principal seat at Islamabad. It establishes the university's structure, including various authorities such as the Board of Trustees and Board of Governors, while defining the powers, functions, and academic freedoms of its officers and staff.

name: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and Bank Act , 1950

metadata.title: The International Monetary Fund and Bank Act, 1950
subjects: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development
metadata.summary: This Act implements the agreements established at the Bretton Woods Conference regarding the International Monetary Fund and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development. It empowers the Federal Government to make payments, issue obligations, and maintain accounts with the State Bank of Pakistan to fulfill its subscriptions and other financial commitments to these international bodies.

metadata.title: The Investigation for Fair Trial Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the powers of law enforcement and intelligence agencies to use modern investigative techniques such as covert surveillance and communication interception. It establishes procedures for obtaining warrants, defines the admissibility of evidence collected under these warrants, and ensures oversight to prevent arbitrary use of power.

metadata.title: The Investment Corporation of Pakistan Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Investment Corporation of Pakistan to encourage and broaden the base of investments. It provides for the corporation's establishment, share capital, governance structure including the Board and Managing Director, and its powers regarding borrowing and business transactions.

metadata.title: The Iqbal Academy Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Iqbal Academy Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Iqbal Academy Act, 1951 with modifications to improve administrative efficiency. It establishes the Iqbal Academy as a body corporate with defined aims, including promoting the study of Iqbal's works, awarding scholarships, and publishing related materials.

metadata.title: The Islamabad (Preservation of Landscape) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the preservation of landscape within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines prohibited acts such as removing or damaging natural features, establishes penalties including imprisonment and fines, and grants specific powers to Authority officers and police for enforcement.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory (Prohibition of Plastic Book Covers) Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Prohibition of Plastic Book Covers) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: All other laws, rules, and regulations inconsistent with this Act
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the sale, distribution, or offering for sale of books encased in single-use plastic covers within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It provides specific exemptions for biodegradable materials, reusable covers, archival preservation needs, and integral book components, while establishing penalties for violations.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the better regulation of the purchase and sale of agricultural products within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes markets and market committees to oversee these activities, defines key terms such as 'agricultural produce' and 'dealer', and outlines the powers and duties of the relevant authorities.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Charities Registration, regulation and Facilitation Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Charities Registration, Regulation and Facilitation Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the registration, regulation, and facilitation of charities within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a Charities Registration Authority to oversee these entities and defines their functions, conditions for registration, and procedures for de-registration.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Child Marriage Restraint Act, 2025

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Child Marriage Restraint Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act aims to restrain the solemnization of child marriages within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes specific punishments for adults marrying children, parents facilitating such unions, and acts of child abuse or trafficking related to marriage.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Child Protection Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Child Protection Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection and care of children in the Islamabad Capital Territory from physical or mental violence, injury, neglect, maltreatment, exploitation, and abuse. It establishes a Child Protection Advisory Board and institutions to assess children's needs, create care plans, and ensure their safety and rehabilitation.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Domestic Workers Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Domestic Workers Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the employment of domestic workers within the Islamabad Capital Territory to safeguard their safety and rights. It establishes provisions for minimum wages, leave, medical care, accommodation, and penalties for exploitation or violation of child labour laws.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Food Safety Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Food Safety Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad Food Authority to regulate food safety and standards within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines key terms related to food, outlines the powers of the authority and its officers, and prescribes penalties for selling adulterated, substandard, or unsafe food.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.amends: Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Act, 2015 to replace references to 'Metropolitan Corporation' with 'Town Corporation'. It substitutes several definitions and sections regarding local areas, union councils, and election delimitation procedures.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Act, 2015
