metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes and reorganizes the local government system within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes an elected local government framework to devolve political, administrative, and financial responsibilities while promoting good governance and transparent decision-making.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Private Education Institution (Registration and Regulation) Act, 2013

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions (Registration and Regulation) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and regulation of privately managed educational institutions within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a regulatory authority to ensure uniform policies, academic standards, and proper discipline among these institutions.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition of Corporal Punishment Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition of Corporal Punishment Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits all forms of corporal punishment against children in workplaces, educational institutions, care settings, and the juvenile justice system within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes that children have a right to respect for their personality and individuality, forbidding any humiliating or degrading treatment.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition of Interest of Private Loans Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition of Interest on Private Loans Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the business and practices of private money-lending and advancing loans based on interest within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines key terms such as 'money lender' and 'interest', establishes penalties for contravention including imprisonment and fines, and provides mechanisms for complaints and recovery of sums.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Senior Citizens Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Senior Citizens Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Senior Citizens Council to oversee the well-being, comfort, and dignity of elderly residents in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines key terms such as 'Senior Citizen' (60 years or older) and creates a fund for social security packages and grants.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Shops, Business and Industrial Establishments (Security) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Shops, Business and Industrial Establishments (Security) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the security of shops, business, and industrial establishments within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It empowers the Government to issue orders regulating security measures for property and persons and establishes penalties for contravention.

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Trust Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to trusts within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes provisions for the registration, administration, and monitoring of trusts, addressing gaps in the previous Trust Act, 1882.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Waqf Properties Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Waqf Properties Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the proper management, supervision, and administration of waqf properties within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes the appointment of administrators, outlines procedures for property registration and sale, and defines offenses related to waqf management.

metadata.title: The Islamabad Club (Administration) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper administration of the affairs of the Islamabad Club. It establishes an Administrator appointed by the Federal Government and a Managing Committee to oversee the club's operations following its dissolution under this law.

metadata.title: Islamabad Consumers Protection Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion and protection of consumer interests within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a Council and an Authority to handle complaints regarding unfair trade practices, false advertisements, and other issues affecting consumers.

name: Islamabad Healthcare Regulation Act, 2018 (Act No_ XXIII of 2018)

metadata.title: The Islamabad Healthcare Regulation Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad Healthcare Regulatory Authority to provide a regulatory framework for healthcare services in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines the powers and functions of the Authority, including setting standards, licensing establishments, conducting inspections, and imposing penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Islamabad High Court Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad High Court for the Islamabad Capital Territory in pursuance of Article 175 of the Constitution. It defines the court's composition, jurisdiction, and powers while adapting existing laws regarding practice, procedure, and subordinate judiciary to apply mutatis mutandis.

name: Islamabad Nature Conservation and Wildlife Management Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Islamabad Nature Conservation and Wildlife Management Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of nature within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a Board to oversee these functions and defines various terms related to animals, plants, and protected areas.

name: Islamabad Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2020.

metadata.title: The Islamabad Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Real Estate Regulatory Authority to regulate and promote the real estate sector in Islamabad. It aims to protect the interests of buyers by ensuring transparency in sales and purchases, while also defining the functions, duties, and powers of developers, agents, and allottees.

name: Islamabad Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Islamabad Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the business of real estate agents and motor vehicles dealers within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes requirements for registration, defines prohibited persons, sets procedures for obtaining certificates, and outlines penalties for operating without a valid registration.

metadata.title: The Islamabad Rent Restriction Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the relations between landlords and tenants of rented premises in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a framework for fixing initial rents, determining fair rent increases, and defining procedures for eviction and dispute resolution.

name: Islamabad Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Islamabad Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal to handle matters regarding the terms and conditions of service for members of the subordinate judiciary in the Islamabad Capital Territory. The Tribunal has exclusive jurisdiction over disciplinary issues and appeals against departmental orders, functioning as a civil court with specific powers to enforce attendance and examine witnesses.

name: Islamabad Transfusion of Safe Blood Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Islamabad Transfusion of Safe Blood Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the transfusion of safe and healthy blood and blood products free from viruses in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes the Islamabad Blood Transfusion Authority to register blood banks, issue licenses, and ensure adherence to national safety standards.

name: Islamabad University of Health Sciences and Emerging Technologies, Islamabad Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Islamabad University of Health Sciences and Emerging Technologies, Islamabad Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad University of Health Sciences and Emerging Technologies (IUHT) in Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, officers, and governing authorities.

name: Islamabad Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Ordinance, 1979 (Repealed by Act no. XVI of 2024 section 41 (w.e.f 27-08-2024))

metadata.title: The Islamabad Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of wildlife within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a Wildlife Management Board and sets up a National Park while prohibiting the killing or capturing of wild animals except under specific conditions.

name: Islambad Capital Territory Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2002. It substitutes a requirement for candidates to be graduates and changes an election year from 2004 to 2005.

metadata.title: The Islamic Development Bank Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance implements the international agreement for the establishment and operation of the Islamic Development Bank. It provides for Pakistan's obligations as a member, designates the State Bank of Pakistan as the depository, and grants specific immunities and privileges to the Bank under the Agreement.

name: Jammu and Kashmir (Administration of property) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Jammu and Kashmir (Administration of Property) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance vests certain immovable properties in the Federal Government that previously belonged to the State of Jammu and Kashmir. It provides for the management, sale, lease, or disposal of these properties and establishes an Administrator to oversee them.

metadata.title: The Judicial Officers' Protection Act, 1850
metadata.summary: This Act provides protection to Magistrates, Judges, and other persons acting judicially from being sued in civil courts for acts done in the discharge of their duties. It specifically grants immunity when such acts are performed in good faith and within the limits of jurisdiction, or when executing lawful warrants.

metadata.title: The Jute (Repeal) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.repeals: The Jute Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the President of Pakistan on December 22, 1983. Its sole purpose is to repeal the Jute Ordinance, 1962, which it does immediately upon coming into force.

metadata.title: The Juvenile Justice System Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a criminal justice system and social reintegration framework specifically for juveniles in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'juvenile', 'heinous offence', and 'diversion', while mandating legal assistance for children involved in cases.

name: Kalam Bibi International Women Institute Bannu Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Kalam Bibi International Women Institute Bannu Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Kalam Bibi International Women Institute Bannu in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It upgrades the existing Women Campus of the University of Bannu into a full-fledged institute and outlines its structure, officers, authorities, and governing rules.

name: Karachi Electric Supply Corporation (Removal from Service) Ordinance, 1999

metadata.title: The Karachi Electric Supply Corporation (Removal from Service) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the removal of persons from the service of the Karachi Electric Supply Corporation. It empowers the Corporation to retire or remove employees without assigning reasons or after providing an opportunity to show cause, and mandates additional pay for those retired under this provision.

metadata.title: The Karachi Electricity Control Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: The Sind Electricity Control Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the production, distribution, use, and consumption of electrical energy in the Karachi Division. It allows the Provincial Government to issue orders regulating these activities, including setting rates and levying surcharges, while also defining penalties for contravention and protecting actions taken in good faith under the Act.

name: Karachi Essential Articles (Price Control and Antl-Hoarding) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Karachi Essential Articles (Price Control and Anti-Hoarding) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the possession, distribution, sale, and prices of certain essential articles in the Karachi Division. It empowers the Commissioner to fix maximum prices, require price marking, control stock quantities, and issue trading licenses.

metadata.title: The Karachi Hotels and Lodging-houses (Control) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides special measures for controlling rates chargeable in hotels and lodging-houses located in Karachi. It also establishes provisions for the reservation of accommodation and addresses various ancillary matters related to these establishments.

metadata.title: The Karachi Port Security Force Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution, regulation, and maintenance of the Karachi Port Security Force. It outlines the force's powers and functions, including maintaining law and order, preventing loss to port property, and investigating offences within the port area.

metadata.title: The Karachi Port Trust Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Karachi Port Trust and defines the constitution, powers, and duties of its Board of Trustees. It outlines regulations regarding property management, tolls, wharf construction, and financial liabilities associated with port operations.

metadata.title: The Karachi Rent Restriction Act, 1953
metadata.repeals: The Karachi Rent Restriction Act, 1953 (in its application to areas other than Cantonment areas by the West Pakistan Ordinance No. 38 of 1962)
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions regarding residential and non-residential accommodation in the Karachi Division, specifically focusing on controlling rents and preventing eviction. It establishes the role of a Controller to fix fair rents based on historical rates or construction costs and outlines restrictions on rent increases and tenant evictions.

metadata.title: The Kazis Act, 1880
metadata.repeals: Repealed to the extent of Islamabad Capital Territory by Ordinance No. 27 of 1981
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government to appoint persons to the office of Kazi in local areas where Muslims desire such appointments. It clarifies that these appointments do not confer judicial or administrative powers and does not make the presence of a Kazi mandatory for marriage ceremonies.

name: King Hamad University of Nursing and Associated Medical Sciences Act, 2025

metadata.title: The King Hamad University of Nursing and Associated Medical Sciences Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the King Hamad University of Nursing and Associated Medical Sciences with its principal seat in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It provides for the university's establishment, incorporation, purposes, functions, powers, and the constitution of its various authorities including the Senate and Syndicate.

metadata.title: The Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority as a body corporate to manage the planning, construction, operation, and maintenance of the Korangi Fisheries Harbour within Port Qasim. It defines the Authority's powers, duties, financial structure, and the composition of its Board while subjecting its acts to Federal Government control.

metadata.title: The Lac Cess Act, 1930
metadata.repeals: The Repealing Act 1938 (I of 1938)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of a cess on lac and refuse lac exported from Pakistan. It establishes specific rates for the cess and grants the Federal Government powers to make rules and prescribe other rates via notification.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Mines) Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions for cases where mines or minerals are situated under land that is desired to be acquired. It outlines procedures for declaring mines as not needed, giving notice before working such mines, and determining compensation for injuries done to mines or mineral rights.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the acquisition of land needed for public purposes and for companies. It also provides for determining the amount of compensation to be paid in such cases.

metadata.title: The Land Control (Karachi Division) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of unauthorised occupation of lands and unauthorised building in the Karachi Division. It also establishes provisions for the eviction of persons from such lands and buildings.

metadata.title: The Land Improvement Loans Act, 1883
metadata.amends: The Land Improvement Act, 1871; Act XXI of 1876
metadata.repeals: The Land Improvement Act, 1871; Act XXI of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding government loans for agricultural improvements. It defines eligible purposes for loans, such as constructing wells, preparing land for irrigation, and reclaiming waste-land.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for further land reforms to ensure a more equitable distribution of wealth in Pakistan. It establishes restrictions on individual land ownership and possession, outlines procedures for obtaining declarations and vesting excess land in the government, and details compensation mechanisms for surrendered lands.

name: Land Reforms Regulation (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Regulation (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain orders passed by the Chairman or a Member of the Federal Land Commission before its commencement. It deems these orders to have been validly passed and effective under the authority conferred by an order of the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Lansdowne Bridge Act, 1892
metadata.repeals: Act of the Governor General in Council for enabling Government to levy tolls on public roads and bridges
metadata.summary: This Act removes doubts regarding the authority to levy and collect tolls on the Lansdowne Bridge over the Indus at Sukkur. It validates past toll collections and applies the provisions of the repealed Tolls Act, 1851 to this specific bridge.

name: Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan to systematically develop and reform the laws of the country. The Commission is tasked with studying statutes, recommending improvements for modernization, simplifying procedures for speedy justice, and addressing issues related to legal education and human rights.

metadata.title: The Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan to systematically develop and reform laws. It defines the commission's composition, functions, and powers regarding the study, modernization, and codification of statutes.

metadata.title: The Law Reforms Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898; Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends certain laws to implement recommendations from the Law Reforms Commission. It establishes new appeal mechanisms to High Courts and modifies the computation of limitation periods for specific appeals.

metadata.title: The Law Reports Act, 1875
metadata.repeals: Act II of 1875
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the publication and authority of law reports in Pakistan, ensuring that only authorized reports are treated as binding authorities. It mandates specific certifications by courts regarding the legal principles enunciated in judgments and restricts the printing of unapproved court orders.

metadata.title: The Laws Local Extent Act, 1874
metadata.repeals: Repealing Act, 1876 (XII of 1876)
metadata.summary: This Act declares the local extent of certain enactments passed by the Governor General of India in Council and other legislative bodies. It specifies that Acts listed in the First Schedule are in force throughout Pakistan, excluding Scheduled Districts, while omitting provisions related to specific presidencies.

metadata.title: The Lawyers Welfare and Protection Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to provide welfare and protection for advocates in Pakistan. It defines specific acts of violence against advocates, outlines punishments including imprisonment and fines, and sets up special courts for the expeditious trial of such offences.

name: Legal Aid and Justice Authority Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Legal Aid and Justice Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Legal Aid and Justice Authority to provide legal, financial, and other assistance for access to justice in criminal cases. It applies to the whole of Pakistan and outlines the authority's management, composition, functions, and powers regarding legal aid panels and funds.

metadata.title: The Legal Practitioners (Fees) Act, 1926
metadata.repeals: The Legal Practitioners (Fees) Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act defines the rights of legal practitioners to sue for their fees and their liabilities regarding negligence in professional duties. It establishes that practitioners can settle engagement terms privately but retains the right to sue for unpaid fees or those computed under existing laws.

name: Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: law relating to legal practitioners and bar councils
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the law relating to legal practitioners and bar councils with certain modifications. It establishes the constitution, functions, and rules for Provincial Bar Councils, the Islamabad Bar Council, and the Pakistan Bar Council.

metadata.title: The Legal Representatives' Suits Act, 1855
metadata.summary: This Act enables executors, administrators, or representatives to sue and be sued for wrongs committed during the lifetime of a deceased person. It ensures that legal actions do not abate due to the death of either party involved in the suit.

metadata.title: The Legal Tender (Inscribed Notes) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides that certain bank notes bearing political, religious, or commercial inscriptions shall cease to be legal tender. It specifies that the State Bank of Pakistan will not be obligated to receive, exchange, or refund the value of such notes after a date specified by the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Lepers Act, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the segregation and medical treatment of pauper lepers. It also establishes controls over lepers following certain callings and outlines procedures for their arrest, detention, and management in designated asylums.

name: Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an efficacious and speedy mechanism for the issuance of Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates to legal heirs. It creates a Succession Facilitation Unit within the National Database and Registration Authority to process applications, manage objections, and maintain records while aiming to curb fraud and forgery.

metadata.title: The Life Insurance (Nationalisation) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the nationalisation of life insurance business in Pakistan by vesting its management in the Federal Government. It establishes a Life Insurance Corporation to transact such business and outlines the transfer of assets, liabilities, and employees from existing insurers to this new Corporation.

metadata.title: The Light House Act, 1927
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the provision, maintenance, and control of lighthouses by the Government in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for the appointment of officers, management of general and local lighthouses, the levy and collection of light dues, and the recovery of expenses.

metadata.title: The Limitation (Emergency and War Conditions) Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act extends the period of limitation for suits, appeals, applications, and other proceedings during times of war or armed hostilities. It specifically addresses cases where persons are displaced from affected areas or detained in enemy territory, allowing legal actions to be taken within six months after such conditions cease.

metadata.title: The Limitation Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the limitation of suits, appeals, and certain applications to Courts. It also provides rules for acquiring ownership of easements and other property by possession.

metadata.title: The Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the incorporation, regulation, and winding up of limited liability partnerships as body corporates in Pakistan. It also covers matters connected with or incidental to these entities.

name: Listed Companies (Substantial Acquisition of Voting Shares and Takes-Overs) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Listed Companies (Substantial Acquisition of Voting Shares and Takeovers) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal framework to ensure fair and equal treatment for investors in Pakistan. It provides a transparent system for the substantial acquisition of voting shares and takeovers of listed companies, including provisions for public announcements and competitive bids.

metadata.title: The Literacy Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance aims to encourage literacy in Pakistan by restricting the issuance of certain licenses and passports, as well as federal government employment, to literate persons only. It defines a 'literate person' as someone certified to read a newspaper and write a simple letter, while providing savings for physically or mentally handicapped individuals.

name: Loans for Agricultural, Commercial and Industrial Purposes Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Loans for Agricultural, Commercial and Industrial Purposes Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for credit facilities for persons engaged in agriculture, commerce, and industry. It establishes the legal framework for banks to grant loans secured by land using a specific 'pass book' as title documentation.

metadata.title: The Local Authorities Loans Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the grant of loans to local authorities in Pakistan. It defines borrowing powers, specifies permissible purposes for loans such as relief works and epidemic prevention, and outlines the government's authority to make rules regarding these financial matters.

name: Local Authorities Pensions and Gratuities Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Local Authorities Pensions and Gratuities Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act extends the powers of local authorities to grant pensions and gratuities to officers who were wounded or incapacitated in state service since August 4, 1914. It also provides for granting benefits to the widows or children of such officers who died due to injuries or illness contracted during that period.

metadata.title: The Maintenance Orders Enforcement Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the enforcement of maintenance orders made in other countries within Pakistan and vice versa. It establishes procedures for registering foreign orders, transmitting domestic orders to reciprocating territories, and allows summary courts to make provisional maintenance orders against residents of reciprocating territories.

metadata.title: The Majority Act, 1875
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the age of majority for persons domiciled in Pakistan. It establishes that minors with appointed guardians or under Court of Wards jurisdiction attain majority at twenty-one years, while others attain it at eighteen years.

metadata.title: The Malaria Eradication Board (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Malaria Eradication Board Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Malaria Eradication Board Ordinance, 1961. It provides for the transfer of officers and employees to the Federal Government and assigns all rights, properties, assets, debts, and liabilities of the Board to the Federal Government upon repeal.

name: Managed Cement Establishments (Payment to Corporation) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Managed Cement Establishments (Payment to Corporation) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance mandates managed cement establishments to pay specific amounts to the State Cement Corporation of Pakistan for each metric ton of cement produced and sold after March 24, 1976. It establishes a Cement Development Fund to receive these proceeds and allows for tax allowances on these payments while granting the Federal Government power to make rules regarding payment methods and fund administration.

name: Manoeuvres, Field Firing and Artillery Practice Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Manoeuvres, Field Firing and Artillery Practice Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act provides facilities for military manoeuvres and field firing and artillery practice. It outlines the powers of the Federal Government to authorize these activities, procedures for assessing compensation for damage, and duties regarding the restoration of land.

metadata.title: The Marine Insurance Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the business of marine insurance and matters connected therewith. It defines key terms such as marine adventure, maritime perils, and policy, while establishing rules regarding insurable interest, disclosure, warranties, and the measurement of indemnity.

metadata.title: The Maritime Security Agency Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and regulation of the Pakistan Maritime Security Agency. It establishes the agency's structure, defines key terms related to maritime interests and zones, and outlines powers regarding staff appointments, command, and law enforcement functions.

name: Marketing Of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.repeals: Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Act, 1974 and rescinds a specific order regarding Pakistan State Oil Company Limited. It facilitates the transfer of Federal Government shares in PSO to private sector investors as part of the deregulation and privatisation of the downstream oil sector.

name: Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits ostentatious displays and wasteful expenses during marriage ceremonies in Pakistan. It restricts the use of lights, fireworks, and explosives for celebrations and limits meals served at venues to one dish plus soft drinks.

metadata.title: The Marriages Validation Act, 1892
metadata.repeals: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1914 (10 of 1914)
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain irregular marriages solemnized under Part VI of the Christian Marriage Act, 1872, between persons where only one is a Native Christian. It declares these marriages valid in law as if both parties were Native Christians and ensures their records are accepted as proper evidence.

metadata.title: The Married Women's Property Act, 1874
metadata.repeals: Repealed by the Repealing Act, 1876 (XII of 1876)
metadata.summary: This Act explains and amends the law relating to certain married women, specifically regarding their wages, earnings, and insurance policies. It declares that property acquired by a married woman through her own employment or skill is her separate property and protects insurance benefits intended for wives from the husband's control.

metadata.title: The Martial Law Regulation No. 60 (Repeal) Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation No. 60
metadata.summary: This Act repeals Martial Law Regulation No. 60, which pertained to educational institutions in the Islamabad Capital Territory. The legislation came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Maternity and Paternity Leave Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for maternity and paternity leave facilities for employees of public and private establishments under the administrative control of the Federal Government. It specifies the duration of leave on full pay for female and male employees based on birth order and establishes penalties for contravention of its provisions.

metadata.title: The Measures of Length Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act declares the imperial standard yard for the United Kingdom to be the legal standard measure of length in Pakistan. It defines the standard foot and inch, establishes presumptions regarding certified measures, and outlines provisions for their inspection and custody by authorities.

metadata.title: The Medical and Dental Degrees Ordinance, 1982
metadata.repeals: The Medical Degrees Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Medical Degrees Act, 1916 with certain modifications. It establishes the exclusive right of specific authorities to confer medical and dental degrees in Pakistan and prohibits unauthorised conferment or use of such titles.

metadata.title: The Medical Colleges (Governing Bodies) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of Governing Bodies to manage and administer Medical Colleges in Pakistan. It outlines the composition of these bodies, including members appointed by the Provincial Government and representatives from institutions, as well as the powers and functions of the Governing Bodies.

metadata.title: The Medical Officers (Regularization of Appointments) Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of appointments of certain medical officers who were appointed on an adhoc basis prior to October 12, 1988. It establishes that eligible officers holding office at the commencement of the Act shall be deemed to have been appointed on a regular basis in the Federal Government cadre, subject to verification of character and qualifications.

metadata.title: The Medical Qualifications (Information) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the furnishing of specific information by persons qualified in certain branches of medicine residing in Pakistan. It mandates that these individuals submit details to the Director-General within one month of the Ordinance's promulgation or their qualification, under penalty of imprisonment or fine for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Medical Tribunal Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a special judicial tribunal to efficiently and expeditiously hear and decide disputes arising in the medical and health sectors of Pakistan. It defines the composition, tenure, and powers of the Medical Tribunal, including its jurisdiction over offences under various existing medical laws and appeals against decisions by relevant apex authorities.

name: Members of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) Immunities and Privileges Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Members of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) Immunities and Privileges Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the immunities and privileges for members of the Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) of Pakistan. It provides specific safeguards against arrest, regulates the registration of cases against members, and mandates procedures for their release or production in custody.

name: Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: law relating to salaries and allowances of members of Parliament
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the salaries and allowances of members of Parliament in Pakistan. It also provides for specific privileges belonging to the Leaders of the House and the Leaders of the Opposition in both Houses of Parliament.

name: Members of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Exemption of Advisers from Disqualification) Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Members of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Exemption of Advisers from Disqualification) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act declares that holders of the office of Adviser to the Governor are not disqualified from being elected or chosen as members of Parliament or a Provincial Assembly. The exemption applies during specific periods when the Federal Government has assumed functions of a Province or when a Proclamation under Article 234 is in force.

name: Members of the Election Commission (Salary, Allowances, Perks and Privileges) Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Members of the Election Commission (Salary, Allowances, Perks and Privileges) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salary, allowances, perks, and privileges of the members of the Election Commission of Pakistan. It stipulates that these benefits shall be equivalent to those admissible to a Judge of a High Court.

name: Members Of The National Assembly (Exemption From Preventive Detention And Personal Appearance) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The Members of the National Assembly (Exemption from Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides specific privileges for Members of the National Assembly of Pakistan regarding exemption from preventive detention and personal appearance in courts. It grants immunity during assembly sessions and for fourteen days before and after a session, except in cases involving reasons of State.

metadata.title: The Mental Health Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the care, treatment, and management of property for mentally disordered persons in Pakistan. It establishes a Federal Mental Health Authority, outlines procedures for admission and discharge, and provides provisions for guardianship and human rights protection.

metadata.title: The Merchandise Marks Act, 1889
metadata.amends: Law relating to Fraudulent Marks on Merchandise
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to fraudulent marks on merchandise and defines terms such as trade mark, trade description, and false trade description. It establishes provisions regarding the application of false descriptions, penalties for their use, and regulations concerning the stamping of length for piece-goods manufactured in Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Mesne Profits and Improvements Act, 1855
metadata.summary: This Act limits the liability for mesne profits and secures value to bona fide holders under defective titles who make improvements. It stipulates that persons holding property in good faith are not chargeable with rents or profits if they paid them to a holder under a defective title, even if the original holder had no right. Additionally, it provides compensation or purchase options for individuals who erect buildings or make improvements on lands held under such belief before being evicted by someone with a better title.

metadata.title: The Metal Tokens Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits private persons from making or possessing pieces of metal intended for use as money. It also amends section 28 of the Indian Penal Code and extends to the whole of Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Microfinance Institutions Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the establishment, business, and operations of microfinance institutions in Pakistan. It aims to promote these institutions for providing financial support to poor persons while protecting depositors and safeguarding institutions from outside interference.

name: Military College of Engineering, Risalpur (Degree) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Military College of Engineering, Risalpur (Degree) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance grants a charter to the Military College of Engineering, Risalpur, enabling it to award the Bachelor of Civil Engineering degree. It establishes the college's constitution, defining the roles of the Controlling Authority, Commandant, and Academic Board, while outlining their respective powers and duties regarding instruction, examinations, and student welfare.

metadata.title: The Mines Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the law relating to the regulation and inspection of mines in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for mine inspectors, mining boards, health and safety standards, employment limitations, and penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Mines Maternity Benefit Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the employment of women in mines during specific periods before and after childbirth. It also provides for the payment of maternity benefits to these women.

name: Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969.

metadata.title: The Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes minimum wage rates for unskilled workers employed in specific commercial and industrial establishments within Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'wages', 'employer', and 'unskilled worker' while outlining exemptions for government services, defense, and public utilities.

metadata.title: The Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of minimum rates of wages for workers employed in certain industrial undertakings. It establishes Minimum Wages Boards and a Council to recommend and declare these rates, while defining key terms such as 'worker', 'employer', and 'wages'.

name: Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration of modaraba companies and regulates their floatation, management, and operation. It establishes eligibility criteria for registration, defines key terms such as 'modaraba' and 'modaraba company', and sets out provisions for the appointment of a Registrar and the constitution of a Tribunal.

metadata.title: The Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the censorship of films and the regulation of their exhibition by means of cinematographs. It establishes a Board to examine and certify films for public exhibition, outlining the powers of the Federal Government and the procedures for certification, suspension, or refusal.

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles Act, 1939
metadata.repeals: Chapters I to VI (in its application to the Province of West Pakistan by the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to motor vehicles in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for insurance against third-party risks, regulations for vehicles temporarily leaving or visiting the country, and outlines offences and penalties related to uninsured vehicles.

metadata.title: The Multi-unit Co-operative Societies Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the incorporation, regulation, and winding up of co-operative societies whose objects are not confined to a single province. It applies to societies incorporated before or after the commencement of this Act under previous provincial laws.

metadata.title: The Municipal Taxation Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Federal and Provincial Governments to prohibit the levy of municipal taxes on specific persons, such as military, naval, or air-force personnel and the governments themselves. It further stipulates that when such prohibitions are in force, the respective governments become liable to pay the municipal committees amounts equivalent to the taxes that would otherwise have been levied.

metadata.title: The Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to recommendations of the Commission on Marriage and Family Laws. It establishes rules for Muslim marriages, succession rights for widows and children, and provisions regarding polygamy and maintenance.

metadata.title: The Mussalman Wakf Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better management of wakf property and ensures the keeping and publication of proper accounts regarding such properties. It establishes obligations for mutwallis to furnish specific particulars about wakf assets, income, and expenses to the Court within six months of the Act's commencement.

metadata.title: The Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act declares the rights of Muslims to create wakfs (endowments) in favor of their families, children, and descendants. It removes doubts regarding the validity of such wakfs even if the ultimate benefit is reserved for the poor or other charitable purposes after the extinction of the family line.

metadata.title: The Mutual Legal Assistance (Criminal Matters) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework for mutual legal assistance in criminal matters between Pakistan and foreign countries. It defines key terms such as central authority, information systems, and proceeds of crime to facilitate international cooperation in investigations, prosecutions, and asset recovery.

metadata.title: The My University Islamabad Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes MY University Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and various authorities like the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The National Accountability Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Accountability Bureau to eradicate corruption and hold accountable persons accused of corrupt practices. It provides for the detection, investigation, prosecution, and speedy disposal of cases involving corruption, misuse of power, and misappropriation of property.

name: National Agri-trade and Food Safety Authority Act, 2026

metadata.title: The National Agri-trade and Food Safety Authority Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Agri-trade and Food Safety Authority (NAFSA) to regulate quality aspects of agrochemicals, agricultural produce, plants, animals, and related products. It aims to facilitate international and inter-provincial trade in compliance with recognized sanitary and phytosanitary measures while addressing domestic needs.

name: National and Provincial Assemblies (Elections to Reserved Seats) Act, 1976

metadata.title: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Elections to Reserved Seats) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conduct of elections to reserved seats in the National and Provincial Assemblies. It also establishes procedures for handling election disputes, defining corrupt practices, and setting disqualifications for candidates.

name: National Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Authority Act, 2023

metadata.title: The National Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Authority in Pakistan as a body corporate. The Authority is designed to unify state response, coordinate international collaboration, and implement policies regarding anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing.

metadata.title: The National Archives Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the custody and preservation of public records of Pakistan and archival materials of historical and national significance. It establishes the National Archives, an Advisory Board, and outlines the management duties of the Director General regarding the storage, conservation, and reproduction of these records.

metadata.title: The National Assembly Secretariat Employees Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the recruitment and conditions of service for persons appointed in the National Assembly Secretariat. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'Secretariat', and 'pay', and establishes the structure and strength limits of the Secretariat.

metadata.title: The National Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes the National Bank of Pakistan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It establishes the bank's share capital, defines the qualifications for directors and members, and outlines the business activities authorized for the institution.

metadata.title: The National Book Foundation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Book Foundation to make books available at moderate prices. It defines the Foundation's constitution, functions, and powers regarding book production, distribution, and promotion.

name: National College of Arts Institute Act, 2021

metadata.title: The National College of Arts Institute Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes the National College of Arts in Lahore, which was previously established under an Ordinance from 1985. It establishes the college as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its structure, including the Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various academic authorities.

metadata.title: The National College of Arts Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers upon the National College of Arts, Lahore, the power to award degrees and provides for related matters. It establishes the College as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its purpose, powers, functions, and governance structure.

metadata.title: The National Command Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Command Authority to provide complete command and control over research, development, production, and use of nuclear and space technologies. It defines the composition of the Authority, including the Prime Minister as Chairman and various Ministers and military chiefs as members, and outlines its powers to supervise strategic organizations.

name: National Commission For Human Development Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The National Commission for Human Development Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Commission for Human Development as an autonomous body under the Cabinet Division to implement social sector programmes. Its primary objective is to promote human development by supporting government departments, NGOs, and elected officials in areas such as literacy, income generation, and basic health care.

name: National Commission for Human Rights Act, 2012

metadata.title: The National Commission for Human Rights Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Commission for Human Rights to promote and protect human rights in Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Commission, including a Chairperson and members from provinces and minority communities, and outlines their appointment procedures. The legislation also grants the Commission powers to conduct inquiries, investigations, and establish human rights courts.

name: National Commission for Minorities Rights Act, 2025

metadata.title: The National Commission for Minorities Rights Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Commission for Minorities Rights to safeguard and promote the social, economic, political, and legal rights of minorities in Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Commission, including a Chairperson and members nominated by Provincial Governments, and outlines its functions, powers, and administrative autonomy.

name: National Commission on the Rights of Child Act, 2017

metadata.title: The National Commission on the Rights of Child Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Commission on the Rights of Child to exercise powers and perform functions related to child rights in accordance with international obligations. It outlines the constitution, appointment, term of office, and disqualification criteria for the Chairperson and members of the Commission.

name: National Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2012

metadata.title: National Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Commission on the Status of Women (NCSW) to promote the social, economic, political, and legal rights of women in Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Commission, including a Chairperson, members from provinces and territories, ex-officio representatives, and outlines the appointment process involving the Prime Minister and Parliamentary Committee.

metadata.title: The National Counter Terrorism Authority Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Counter Terrorism Authority in Pakistan to address the existential threat of terrorism and extremism. The Authority is empowered to coordinate state responses, formulate strategies, collect intelligence, and liaise with international entities to counter these threats.

name: National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance (NADRA), 2000

metadata.title: The National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Database and Registration Authority to facilitate the registration of all persons in Pakistan. It provides for the creation of multipurpose databases, data warehouses, and networking facilities to improve state affairs and public services.

metadata.title: The National Defence University Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Defence University at Islamabad to provide higher education in national defence and security fields. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Senate, Syndicate, and various authorities, while outlining its powers, functions, and governance mechanisms.

metadata.title: The National Development Volunteer Programme (Repeal) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.repeals: The National Development Volunteer Programme Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President to immediately repeal the National Development Volunteer Programme Act, 1973. It is deemed to have taken effect from June 1, 1980.

metadata.title: The National Disaster Management Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive National Disaster Management System for Pakistan, creating structures at the national, provincial, and district levels. It defines key terms such as 'disaster' and outlines the powers, functions, and responsibilities of various authorities including the National Commission and Provincial Authorities.

metadata.title: National Education Foundation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Education Foundation as a body corporate to promote quality and gender-sensitive education in Federal Administered Areas. The Foundation aims to act as a catalyst for education by mobilizing resources through public-private partnerships, specifically targeting disadvantaged groups including minorities, children below the poverty line, and those in remote rural areas.

name: National Energy Efficiency and Conservation Act, 2016

metadata.title: The National Energy Efficiency and Conservation Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes institutions and mechanisms to ensure the effective conservation and efficient use of energy in Pakistan. It defines key terms related to energy sectors, audits, and authorities while outlining the powers of the Federal and Provincial Governments to enforce these measures.

metadata.title: The National Excellence Institute Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Excellence Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's composition, including its Patron, Chancellor, Board of Governors, and staff, while granting it the power to acquire property and manage its own funds.

metadata.title: The National Forensics Agency Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Forensics Agency as an independent body corporate with financial and administrative autonomy. The Agency is empowered to examine forensic materials, render opinions to courts and tribunals, and assist in civil, criminal, corporate, and public matters under investigation by Federal or Provincial authorities.

name: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Act, 1994

metadata.title: The National Fund for Cultural Heritage Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The National Fund for Cultural Heritage Ordinance, 1994 (V of 1994)
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Fund for Cultural Heritage to promote the conservation and preservation of Pakistan's national heritage. It outlines the fund's purposes, sources of financing, the composition of its Board of Governors, and provisions for tax exemptions on contributions.

metadata.title: The National Guards Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and discipline of the National Guards in Pakistan. It establishes two main forces, the Mujahid Force and the Janbaz Force, and outlines their organization, personnel rules, and application across the country.

metadata.title: The National Highway Authority Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Highway Authority to plan, develop, operate, and maintain national highways and strategic roads in Pakistan. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to acquire property and manage its funds, while also outlining the composition of the Council and Executive Board.

metadata.title: The National Highways Safety Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for safe driving on national highways and addresses related matters. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan under emergency powers due to the suspension of the National Assembly and Senate.

metadata.title: The National Information Technology Board Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Information Technology Board (NITB) to facilitate e-governance across Pakistan. The Board is designed to provide effective and efficient advisory services, consultancies, and software applications to Federal Ministries and Divisions. It aims to focus on cross-cutting e-governance initiatives that can be replicated across multiple public organizations to improve government-to-government and government-to-citizen services.

name: National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (Administration) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (Administration) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper administration of the National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases in Karachi. It incorporates the Institute as a body corporate, vests its powers in a Governing Body, and outlines its functions including treatment, research, and training.

metadata.title: The National Institute of Electronics Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Institute of Electronics as a body corporate with headquarters in Islamabad. It outlines the institute's functions, which include design and development work in electronics, advanced training, and coordination with other research centers.

name: National Institute of Folk and Traditional Heritage (Lok Virsa), Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The National Institute of Folk and Traditional Heritage (Lok Virsa) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: National Institute of Folk and Traditional Heritage (Lok Virsa)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reconstitution of the National Institute of Folk and Traditional Heritage (Lok Virsa) to effectively preserve indigenous cultural heritage. It establishes the Institute as a body corporate with powers to acquire property, conduct research, and promote the true identity of Pakistan through various cultural initiatives.

name: National Institute of Health (NIH) Ordinance, 1980 (Repealed by ACT No. XIII OF 2021 section 33 (w.e.f 29-07-2021))

metadata.title: The National Institute of Health Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Institute of Health as a body corporate with headquarters in Islamabad. It outlines the Institute's functions, which include advising the Federal Government on disease control, conducting research, producing vaccines, and analyzing drug quality.

metadata.title: The National Institute of Health (Re-organization) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Institute of Health (NIH) as an autonomous body corporate in Pakistan. It re-organizes the health sector by creating various institutes and centers under the NIH's control for research, disease prevention, and managing health emergencies.

metadata.title: The National Institute of Oceanography Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Institute of Oceanography as a body corporate to conduct and coordinate research in oceanography and marine sciences. It defines the institute's functions, including undertaking surveys, training programs, and maintaining a national data center, while outlining its management structure under a Board of Governors.

metadata.title: The National Institute of Technology Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the National Institute of Technology in the private sector. It outlines the powers, functions, and structure of the Institute, including its authorities, officers, and governing bodies.

metadata.title: The National Insurance Corporation (Reorganization) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conversion of the National Insurance Corporation into a public limited company incorporated under the Companies Ordinance, 1984. It details the vesting of the Corporation's property, rights, and liabilities into the new Company, the transfer of employees, and the subsequent dissolution of the Corporation.

name: National Insurance Corporation Act, 1976(Repeal by ord.37 of 200,s.9(when notified))

metadata.title: The National Insurance Corporation Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Insurance Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the corporation's capital, management structure, functions, and the requirement that all public property be insured with the corporation.

metadata.title: The National Investment (Unit) Trust Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the National Investment (Unit) Trust, defining its units as transferable movable property and approved securities. It grants the Federal Government authority to authorize bearer certificates and make necessary rules to implement the Ordinance's provisions.

metadata.title: The National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee, headed by the Chief Justice of Pakistan. The Committee is tasked with coordinating judicial policy, improving the administration of justice, setting performance standards for judicial officers, and publishing annual reports.

metadata.title: The National Logistics Corporation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Logistics Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession to manage multi-modal logistics networks and infrastructure development. It outlines the Corporation's functions, including organizing multimodal logistics activities, supporting the Pakistan Army, and operating under government policy guidelines.

name: National Metrology Institute of Pakistan Act, 2022

metadata.title: The National Metrology Institute of Pakistan Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Metrology Institute of Pakistan as an apex body to implement a unified national measurement system. It provides for the institute's infrastructure, management structure, functions, and powers to support quality assurance and legal metrology in accordance with international practices.

name: National Press Trust (Appointment of Chairman) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The National Press Trust (Appointment of Chairman) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of a Chairman to the National Press Trust by the President. It outlines the qualifications, tenure, remuneration, and resignation procedures for the Chairman while ensuring this Act overrides other conflicting laws.

name: National Rahmatul-Lil-Aalameen Wa Khatamun Nabiyyin Authority Act, 2022

metadata.title: The National Rahmatul-Lil-Aalameen Wa Khatamun Nabiyyin Authority Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Rahmatul-Lil-Aalameen Wa Khatamun Nabiyyin Authority to promote research on the Seerat and address contemporary social challenges. The Authority aims to guide the young generation, consolidate literature on the Prophet's life, and build linkages with provincial governments and institutions.

name: National School of Public Policy Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The National School of Public Policy Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National School of Public Policy as a body corporate with headquarters in Islamabad. It outlines the school's functions, including providing instruction, conducting research, and offering training to government officials. The document also defines the composition and powers of the Board of Governors responsible for the school's administration.

metadata.title: The National Security Council Act, 2004
metadata.repeals: The National Security Council Order, 2001 (Chief Executive's Order No. 5 of 2001)
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Security Council to serve as a forum for consultation on matters of national security, including sovereignty, integrity, defence, and crisis management. It defines the council's composition, functions, meeting procedures, and the powers of its secretariat while repealing the previous National Security Council Order of 2001.

metadata.title: The National Skills University Islamabad Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act upgrades the National Institute of Science and Technical Education, Islamabad to the status of the National Skills University Islamabad. It establishes the university's structure, including its main campus in Islamabad and provisions for additional campuses determined by the Senate.

metadata.title: The National Sports Trust (Repeal) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.repeals: The National Sports Trust Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the National Sports Trust Act, 1972. It transfers all rights, properties, assets, debts, liabilities, and obligations of the National Sports Trust to the Pakistan Sports Board.

metadata.title: The National Tariff Commission Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The National Tariff Commission Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act reforms and repeals the National Tariff Commission Act, 1990 to establish a reconstituted National Tariff Commission. It defines the commission's powers, member qualifications, functions regarding trade remedy laws, and administrative procedures.

metadata.title: National Textile University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Textile University as a fully autonomous body to promote knowledge and technology in textile fields. It provides for the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board of Governors, and academic councils, while ensuring it succeeds the National College of Textile Engineering, Faisalabad.

metadata.title: The National Training Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes Training Boards to regulate and promote vocational training facilities across various fields in Pakistan. It provides for the financing of training programmes and establishes the National Training Board along with provincial counterparts to oversee these activities.

name: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences as a body corporate with its principal seat in Islamabad. It provides for the university's structure, including various councils and boards, and grants powers to offer instruction and training in computer and emerging sciences.

name: National University of Medical Sciences Act, 2015

metadata.title: The National University of Medical Sciences Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National University of Medical Sciences and provides for its incorporation, purposes, powers, and functions. It outlines the structure of the university's governance, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Board of Governors, Syndicate, and Academic Council, while defining various roles and terms related to staff, colleges, and affiliated institutions.

name: National University of Modern Languages Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The National University of Modern Languages Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National University of Modern Languages (NUML) in Islamabad as a fully autonomous body. It defines the university's structure, including its councils and committees, and grants it powers to determine courses, conduct examinations, award degrees, and pursue research.

metadata.title: The National University of Pakistan Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National University of Pakistan and provides for its powers, functions, and organizational structure. It defines the roles of various authorities, including the Board, Syndicate, and Academic Council, while outlining provisions for statutes, regulations, and financial management.

name: National University of Science and Technology Act (NUST) , 1997

metadata.title: The National University of Sciences and Technology Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National University of Sciences and Technology at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the University full autonomy to govern its academic and administrative functions, including determining courses, examining students, awarding degrees, and conducting research in engineering, sciences, and technology.

name: National Vocational and Technical Training Commission (NAVTTC) Act, 2011

metadata.title: The National Vocational and Technical Training Commission Act, 2011
metadata.repeals: National Training Ordinance, 1980 (IX of 1980)
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Vocational and Technical Training Commission as an autonomous body to regulate, coordinate, and provide policy direction for vocational and technical training in Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Board, outlines the functions and powers of the Commission, and details administrative procedures including appointments and meetings.

name: National Zakat Foundation (Merger in Bait-ul-Mal) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The National Zakat Foundation (Merger in the Bait-ul-Mal) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the merger of the National Zakat Foundation into the Bait-ul-Mal. It details the transfer of assets, liabilities, contracts, and employees from the Foundation to the Bait-ul-Mal effective March 31, 2001.

metadata.title: The Natural Gas (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of a development surcharge on natural gas sold by specified companies. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'fixed sale price' and 'prescribed price', mandates that the surcharge be treated as an expenditure allowable for income tax purposes, and sets penalties for selling natural gas above the fixed maximum price.

metadata.title: Natural Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Natural Gas Regulatory Authority to foster competition and improve efficiency in natural gas transportation and distribution services. It provides for the regulation of activities including transmission, distribution, sale, and purification of natural gas through a licensing framework.

metadata.title: The Naturalization Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the naturalization of aliens resident in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for granting certificates of naturalization, including requirements regarding residence duration, good character, and language knowledge.

metadata.title: The Naval Armament Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Treaty for the Limitation of Naval Armament signed in London on March 25, 1936. It restricts the building or equipping of vessels of war without a licence and establishes penalties and procedures for forfeiture of ships built in contravention of the Act.

name: Naya Pakistan Housing and Development Authority Act (NPHDA), 2020

metadata.title: The Naya Pakistan Housing and Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Naya Pakistan Housing and Development Authority to oversee housing and real estate development activities. It covers planning, construction, management of schemes, and related civic or municipal tasks on both profit and non-profit bases.

metadata.title: The Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act defines the legal characteristics of promissory notes, bills of exchange, and cheques. It establishes the rules regarding negotiation, presentment for acceptance or payment, discharge from liability, and procedures for noting and protest.

name:
Net work Analyser Study Centre (Transfer to 
WAPD) Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: The Network Analyser Study Centre (Transfer to WAPDA) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of the Network Analyser Study Centre in Lahore to the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (WAPDA). It outlines the terms of the asset transfer, including equipment valuation and land ownership retention by the Federal Government. Additionally, it details the transfer of existing civil servants from the Centre to WAPDA, including provisions for opting out with compensation.

name: New Energy Vehicles Adoption Levy Act, 2025

metadata.title: The New Energy Vehicles Adoption Levy Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a levy on internal combustion engine vehicles to promote the adoption of new energy vehicles in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'new energy motor vehicle' and outlines the collection mechanisms for both imported and locally manufactured vehicles, aligning them with customs and sales tax procedures respectively.

metadata.title: The Newspaper Employees (Conditions of Service) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960 with certain amendments. It establishes conditions for newspaper employees regarding appointment, termination, wages, provident funds, and leave within the whole of Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Newsprint Control Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the keeping, storage, distribution, disposal, acquisition, and use of newsprint in Pakistan. It establishes controls on who can deal in newsprint, sets maximum prices, requires declarations of stock held by dealers and importers, and mandates record-keeping for sales and usage.

name: NFC Institute of Engineering and Technology Multan Act, 2012

metadata.title: The NFC Institute of Engineering and Technology Multan Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the NFC Institute of Engineering and Technology Multan with degree awarding status to enhance higher education quality. It defines the institute's structure, including its authorities, officers, and governing bodies like the Senate and Syndicate. The legislation also outlines provisions for existing employees, student transfers, and the framework for statutes, regulations, and rules.

name: Nippon Institute of Advanced Sciences Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Nippon Institute of Advanced Sciences Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Nippon Institute of Advanced Sciences in Sheikhupura as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the powers and functions of the Institute, its officers, authorities, and governing bodies such as the Board of Governors and Syndicate.

name: Non-Performing Assets and Rehabilitation of Industrial Undertaking (Legal Proceedings) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Non-Performing Assets and Rehabilitation of Industrial Undertakings (Legal Proceedings) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for expeditious legal remedies regarding non-performing assets and the recovery of outstanding amounts owed to banks and financial institutions. It aims to make these assets attractive for privatization and to promote the revitalization of the national economy through the restructuring and rehabilitation of industrial undertakings.

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Constabulary Act, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the Frontier Constabulary in the North-West Frontier. It defines the powers of the Federal Government to maintain, appoint officers for, and employ this force for the protection and administration of the external frontier.

metadata.title: The Notaries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for and regulates the profession of notaries in Pakistan. It establishes the power to appoint notaries, maintains registers of practitioners, issues certificates of practice, and defines the functions and penalties related to the office.

metadata.title: The Oaths Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: Repealed by the Repealing Act, 1873 (XII of 1873)
