metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to judicial oaths, affirmations, and declarations in Pakistan. It also repeals the law concerning official oaths, affirmations, and declarations.

metadata.title: The Obstructions in Fairways Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Federal Government to remove or destroy obstructions in fairways leading to ports in Pakistan. It also provides for the recovery of expenses incurred during removal, the sale of unclaimed items, and penalties for breaches of rules made under the Act.

name: Off the Grid (Captive Power Plants) Levy Act, 2025

metadata.title: The Off The Grid (Captive Power Plants) Levy Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an 'off the grid' levy on natural gas or RLNG consumed by captive power plants in Pakistan. The collected funds are designated for reducing power generation tariffs across all consumer categories, with specific provisions for recovery of unpaid levies and tax allowances.

name: Offence of Qazf (Enforcement of Hadd) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Offence of Qazf (Enforcement of Hadd) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance modifies existing laws regarding the offence of qazf to align them with Islamic injunctions found in the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It defines the offence, establishes proof requirements involving witnesses or confession, and outlines punishments for false accusations of zina against specific individuals.

name: Offence of Zina (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance,1979

metadata.title: The Offence of Zina (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance modifies existing laws to bring the legal definition and punishment of zina into conformity with Islamic injunctions found in the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It establishes specific conditions for zina liable to hadd, defines punishments such as stoning or whipping, and outlines strict evidentiary requirements including confessions or testimony from four witnesses.

name: Offences Against Property (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Offences against Property (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance modifies existing laws relating to certain offences against property to bring them in conformity with the injunctions of Islam as set out in the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It defines specific terms such as 'hadd', 'tazir', and 'nisab' regarding theft and establishes punishments for various types of property offences.

name: Offences in Respect of Banks (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Offences in Respect of Banks (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the speedy trial of specific offences committed in respect of banks and related matters. It establishes Special Courts with designated judges to exclusively try scheduled offences, defines key terms such as 'bank' and 'scheduled offence', and outlines procedures for transferring pending cases to these courts.

metadata.title: The Official Secrets Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law in Pakistan relating to official secrets. It defines various terms such as documents, intelligence agencies, and munitions of war, while establishing offences related to unauthorized communication, interference with police or armed forces, and harbouring spies.

metadata.title: The Official Trustees Act, 1913
metadata.amends: Law constituting the office of Official Trustee
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the office of Official Trustee in Pakistan. It establishes the appointment, powers, duties, and liabilities of Official Trustees and their deputies, while also defining the jurisdiction of High Courts and procedures for audits.

name: Oil and Gas Development Corporation (Re-Organization) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Oil and Gas Development Corporation (Re-organization) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conversion of the Oil and Gas Development Corporation into a public limited company named Oil and Gas Development Company Limited. It clarifies that the new company succeeds to all assets, liabilities, rights, and legal proceedings of the former corporation as of its incorporation date.

name: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026

metadata.title: The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.amends: The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002 to clarify the definition of 'Chairman' and address vacancies in the post. It grants the Federal Government authority to assign the additional charge of Chairman to a specific civil servant for up to three months if the post is vacant.

name: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) Ordinance , 2002

metadata.title: The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority to foster competition and increase private investment in Pakistan's petroleum industry. It provides for the Authority's powers, functions, licensing regime, tariff structures, and offences related to petroleum activities.

metadata.title: The Oilseeds Cesses Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of cesses on oils extracted from oilseeds and on oilseeds exported from Pakistan. It establishes specific rates for excise duty on extracted oils and customs duty on exports, while also outlining procedures for monthly returns by mill owners and powers of inspection.

name: Organization of the Islamic Conference (Immunities and Privileges) Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Organization of the Islamic Conference (Immunities and Privileges) Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Organization of the Islamic Conference (Immunities and Privileges) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Agreement on Immunities and Privileges of the Organization of the Islamic Conference. It grants the Organization juridical personality, immunity from legal process regarding its property, and exemptions from taxes and customs duties for official use.

name: PAF Air War College Institute Act, 2021

metadata.title: The PAF Air War College Institute Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act re-organizes the Pakistan Air Force Air War College into a premier degree awarding institute. It establishes the institution to impart higher education in defense, security studies, and various scientific fields within a joint military environment.

name: Pakistan (Army and Air Force) Reserves Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Army and Air Force) Reserves Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and discipline of the Pakistan Army and Air Force Reserves. It consolidates and amends laws relating to the government of these reserves, defining categories such as Regular and Supplementary Reserves for both branches.

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Exchange of Prisoners) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance implements an agreement between Pakistan and India regarding the exchange of certain classes of prisoners. It establishes the legal framework for the transfer, custody, and repatriation of prisoners, including provisions to avoid local court jurisdiction once a prisoner is handed over to Indian officials.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Academy of Letters' Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Academy of Letters as an autonomous body corporate with perpetual succession. Its primary purpose is to promote Pakistani languages and literature while ensuring the welfare of the writers' community throughout Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Board Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Board Kamra to manage and reorganize factories within existing financial resources. It empowers the Board to administer factory affairs on commercial lines while meeting national defence needs during war and peace, subject to directions from the Federal Government regarding national interest.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Agricultural Research Council Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution and re-organization of the Pakistan Agricultural Research Council. It establishes the Council as a body corporate with defined functions, powers, management structure, and financial provisions.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for the Pakistan Air Force, defining persons subject to its laws and outlining conditions of service. It details provisions regarding commissions, offences, punishments, courts-martial, and the privileges of personnel.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Air Safety Investigation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for investigating accidents and incidents involving aircraft in Pakistan. It creates the Bureau of Aircraft Safety Investigations, defines key terms like 'accident' and 'aircraft', and outlines the powers of investigators regarding evidence collection and report publication.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Airports Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Airports Authority to improve the administration, operation, and development of airports and air transport services in Pakistan. It defines the Authority's functions, powers, structure, financial provisions, and outlines offences and penalties related to airport property and operations.

name: Pakistan Animal Quarantine (Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Pakistan Animal Quarantine (Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the import, export, and quarantine of animals and animal products to prevent the introduction or spread of diseases. It empowers the Federal Government to issue notifications prohibiting or restricting trade in specific items and grants customs officers corresponding enforcement powers.

name: Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Pakistan Armed Forces Nursing Service as a part of the Armed Forces of Pakistan and provides for its discipline. It establishes rules regarding the constitution, eligibility for appointment, commissioned rank, and the application of army, air force, and navy acts to its members.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the sale, transport, bearing, or possession of arms, ammunition, and military stores in Pakistan. It establishes prohibitions on unlicensed activities, defines various types of arms and ammunition, outlines licensing powers, and prescribes penalties for breaches.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Army Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for the Pakistan Army, covering personnel appointment, service termination, and disciplinary procedures. It defines various military offences, outlines the constitution and powers of courts martial, and prescribes punishments and penalties for violations of good order and discipline.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission to promote the peaceful uses of atomic energy and discharge international obligations related thereto. It provides for the composition, functions, and powers of the Commission, including its status as a body corporate with perpetual succession.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Bait ul Mal Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Bait ul Mal fund to provide financial assistance and rehabilitation services to destitute widows, orphans, invalids, and other needy persons. It outlines the constitution of the Bait ul Mal Board, defines its functions, and specifies sources for financing the fund, including government grants, donations, and asset sales.

name: Pakistan Banking (Prevention of Default and Evasion of labilities) Ordinance, 1947

metadata.title: The Pakistan Banking (Prevention of Default and Evasion of Liabilities) Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to prevent banking concerns in Pakistan from defaulting on commitments due to external pressure. It prohibits banks from acting on instructions from government authorities outside Pakistan regarding cheque payments or deposit deliveries without prior approval. The document also outlines procedures for demanding explanations, conducting searches of bank premises, and prohibiting the removal of assets held in safe custody.

name: Pakistan Banking and Finance Services Commission Act, 1992

metadata.title: The Pakistan Banking and Finance Services Commission Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Banking and Finance Services Commission to provide a systematic basis for recruiting officers in financial institutions. The Commission is empowered to conduct examinations, interviews, and tests for recruitment and promotion within these institutions while advising the Federal Government on related matters.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Boy Scouts Association Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance incorporates the Pakistan Boy Scouts Association as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Association exclusive rights to use specific titles, uniforms, badges, and emblems, while also establishing penalties for contravention of these provisions.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the corporation's functions, management structure including the Board of Directors, and financial provisions such as income sources and borrowing powers.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the acquisition and determination of Pakistan citizenship. It establishes rules regarding citizenship by birth, descent, migration, naturalization, and registration, while also addressing issues such as dual nationality and deprivation of citizenship.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Civil Aviation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority and defines its functions, powers, and structure. It regulates various aspects of civil aviation including aircraft registration, air service licences, airport operations, and aviation security measures.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Civil Aviation Authority as a body corporate to regulate and control civil aviation activities in Pakistan. It empowers the Authority to develop infrastructure for safe and efficient air transport services while subjecting its operations to directives from the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Climate Change Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Climate Change Council and the Pakistan Climate Change Authority to address climate change effects. It defines key terms such as adaptation, mitigation, and greenhouse gases while outlining the functions and composition of these bodies.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Coast Guards Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and regulation of the Pakistan Coast Guards. It outlines the functions of the Force, which include preventing smuggling, stopping illegal immigration, and supplementing national defense in war.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Coinage Act, 1906
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to coinage and the mint in Pakistan. It establishes provisions for the denominations, dimensions, designs, and composition of coins, as well as their status as legal tender.

name: Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons Ordinance, I962

metadata.title: The Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons as a body corporate to maintain high principles of the medical profession. It outlines the functions of the College, including promoting specialist practice, arranging post-graduate training, conducting examinations, and facilitating research.

name: Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 1956(Repeal by act iX of 2017 s.19)

metadata.title: The Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: Ordinance XXIV of 1955
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Commissions of Inquiry by the Federal Government to investigate matters of public importance. It vests these commissions with specific powers similar to a Civil Court, including summoning witnesses, requiring document production, and receiving evidence on affidavits.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of Commissions of Inquiry by the Federal Government to investigate matters of public importance. It grants these commissions extensive powers similar to civil courts, including summoning witnesses, seizing documents, ordering police investigations, and punishing contempt.

name: Pakistan Council for Science and Technology Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Pakistan Council for Science and Technology Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Council for Science and Technology as a body corporate to advise the Federal Government on national policies regarding science, technology, and innovation. The Council is empowered to conduct policy research, formulate proposals, manage funds, and promote collaboration between academia, industry, and international organizations.

name: Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: The Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners as a body corporate to regulate architectural and town planning professions in Pakistan. It provides for the constitution of the Council, its membership, functions, and powers regarding the recognition of qualifications and maintenance of registers.

name: Pakistan Council of Research in Water Resources Act, 2007

metadata.title: The Pakistan Council of Research in Water Resources Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Council of Research in Water Resources as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the Council's functions, which include conducting research on water resources, developing conservation technologies, and advising the government on water policy.

name: Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research to promote and guide scientific and technological research for industrial problems in Pakistan. It defines the Council's composition, functions, term of office for members, and powers regarding funds and property.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1958
metadata.amends: The Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1948
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1948, with certain amendments to provide for speedier trials and effective punishment of specific offences. It establishes the appointment, jurisdiction, and powers of Special Judges to try these cases exclusively within designated territorial limits.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Currency Act, 1950
metadata.repeals: Pakistan Currency Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the issue and circulation of one-rupee notes by the Government of Pakistan. It establishes these notes as legal tender in Pakistan, equivalent to the rupee coin issued under the Pakistan Coinage Act, 1906.

name: Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance (PEMRA), 2002

metadata.title: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (PEMRA) to regulate electronic media in Pakistan. It aims to improve information standards, ensure accountability and transparency, and facilitate the devolution of responsibility to grassroots levels.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Engineering Council Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Pakistan Engineering Council to regulate the engineering profession within Pakistan. It establishes the Council's functions, including accrediting engineering institutions and qualifications, licensing engineers, and maintaining a register of members.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, conservation, rehabilitation, and improvement of the environment while preventing and controlling pollution. It also establishes mechanisms to promote sustainable development through the creation of specific councils and agencies.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance of certain essential services in Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to declare specific employments as essential and to order persons engaged in them to remain in specified areas.

name: Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the quality and promotes the export of fish and fishery products from Pakistan. It establishes mechanisms for the registration of processing plants and exporters, defines key terms related to fish and inspection, and outlines the functions of an Inspection Committee.

metadata.title: The Pakistan General Cosmetics Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan General Cosmetics Regulatory Authority to regulate general cosmetics in Pakistan. It covers aspects such as quality, standard, labeling, packing, manufacturing, storage, distribution, and sales of these products.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Girl Guides Association Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance incorporates the Pakistan Girl Guides Association as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Association exclusive rights to use specific titles, emblems, uniforms, and decorations, while also establishing penalties for contravention of these provisions.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Global Institute Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Global Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy to provide education, conduct research, and award degrees.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Halal Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Halal Authority as a body corporate to promote trade and commerce in Halal articles and processes. It defines key terms such as 'Halal', 'Authority', and 'Accredited Halal Certification Body' while outlining the establishment, management, and powers of the Authority.

name: Pakistan Health Research Council Act, 2016 (Repealed by ACT No. XIII OF 2021 section 33 (w.e.f 29-07-2021))

metadata.title: The Pakistan Health Research Council Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the Pakistan Medical Research Council into the Pakistan Health Research Council. It grants the new body administrative and financial autonomy to promote, organize, and conduct scientific research in various fields of health.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Hotels and Restaurants Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to control and regulate the standards of service and amenities for tourists in hotels and restaurants across Pakistan. It establishes a regulatory framework including the appointment of Controllers, registration requirements, classification of establishments, and the fixing of fair rates.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the dissolution of the Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation and addresses matters ancillary to that process. It facilitates the transfer of the Corporation's business, projects, and properties to a company or its subsidiary while ensuring the continuance of contracts, proceedings, and employee services.

name: Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Transfer of Projects and Companies) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Transfer of Projects and Companies) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transfer of certain projects and companies from the West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation to specified corporations. It defines key terms such as 'corporation', 'managed company', and 'project' while establishing the legal framework for vesting assets and transferring shares on a designated appointed day.

name: Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary Services Act, 2008

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary Services Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary Services as a body corporate to promote research and provide training. It aims to offer information facilities to Parliamentarians and assist them in performing their duties effectively.

name: Pakistan Institute of Development Economics Act, 2010

metadata.title: Pakistan Institute of Development Economics Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act grants degree awarding status to the Pakistan Institute of Development Economics in Islamabad. It reconstitutes the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession and provides for its academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Science Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers the power on the Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences in Islamabad to award degrees. It establishes the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its powers regarding instruction, research, examinations, and affiliations.

name: Pakistan Institute of Fashion and Design Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Fashion and Design Act, 2011
metadata.amends: Pakistan Institute of Fashion and Design
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the Pakistan Institute of Fashion and Design, Lahore, granting it degree-awarding status. It establishes the institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its officers, authorities, and statutory powers.

name: Pakistan Institute of International Affairs (Administration) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of International Affairs (Administration) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper administration of the affairs of the Pakistan Institute of International Affairs. It dissolves the existing Council, vests all powers and assets in an appointed Administrator, and establishes a Managing Committee to advise the Administrator.

name: Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) Act, 2023
metadata.repeals: The Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Act, 2021 and establishes the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS). It defines key terms such as 'super specialty' and grants the Government authority to engage highly skilled clinical medical professionals up to sixty-five years of age. The legislation also outlines the transfer of assets and liabilities from the dissolved institute to the Division concerned under the Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University Islamabad (Amendment) Act, 2018.

name: Pakistan Institute of Research and Registration of Quality Assurance Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Research and Registration of Quality Assurance Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Institute of Research and Registration of Quality Assurance in the private sector at Gwadar. It provides for the institute's incorporation, functions, powers, and the structure of its authorities including the Board of Governors and Syndicate.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Insurance Corporation (Re-Organization) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conversion of the Pakistan Insurance Corporation into a public limited company named Pakistan Reinsurance Company Limited. It details the vesting of the Corporation's rights, property, and liabilities into the new company while ensuring employee terms are not varied to their disadvantage.

name: Pakistan Insurance Corporation Act, 1952(Repeal by Ord.36 of 2000,s.7)

metadata.title: The Pakistan Insurance Corporation Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Insurance Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the corporation's powers, management structure, business scope, and financial regulations including investment and reinsurance arrangements.

name: Pakistan International Airline Corporation (Suspension of Trade Unions and Existing Agreements) Order (Repeal) Act, 2008

metadata.title: The Pakistan International Airline Corporation (Suspension of Trade Unions and Existing Agreements) Order (Repeal) Act, 2008
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan International Airline Corporation (Suspension of Trade Unions and Existing Agreements) Order, 2001 (C.E's Order No. 6 of 2001)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Pakistan International Airline Corporation (Suspension of Trade Unions and Existing Agreements) Order, 2001. It provides that trade unions suspended under the repealed order must be registered afresh while allowing other administrative actions to continue until altered.

metadata.title: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) (Repeal) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016, with specific exceptions regarding section 7. It validates all previous actions, orders, and rights taken under the repealed Act as if they were always lawful.

metadata.title: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016. It preserves the validity of all actions, orders, and rights acquired under the repealed Act while exempting a specific subsection of section 7 from the repeal.

name: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation - PIA (Conversion) Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conversion of the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation into a public limited company. It details the transfer of assets and liabilities, the continuation of existing licenses and benefits, and grants waivers from certain taxes and duties.

name: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act, 1956(Repeal by act XV of 2016)

metadata.title: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the takeover of Orient Airways Limited's undertaking and outlines the Corporation's functions to develop safe and efficient air-transport services.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Junior Cadet Corps Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes and maintains the Junior Cadet Corps in Pakistan, defining its structure and organization within schools. It outlines the criteria for enrolling cadets, appointing officers, subjecting them to military law during training, and regulating their allowances and commissions.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Land Port Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Land Port Authority to administer an integrated system for cross-border movement of goods and passengers. It provides a framework for declaring, regulating, and securing land ports while coordinating with government agencies to promote trade and border control.

name: Pakistan Madrasah Education (Establishment and Affiliation of Model Dini Madaris) Board Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Pakistan Madrasah Education (Establishment and Affiliation of Model Dini Madaris) Board Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Madrassah Education Board to regulate and standardize dini madaris in Pakistan. It aims to integrate Islamic education with the general education system and ensure uniformity in curricula and examination standards.

name: Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Transfer of Managed Establishments) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Transfer of Managed Establishments) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of certain managed establishments relating to maritime shipping and matters connected thereto. It empowers the Federal Government to offer the transfer of shares or proprietary interests in these establishments to specified persons under terms set out in the Schedule.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Maritime Zones Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Pakistan's territorial sea and maritime zones. It defines various maritime concepts such as internal waters, contiguous zones, and exclusive economic zones while establishing rules for innocent passage, pollution prevention, and jurisdiction over offences like piracy.

name: Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the registration of medical practitioners and dentists in Pakistan. It establishes a uniform minimum standard for basic and higher qualifications in medicine and dentistry while reconstituting the Medical and Dental Council.

name: Pakistan Medical And Dental Council Ordinance (PMDC), 1962 (Repealed by Act no. XXXIII of 2020 section 50 (w.e.f 22-09-2020)

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the registration of medical practitioners and dentists in Pakistan. It establishes the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council to set uniform minimum standards for basic and higher qualifications in medicine and dentistry.

name: Pakistan Medical Commission Act, 2020 (Repealed by Act no. IV of 2023 section 51 (w.e.f 12-01-2023))

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical Commission Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Medical Commission to regulate and control the medical and dental professions. It sets uniform minimum standards for basic and higher medical education, training, and the recognition of relevant qualifications.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Merchant Shipping Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the registration, nationality, and control of ships in Pakistan. It outlines regulations regarding the engagement of seamen, the competency of officers, and the management of coastal shipping operations.

name: Pakistan Military Academy (Degrees and Certificates) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Pakistan Military Academy (Degrees and Certificates) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the Pakistan Military Academy at Kakul to confer degrees and grant certificates to its cadets and officers. It defines the specific academic courses eligible for degree awards (Arts and Science) and certificate issuance, while also empowering the Academy to make regulations with Federal Government approval.

name: Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorized Use) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised Use) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act prevents the unauthorised use of specific national names and emblems, such as those of Quaid-i-Azam Mohammad Ali Jinnah and the Pakistan flag. It prohibits registering trademarks or patents that bear these protected names or emblems without prior written permission from the Prime Minister.

metadata.title: The Pakistan National Accreditation Council Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan National Accreditation Council as a body corporate to oversee accreditation of conformity assessment bodies. It defines the Council's functions, including setting policies, providing training, and accrediting bodies in line with national and international standards.

name: Pakistan National Council of the Arts Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Pakistan National Council of the Arts Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan National Council of the Arts to provide for its patronage, promotion, and development. It defines the Council's structure, including a Board of Governors and a Director-General, and outlines its functions such as advising the government on artistic policy and organizing cultural exhibitions.

metadata.title: The Pakistan National Service Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance introduces compulsory national service for male citizens of Pakistan aged eighteen to twenty who possess matriculation qualifications. It establishes the liability, deferment conditions, and selection processes for rendering this service while defining exemptions for defence personnel and students in essential fields.

metadata.title: The Pakistan National Shipping Corporation Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: National Shipping Corporation Ordinance, 1963; Pakistan Shipping Corporation Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan National Shipping Corporation by amalgamating the National Shipping Corporation and the Pakistan Shipping Corporation. It provides for the dissolution of the two existing corporations as of December 31, 1978, and outlines the functions, administration, and governance structure of the new entity.

name: Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the Pakistan Naval Academy to confer degrees such as Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of Arts, and Bachelor of Studies in Naval and Management Sciences. It grants this power to Cadet-entry Officers upon successful completion of their prescribed course and extends similar powers to foreign government officers completing courses at the Academy.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Navy (Extension of Service) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the retention in service of certain persons enrolled in the Pakistan Navy whose term of service has expired. It stipulates that such personnel shall continue to be liable for service until discharged by the Officer Commanding, with an extension period not exceeding five years.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the Pakistan Navy, defining persons subject to its jurisdiction and outlining conditions of service. It details various offences ranging from misconduct in action to desertion, along with corresponding punishments and procedures for courts-martial.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nuclear Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Nuclear Regulatory Authority as the competent national body for regulating nuclear safety and radiation protection. It defines the Authority's functions, powers regarding licensing and authorization, and outlines the extent of civil liability for nuclear damage.

name: Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to the registration, licensing, and training of nurses, nurse practitioners, midwives, midwifery associates, and nurse auxiliaries in Pakistan. It establishes the Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council, defines its powers and functions, and sets out procedures for institutional recognition, examinations, and the maintenance of professional registers.

name: Pakistan Nursing Council Act (PNC), 1973 (Repealed by Act No. XXXVII of 2026, s. 53 (w.e.f 04-06-2026))

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nursing Council Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the laws relating to the registration and training of nurses, midwives, and health visitors in Pakistan. It establishes the Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council (PN&MC) and provides for its powers, functions, and the maintenance of registers for practitioners.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Ordnance Factories Board Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Ordnance Factories Board to manage and administer ordnance factories. It invests the Board with specific powers and functions previously held by the Central Government regarding these factories.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Ordnance Factories Board Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Ordnance Factories Board to manage and administer ordnance factories. It invests the Board with specific powers previously held by the Central Government regarding factory operations, personnel management, and commercial administration.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Penal Code
metadata.summary: This document outlines the structure and contents of the Pakistan Penal Code, covering definitions, punishments, general exceptions, and rights of private defence. It also details provisions regarding abetment of offences within the jurisdiction.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Plant Quarantine Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the International Plant Protection Convention, 1951. It empowers the Federal Government to prohibit or regulate the import of articles likely to cause infection or carry pests through notifications issued in the official Gazette.

name: Pakistan Postal Services Management Board Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Pakistan Postal Services Management Board Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Postal Services Management Board to manage the Pakistan Post Office Department. It defines the Board's structure, including its members and officers, and outlines its powers, functions, and financial provisions.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Railways Police Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution, control, and regulation of the Pakistan Railways Police. It outlines the specific functions of this force, including maintaining law and order on railways, preventing loss to railway property, and ensuring passenger safety.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes a force called the Pakistan Rangers for the protection of and maintenance of order in border areas. It defines the powers, duties, and conditions of service for members and officers of the Force, including provisions for appointments, functions, and punishments.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Red Crescent Society Act
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan Red Crescent Society Act (Repealed by Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act No. XXVI of 1951)
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Pakistan Red Crescent Society to continue the work previously carried on by the Indian Red Cross Society in Pakistan. It provides for the incorporation of the society, the appointment of its managing body, and the transfer of assets from the Joint War Committee. The legislation also outlines the purposes for which the society's funds may be applied, specifically focusing on medical aid and relief for the sick and wounded.

name: Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1959 (II of 1960)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the immediate dissolution of the Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation. It authorizes the Federal Government to transfer the Corporation's undertakings, properties, and employees to another body before dissolving the entity.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Science Foundation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Science Foundation as a body corporate to promote and finance scientific activities relevant to the country's socio-economic needs. The Foundation functions as a financing agency for research, science centers, and the exchange of scientists with other countries, while being guided on policy questions by the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Single Window Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an autonomous body known as the Pakistan Single Window to simplify cross-border trade processes and reduce business costs. It creates a single point for submitting trade data to enable synchronized processing, standardization of documents, and integrated risk management techniques.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund, which is owned and controlled by the Federal Government. It outlines the Fund's objectives, composition of its Board and Supervisory Council, investment mandates, and operational procedures including borrowing, lending, and public-private partnerships.

name: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of a Space Research Council and the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO). It aims to promote the peaceful uses and applications of space science and technology for the socio-economic development of the country.

name: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996

metadata.title: The Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority to provide standardization and quality control services. It defines key terms such as 'article', 'Pakistan standard', and 'quality assurance' while outlining the authority's powers, constitution, and functions.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Study Centres Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Pakistan Study Centres in universities across the country to study languages, literature, social structures, and customs of various regions. It defines the functions of these centres and institutes, outlines the composition and powers of their Boards of Governors, and provides for the appointment of directors and management of funds.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-organisation) Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the re-organisation of the telecommunication system in Pakistan. It establishes key bodies including the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority, Frequency Allocation Board, National Telecommunication Corporation, and the Pakistan Telecommunication Employees Trust.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Territorial Force Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution, administration, and discipline of the Pakistan Territorial Force. It establishes the framework for enrolment, appointment to units, transfer of personnel, and discharge from service.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Tobacco Board to promote the cultivation, manufacture, and export of tobacco and related products. It provides for the board's constitution, functions, control mechanisms, and powers regarding pricing, cess levies, and export regulations.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Tourist Guides Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of the profession of tourist guides in Pakistan. It establishes a regulatory committee, sets out licensing requirements, defines a code of conduct, and prescribes penalties for unlicensed practice or violations.

name: Pakistan Trade Control of Wiled Fauna and Flora Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Pakistan Trade Control of Wild Fauna and Flora Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Federal Government to give effect to the United Nations Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora. It establishes prohibitions on the export, re-export, and import of specimens included in the Convention's Appendices without valid permits issued by designated authorities.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Veterinary Medical Council Act 1996
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Pakistan Veterinary Medical Council to regulate the registration and practice of veterinary professionals in Pakistan. It establishes uniform standards for qualifications, defines the council's composition, and outlines powers regarding recognition of courses and maintenance of registers.

name: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority to ensure the unified and coordinated development of water and power resources in Pakistan. It defines the Authority's corporate status, outlines the appointment and terms for its Chairman and Members, and grants it general powers regarding schemes, surveys, and control over power stations.

metadata.title: The Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 1936
metadata.amends: The Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to marriage and divorce among Parsis in Pakistan. It establishes requisites for valid marriages, procedures for matrimonial suits, and provisions regarding custody of children and alimony.

metadata.title: The Partition Act, 1893
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to partition suits in Pakistan. It empowers courts to order the sale of property instead of division when a fair division is not reasonably possible, and outlines procedures for shareholders to buy out others' shares.

metadata.title: The Partnership Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to partnership in Pakistan. It establishes the nature of partnerships, relations between partners and third parties, and procedures for registration and dissolution.

metadata.title: The Passports Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the departure from and entry into Pakistan, as well as visits to foreign countries by Pakistani citizens. It establishes requirements for possessing a valid passport, defines offenses related to forgery or misuse of travel documents, and prescribes penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Patents Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This document establishes the legal framework for patents in Pakistan, defining patentability criteria and administration procedures. It outlines the rights of inventors, processes for application and examination, and provisions regarding infringement, compulsory licenses, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Pay-As-You-Earn Scheme Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for a scheme allowing the import of machinery and equipment on credit to establish industrial units and enterprises. It requires that the cost of such imports be met from the export earnings of the specific unit or enterprise.

metadata.title: The Payment of Wages Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the payment of wages to certain classes of persons employed in industry, including factories, industrial establishments, and railway administrations. It establishes rules regarding wage periods, time of payment, permissible deductions, fines, and penalties for offenses related to unpaid or delayed wages.

name: Payment Systems and Electronic Fund Transfers Act, 2007

metadata.title: The Payment Systems and Electronic Fund Transfers Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a regulatory framework for payment systems and electronic fund transfers within Pakistan. It defines the rights, liabilities, and obligations of financial institutions, service providers, and consumers while setting standards for system operation and error correction.

name: Peaceful Assembly and Public Order Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Peaceful Assembly and Public Order Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the holding of public assemblies at certain places in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes procedures for obtaining permission from the District Magistrate, defines key terms such as 'Assembly' and 'Event Coordinator', and outlines powers to impose bans or recall permissions based on security concerns.

metadata.title: The Pensions Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to pensions and grants of money or land-revenue by the Government. It establishes procedures for making claims, defines the appropriate government authority, and outlines exemptions from attachment.

metadata.title: The Petroleum Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the import, transport, storage, production, refining, and blending of petroleum and other inflammable substances. It establishes rules for licensing, testing standards, penalties for offenses, and defines key terms such as petroleum classes and illegal sales.

name: Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) and Climate Support Levy Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Petroleum Products Petroleum Levy and Climate Support Levy Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of a Petroleum Levy and Climate Support Levy on petroleum products. It outlines the procedures for payment, exemptions, refunds, and the recovery of unpaid amounts as arrears of land revenue.

metadata.title: The Pharmacy Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Pharmacy Councils at both the Central and Provincial levels to regulate the practice of pharmacy in Pakistan. It provides for the composition of these councils, the registration of pharmacists, approval of courses and examinations, and the maintenance of registers.

name: Pir Roshaan Institute of Progressive Sciences and Technologies, Miranshah Act, 2023

metadata.title: Pir Roshaan Institute of Progressive Sciences and Technologies, Miranshah Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Pir Roshaan Institute of Progressive Sciences and Technologies at Miranshah in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It outlines the institute's powers, purposes, organizational structure including various authorities like the Board of Governors and Syndicate, and financial provisions.

metadata.title: The Plant Breeders' Rights Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act encourages the development of new plant varieties and protects the rights of their breeders. It establishes a Plant Breeders' Rights Registry to administer these protections and provides for the issuance of certificates, exceptions for researchers and farmers, and mechanisms for infringement suits.

metadata.title: The Poisons Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the importation, possession, and sale of poisons in Pakistan. It grants powers to Federal and Provincial Governments to regulate these activities through rules and licences, establish presumptions about specified substances, and impose penalties for unlawful actions.

metadata.title: The Police (Incitement to Disaffection) Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act provides penalties for spreading disaffection among police forces and committing kindred offences. It defines members of a police force, outlines specific punishments including imprisonment or fines, and establishes requirements for court sanctions and trial procedures.

metadata.title: The Police Act, 1861
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the police force to make it a more efficient instrument for preventing and detecting crime. It defines the constitution of the force, duties of officers, powers regarding public assemblies, and procedures for property recovery and penalties.

metadata.title: The Police Act, 1888
metadata.amends: Law relating to the regulation of Police
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the regulation of police by relaxing restrictions on the employment of police officers across different presidencies, provinces, or places. It empowers the Federal Government to create special police districts spanning multiple provinces and allows police officers to exercise their powers beyond their home province with appropriate orders.

metadata.title: The Police Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This document establishes the organizational structure, responsibilities, and disciplinary framework for the police in Pakistan. It creates various public safety commissions at provincial, district, and national levels to oversee police conduct and address complaints.

name: Population Welfare Planning Programme (Appointment and Temination of Service) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Population Welfare Planning Programme (Appointment and Termination of Service) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the restructuring and reorganisation of the Population Programme, specifically regarding the appointment and termination of service for its employees. It establishes procedures for appointments by the appointing authority based on recommendations from the Federal Public Service Commission or Departmental Selection Committees and defines eligibility criteria.

name: Port Authorities Lands And Buildings (Recovery Of Possession) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Port Authorities Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Possession) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the speedy recovery of possession of lands and buildings belonging to Port Authorities from unauthorized occupants or lessees who fail to vacate after a lease expires or is determined. It establishes the procedures for issuing notices, conducting inquiries by an Authorized Officer, and ordering eviction or demolition of structures.

metadata.title: The Port Qasim Authority Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Port Qasim Authority to plan, develop, and manage Muhammad Bin Qasim Port at Phitti Creek. It outlines the Authority's powers regarding land acquisition, toll collection, financial management, and regulatory functions while defining its relationship with the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Ports Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the enactments relating to ports and port charges in India. It defines the extent of the Act, establishes powers for conservators, regulates vessel movements, and outlines the levy and recovery of port dues.

metadata.title: The Post Office Act, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for postal services in Pakistan, including the government's exclusive privilege to convey letters. It outlines regulations regarding postage rates, transmission conditions, registration, insurance, and money orders, while also defining penalties for various offenses related to mail handling.

name: Post Office National Savings Certificates Ordinance, 1944

metadata.title: The Post Office National Savings Certificates Ordinance, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes provisions regarding Post Office Twelve-Year National Savings Certificates and other classes of savings certificates. It establishes restrictions on the transfer of these certificates without written consent from an authorized officer and outlines procedures for payment upon the death of a holder.

metadata.title: The Power Alcohol Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for matters connected with the development of the power alcohol industry under Federal control in Pakistan. It regulates the production, disposal, and use of power alcohol, including restrictions on manufacturing substances and requirements for mixing it with petrol.

metadata.title: The Powers-of-Attorney Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to powers-of-attorney in Pakistan. It grants donees of powers-of-attorney the authority to execute instruments in their own name and protects third parties acting in good faith without notice of the donor's death or incapacity.

name: President to hold Another Office Act, 2004

metadata.title: The President to Hold Another Office Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act enables the President of Pakistan to hold the office of Chief of the Army Staff simultaneously. It declares that holding this additional office does not disqualify the President under specific constitutional provisions regarding offices of profit.

metadata.title: The President's Pension Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a monthly pension to persons who have held the office of President under specific conditions. It also grants various facilities, including medical aid, official residences, and security, to the former President and their widows.

name: President's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975

metadata.title: The President's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salary, allowances, and privileges of the President of Pakistan. It provides for monthly payments, equipment allowances, travel costs, and the use of official residences and transport without rent or hire.

metadata.title: The Press Council of Pakistan Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Press Council of Pakistan as an autonomous and independent body to implement the Ethical Code of Practice. It defines the Council's composition, functions, financial resources, and powers regarding inquiries into complaints against the press.

name: Press Newspapers, News Agencies and Books Registration Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Press, Newspapers, News Agencies and Books Registration Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to news agencies, publications, and printing presses in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for declarations by printers and publishers, regulates foreign ownership of newspapers, and outlines penalties for contraventions.

name: Prevention and Control of Human Trafficking Ordinance, 2002 (Repealed by Act XXXIV of 2018)

metadata.title: The Prevention and Control of Human Trafficking Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides effective measures to prevent and control human trafficking in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as human trafficking, victim, and organized criminal groups, and establishes punishments for various offences related to trafficking, including slavery, forced labour, and exploitative entertainment.

metadata.title: The Prevention of Anti-National Activities Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the more effective prevention of certain anti-national and treasonable activities by individuals and associations. It empowers the Federal Government to declare associations as anti-national and establishes a Tribunal to adjudicate on such declarations.

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the more effective prevention of bribery and corruption in Pakistan. It defines offences related to public servants accepting gratification, establishes legal presumptions regarding such acceptance, and outlines criminal misconduct by public officials.

name: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to prevent cruelty towards animals in Pakistan. It defines offenses such as overdriving, beating, or selling animals that have suffered unnecessary pain and establishes corresponding penalties including fines and imprisonment.

metadata.title: The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes provisions to prevent unauthorized acts regarding information systems and defines related cybercrimes. It creates mechanisms for the investigation, prosecution, trial of offenses, and international cooperation on these matters.

metadata.title: The Prevention of Gambling Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of gambling within Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'common gaming-house' and 'gaming', establishes penalties for owning, keeping, or participating in gambling activities, and grants magistrates powers to enter and search suspected locations.

metadata.title: The Prevention of Seditious Meetings Act, 1911
metadata.repeals: The Repealing Act, 1927 (XII of 1927)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the prevention of public meetings likely to promote sedition or disturb public tranquility. It empowers provincial governments to notify proclaimed areas where strict regulations on holding such meetings, giving notice, and obtaining permission apply.

metadata.title: The Prevention of Smuggling Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the effective prevention of smuggling and related matters within Pakistan. It establishes provisions for preventive detention, special judicial inquiries, and the forfeiture of property acquired through smuggling.

name: Prevention Of Smuggling Of Migrants Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Prevention of Smuggling of Migrants Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides effective measures to prevent the smuggling of migrants by land, sea, and air. It establishes specific offences related to facilitating illegal entry, harbouring illegal residents, and handling documents for smuggling purposes, along with corresponding punishments.

name: Prevention of Trafficking In Persons Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides effective measures to prevent and combat trafficking in persons, with a specific focus on women and children. It defines key terms such as 'victim' and 'coercion', establishes severe penalties for traffickers including imprisonment and fines, and outlines provisions for the protection of victims and witnesses.

name: Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of prices and the prevention of profiteering and hoarding within Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to make orders regulating the production, movement, supply, and sale of essential commodities at fair prices.

name: Prime Minister's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act,1975

metadata.title: The Prime Minister's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Prime Minister of Pakistan to enable them to discharge their duties conveniently and with dignity. It specifies the annual salary, equipment allowance, travel expenses for taking up or laying down office, and provisions regarding official residence, transport, and medical facilities.

metadata.title: The Prisoners Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to prisoners confined by order of a Court. It establishes provisions for the detention, execution of sentences, removal, discharge, and attendance of prisoners in court.

metadata.title: The Prisons Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act provides rules for the regulation of prisons in Pakistan and amends the law relating to them. It establishes definitions, outlines the duties of prison officers, and sets provisions regarding prisoner admission, discipline, employment, and health.

name: Private Military Organizations (Abolition and Prohibition) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Private Military Organisations (Abolition and Prohibition) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes private organisations capable of functioning as military organisations and provides penalties for their formation. It empowers the Federal Government to declare such organisations illegal via notification and imposes imprisonment and fines on those who form or participate in them.

name: Private Power and Infrastructure Board Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Private Power and Infrastructure Board Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Private Power and Infrastructure Board (PPIB) as an independent body corporate to implement power policies in the private sector. It aims to promote private investment, safeguard existing investments, and provide a one-window facility for investors in the power and infrastructure sectors.

metadata.title: The Private Security Companies Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation, licensing, and control of private security companies operating in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It was promulgated by the President under emergency provisions due to the suspension of the National Assembly and Senate.

metadata.title: The Privatisation Commission Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Privatisation Commission to implement the Federal Government's privatisation policy. It provides for a fair and transparent process, including the establishment of funds, management structure, and mechanisms to resolve disputes related to privatisation transactions.

metadata.title: The Privy Purses (Charged Expenditure) Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act declares that the expenditure relating to privy purses payable by the Federal Government to Rulers of certain former States is a charge on the Central Consolidated Fund. It stipulates that such sums shall be paid out of that Fund and are deemed to have always been so charged.

metadata.title: The Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the release on probation of offenders in certain cases and addresses matters incidental thereto. It empowers specific courts to make orders discharging offenders conditionally or granting probation, subject to bonds and good behavior.

metadata.title: The Professions Tax Limitation Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a maximum limit of one hundred thousand rupees per annum for taxes imposed on professions, trades, callings, or employments by Provincial Assemblies. It clarifies that such taxes shall not be regarded as improvements to income tax and validates levies made after July 1, 1977, provided they do not exceed the fixed limit.

name: Prohibitation of Smoking and Protection of Non-Smokers Health Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Prohibition of Smoking and Protection of Non-Smokers Health Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits smoking and other tobacco uses in places of public work or use and in public service vehicles to protect the health of non-smokers. It empowers the Federal Government to declare no-smoking zones, authorize officers to enforce rules, ban tobacco advertisements, restrict sales to minors, and impose penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order modifies the existing law regarding the prohibition of intoxicants to align with Islamic injunctions from the Holy Qur'an and Sunnah. It establishes penalties for manufacturing, selling, or possessing intoxicants, defines specific terms like 'intoxicant' and 'hadd', and outlines procedures for licensing and enforcement.

name: Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Work Place Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to protect women from harassment at the workplace in Pakistan. It establishes mechanisms including an Inquiry Committee and an Ombudsperson to handle complaints regarding sexual advances, stalking, or gender-based discrimination that interfere with work performance.

name: Protection of Breast Feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection of breast-feeding and adequate nutrition for infants and young children in Pakistan. It regulates the marketing and promotion of designated products, including breast milk substitutes and feeding equipment, while establishing a National Infant Feeding Board to oversee implementation.

name: Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance protects properties belonging to minority communities in Pakistan that are meant for their communal use. It prohibits the sale, purchase, or transfer of such properties without a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Federal Government and establishes penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The Protection of Economic Reforms Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal protection for economic reforms introduced by the Government to create a liberal environment for savings and investments. It overrides conflicting provisions in other laws and grants specific freedoms regarding foreign currency transactions, tax immunities for foreign accounts, and protections for fiscal incentives and private sector ownership transfers.

name: Protection of Journalists and Media Professionals Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Protection of Journalists and Media Professionals Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal and institutional framework to promote, protect, and ensure the independence, impartiality, safety, and freedom of expression for journalists and media professionals in Pakistan. It creates an Independent Commission to investigate threats, combat impunity, and provide redress against harassment or violence directed at these professionals.

metadata.title: The Protection of Pakistan Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for protection against waging war or insurrection against Pakistan and the prevention of acts threatening its security. It establishes special courts, defines specific terms like 'militant' and 'scheduled offence', and outlines powers for armed forces to prevent such offences.

metadata.title: The Protection of Ports (Special Measures) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides special measures to ensure the protection of ports in Pakistan by allowing the Federal Government to declare protected areas and regulate entry. It empowers the government to make rules restricting admission, removing persons, and dealing with suspicious loitering near these areas.

metadata.title: The Provident Funds Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the law relating to Government and other Provident Funds. It defines key terms such as compulsory deposits, contributions, and dependants while establishing protections against attachment or assignment of these funds.

metadata.title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance introduces a scheme of social security to provide benefits to employees or their dependents in cases of sickness, maternity, employment injury, or death. It establishes the Employees' Social Security Institution and outlines its management, contributions, finance, audit, and various benefit structures including medical care and pensions.

name: Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation to promote economic and industrial development. It defines the Corporation's structure, including its share capital, management by a Board of Directors, and operational powers.

metadata.title: The Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to insolvency as administered by courts outside the Karachi Division. It establishes procedures for petitions, adjudication of insolvency, administration of property, and the discharge of debtors.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the licensing of drivers, registration of motor vehicles, and the issuance of transport permits in Pakistan. It also outlines regulations regarding traffic control, vehicle maintenance standards, and specific offences related to driving and vehicle usage.

name: Provincial Service Tribunals (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Provincial Service Tribunals (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of clause (2) of Article 212 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to Provincial Service Tribunals. It was enacted in response to requests from the Provincial Assemblies of Balochistan, North-West Frontier Province, Punjab, and Sind.

metadata.title: The Provisional Collection of Taxes Act, 1931
metadata.repeals: The Provisional Collection of Taxes Act, 1931 (by the Repealing Act, 1938)
metadata.summary: This Act provides the legal framework for giving immediate effect to provisions in Bills relating to customs, excise, or sales taxes before they are formally enacted. It empowers the Federal Government to make declarations allowing such tax measures to take effect immediately while the Bill is pending in the Central Legislature. The Act also outlines procedures for refunds or demands if declared provisions cease to have force of law or are amended.

metadata.title: The Public Accountants' Default Act, 1850
metadata.summary: This Act requires public accountants to provide security for the discharge of their office trusts and the proper accounting of moneys under their control. It defines who constitutes a 'public accountant' and outlines procedures for prosecuting them and their sureties in cases of loss or defalcation, applying land-revenue recovery laws to such proceedings.

metadata.title: The Public Debt Act, 1944
