metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Government securities and the management of public debt. It defines key terms such as 'Government security' and establishes procedures for transferring, holding, and determining title to these securities.

metadata.title: The Public Finance Management Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act strengthens the management of public finances to improve fiscal policy definition and implementation for better macroeconomic management. It clarifies institutional responsibilities related to financial management and regulates the custody, payment into, and withdrawal from the Federal Consolidated Fund and Public Account.

metadata.title: The Public Gambling Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the punishment of public gambling and the keeping of common gaming-houses in the Punjab. It establishes penalties for owning gaming houses, being found therein, and giving false information, while also defining the powers of police to enter and search suspected premises.

metadata.title: The Public Health (Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes special provisions to prevent the spread of human disease and safeguard public health during an emergency. It empowers the appropriate Government to direct local authorities, appoint additional health staff, assume superintendence of services, and take over administration where necessary.

metadata.title: The Public Investments (Financial Safeguards) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes financial safeguards for corporations, institutions, or undertakings established with the aid of public revenues. It empowers the appropriate Government to prescribe financial procedures, issue directions, scrutinize transactions, and call for documents to ensure compliance.

metadata.title: The Public Order (Meetings) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the preservation of public order during public meetings and aims to prevent disturbances at such events. It defines specific offenses including disorderly conduct, carrying offensive weapons, and using insulting language intended to provoke a breach of the peace.

metadata.title: The Public Order (Political Uniforms) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the wearing of uniforms in connection with political purposes and prevents private persons from maintaining associations with a military or semi-military character. It defines specific offences related to marching in military order, wearing political uniforms, and managing quasi-military groups, while also outlining punishments and exceptions for ceremonial occasions.

metadata.title: The Public Private Partnership Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Public Private Partnership Authority to create an enabling environment for development projects in Pakistan. It provides a regulatory framework to promote private sector participation in public infrastructure and service delivery.

metadata.title: The Public Procurement Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority to regulate the procurement of goods, services, works, and the disposal of public assets in the public sector. It defines key terms such as 'goods', 'works', and 'public procurement' and outlines the authority's functions, management structure, financial provisions, and regulatory powers.

name: Publication of Laws of Pakistan Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Publication of Laws of Pakistan Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication of the text of the laws of Pakistan is free from errors of reproduction, updating, and printing. It establishes a Laws of Pakistan Cell to review publications and register publishers, while exempting public sector organizations and legislatures from registration but requiring them to maintain internal checks.

name: Publication of the Holy Quran (Elimination of Printing Errors) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Publication of the Holy Quran (Elimination of Printing Errors) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication of the Holy Quran text free from printing errors and establishes a regulatory framework for publishers and recording companies. It creates a Quran Board to authenticate standard copies and supervise error-free printing, while defining specific requirements for paper, layout, and quality control.

metadata.title: The Punjab Laws Act, 1872
metadata.summary: This Act declares which rules, laws, and regulations previously made for the Punjab have the force of law. It also serves to amend, consolidate, or repeal other existing rules, orders, and regulations within the territory.

metadata.title: The Qanun-e-Shahadat, 1984
metadata.summary: This Act codifies the law relating to evidence in Pakistan. It outlines rules regarding the relevancy of facts, competence of witnesses, admissions, and documentary evidence.

metadata.title: The Quaid-e-Azam University Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the University of Islamabad to improve its administration. It establishes the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, statutes, and regulations.

metadata.title: The Quaid-i-Azam's Mazar (Protection and Maintenance) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection and maintenance of the Quaid-i-Azam's Mazar in Karachi. It declares the site a national historical monument, vests it in the Federal Government, and prohibits meetings, weapons, and acts derogatory to its sanctity within specific boundaries.

metadata.title: The Railway Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Railway Regulatory Authority to foster competition and encourage private sector investment in Pakistan's railway network. It provides for the exclusive power to grant licenses, regulates track access agreements, and outlines the enforcement mechanisms and budgetary provisions for the Authority.

metadata.title: The Railway Stores (Unlawful Possession) Ordinance, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes special provision for punishing the offence of unlawful possession of railway stores. It applies to the whole of Pakistan and came into force immediately upon promulgation.

metadata.title: The Railways (Local Authorities' Taxation) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the extent to which railway property vested in the Federal Government is liable to taxation imposed by local authorities within a Province. It establishes that such liability exists only if declared by a notification in the official Gazette and outlines the process for determining fair sums in lieu of specific taxes.

metadata.title: The Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act confers special powers for a limited period to regulate the transport of goods on railways. It grants the Federal Government authority to issue directions regarding priority transport or refusal to carry specific goods based on urgent public interest.

metadata.title: The Railways Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for railways in Punjab, covering preliminary definitions, inspection, construction, and maintenance of railway works. It further regulates traffic facilities, working conditions for passengers and goods, responsibilities of licensees, accident reporting, and various penalties and offences related to railway operations.

metadata.title: The Railways Order, 1962
metadata.repeals: Railway Board Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order transfers railways from the Federal Government to Provincial Governments or authorities in accordance with Article 233 of the Constitution. It establishes the constitution, powers, and functions of the Railway Board for each Province, including provisions for track access agreements and rail development.

name: Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreement and Foreign Arbitral) Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Act, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the recognition and enforcement of arbitration agreements and foreign arbitral awards in Pakistan. It aligns domestic law with the United Nations Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards, 1958, by establishing exclusive court jurisdiction and defining procedures for enforcing such awards.

metadata.title: The Recusant Witnesses Act, 1853
metadata.repeals: The Recusant Witnesses Act, 1853 (by Act X of 1861)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law of evidence in the civil courts of the Bengal Presidency regarding the summoning and attendance of witnesses. It establishes liabilities for damages against persons who neglect, refuse, or abscond to avoid service of summons or fail to give evidence.

metadata.title: The Reformatory Schools Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Reformatory Schools and provides further provisions for dealing with youthful offenders. It establishes the powers of the Provincial Government to create, maintain, and manage these schools while defining requirements for inmate care and industrial training.

name:
Regional Development Finance Corporation and Small Business Finance Corporation
(Amalgamation and Conversion) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Regional Development Finance Corporation and Small Business Finance Corporation (Amalgamation and Conversion) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the amalgamation of the Regional Development Finance Corporation and the Small Business Finance Corporation into a single public limited company. It outlines the transfer of assets, liabilities, contracts, and proceedings from the original entities to the newly formed company.

name: Regional Development Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1985(Repeal by ord.LVi of 2001,s.14(w.e.f 01-01-2002))

metadata.title: The Regional Development Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Regional Development Finance Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the corporation's authorized and paid-up share capital, specifying contributions from the National Development Finance Corporation and nationalized banks. The document also outlines the governance structure involving a Board of Directors and the Federal Government's authority to provide policy directions.

metadata.title: The Registered Designs Ordinance, 2000
metadata.repeals: law relating to industrial designs
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the law relating to the protection of industrial designs in Pakistan. It establishes the Patent Office, defines registerable designs and proprietorship, outlines registration proceedings, and sets out offences and penalties related to design infringement.

name: Registered Layout-Designs of Integrated Circuits Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Registered Layout-Designs of Integrated Circuits Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal system for the registration and protection of layout-designs of integrated circuits in Pakistan. It defines originality requirements, assigns rights to creators or employers, and outlines unlawful acts such as unauthorized reproduction.

metadata.title: The Registration Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for the registration of documents in Pakistan, defining compulsory and optional registration requirements. It outlines the duties of registering officers, procedures for presenting wills and land documents, fee structures, and penalties for offenses related to the registration process.

metadata.title: The Registration of Foreigners Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of foreigners entering, being present in, and departing from Pakistan. It establishes definitions, powers to make rules regarding reporting requirements, penalties for non-compliance, and protections for persons acting under the Act.

name: Regulation of Generation Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for regulating the generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power in Pakistan. It creates the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority to ensure transparent and effective regulation of the electricity market.

name: Regulation of Mines and Oil Fields and Mineral Development (Federal Control) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Regulation of Mines and Oil fields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters connected with the regulation of mines and oil fields under government control in Pakistan. It empowers the appropriate Government to make rules regarding exploration licenses, mining leases, production controls, and royalty rates.

metadata.title: The Religious Societies Act, 1880
metadata.summary: This Act simplifies the manner in which religious worship bodies may hold property acquired for such purposes. It provides mechanisms for appointing new trustees, dissolving societies, and adjusting their affairs without requiring formal conveyance.

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000. It ensures that pending proceedings under the repealed Ordinance continue while future disciplinary matters for government servants are governed by the Civil Servants Act, 1973.

metadata.title: The Removal of Accused Persons Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the removal of accused persons from one Province to another within Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to issue general or special orders regarding such transfers, overriding any other existing laws.

metadata.title: The System of Sardari (Abolition) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The System of Sardari, (Abolition) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the system of Sardari, which is described as a remnant of an oppressive feudal and tribal system in Pakistan. It prohibits recognized Sardars from exercising unauthorized judicial powers, maintaining private jails, arresting people without legal cause, demanding tribute, or claiming benefits from tribal land.

metadata.title: The Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of certain emergency powers regarding requisitioned land after the Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1965 ceases to have effect. It empowers the appropriate Government to use, deal with, release from requisition, or acquire such lands in specified circumstances.

metadata.title: The Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of certain emergency powers regarding requisitioned land after the repeal of the Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971. It outlines procedures for releasing land from requisition, determining compensation, and obtaining necessary information.

metadata.title: The Reservists (Reinstatement in Civil Employment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reinstatement in civil employment of reservists who were called up for service or training in any Defence Service. It mandates that employers must reinstate such reservists upon their release from service, subject to specific conditions regarding application timelines and exemptions granted by the Federal Government.

metadata.title: The Revenue Recovery Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides better provisions for recovering certain public demands, specifically focusing on land-revenue arrears. It outlines the procedures for Collectors to enforce recovery processes in districts other than where the demand originated and defines the liabilities of defaulters.

metadata.title: The Revocation of Privileges Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act revokes and annuls several Bills passed by the National Assembly on May 3, 1992, regarding salaries and privileges. The legislation declares these specific bills withdrawn and of no legal effect as per a unanimous resolution adopted by the National Assembly on May 7, 1992.

name: Rice Milling Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Rice Milling Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Rice Milling Control and Development Act, 1976 (LVIII of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Rice Milling Control and Development Act, 1976. It provides for the return of establishments to previous management, the continuance of employees in service, and compensation payments by the Corporation.

name: Right of Access to Information Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Right of Access to Information Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the right of citizens to access information held by public bodies in a transparent and effective manner. It aims to promote government accountability, reduce corruption, and improve participation in public affairs while subjecting this right to reasonable restrictions imposed by law.

name: Right to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Right to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the fundamental right to free and compulsory education for all children aged five to sixteen years in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It outlines the obligations of the appropriate Government to provide infrastructure, ensure admission without discrimination, and regulate school standards while defining terms related to fees, parents, and special education needs.

name: Riot and Civil Commotion Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1947

metadata.title: The Riot and Civil Commotion Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the insurance of certain property against risks arising from riots and civil commotions. It defines insurable properties, ownership rules, and establishes a specific fund to manage these risks while excluding losses caused by war or cessation of work.

metadata.title: The Riphah International University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Riphah International University in Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and Board of Governors, while outlining powers for instruction, research, examinations, and degree conferral.

metadata.title: The Road Transport Workers Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the hours of work and other employment conditions for road transport workers in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'worker', 'employer', and 'road transport service' while establishing limits on daily working hours, rest intervals, and age requirements for drivers.

name: Royal Pakistan Navy (Extension of Service) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Pakistan Navy (Extension of Service) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the retention in service of certain persons enrolled for service in the Pakistan Navy after their original term has expired. It stipulates that such personnel shall continue to be liable for service until discharged by the Officer Commanding, provided the extension does not exceed five years.

name: Rulers of Acceding States (Abolition of Privy Purses and Privileges) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Rulers of Acceding States (Abolition of Privy Purses and Privileges) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order abolishes the privy purses and other privileges granted to the Rulers of Acceding States. It establishes a maintenance allowance in lieu of these abolished benefits, subject to conditions regarding allegiance to Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Rules and Regulations Continuance Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance in force of certain rules made under the Electricity Act, 1910 and regulations made under the Boilers Act, 1923. It deems these pre-1937 rules and regulations to have been made by the authority substituted for the Governor General in Council and allows them to remain in force until superseded.

metadata.title: Rules of Business, 1973
metadata.summary: These rules govern the business of the Federal Government of Pakistan, detailing procedures for the Cabinet, legislation, and relations with Parliament. They establish the organization of government divisions and outline protocols for inter-divisional consultation and emergency situations.

metadata.title: The Sacked Employees (Re instatement) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to persons in corporation, autonomous, semi-autonomous body, or Government service who were dismissed, removed, or terminated between November 1996 and October 1999. It establishes a Review Board to handle petitions regarding the re-instatement of sacked employees and outlines procedures for regularization of their service.

metadata.title: The Safeguard Measures Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides a legal framework for the imposition of safeguard measures in Pakistan to address serious injury or threat thereof caused by increased imports. It establishes procedures for investigation, determination of injury, and the application of duties or quotas, while aligning with Article XIX of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade.

metadata.title: The Sale of Goods Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to the sale of goods in Pakistan. It establishes preliminary provisions, contract formation rules, effects on property transfer, performance duties, unpaid seller rights, breach remedies, and miscellaneous clauses.

name: Sales Tax Act, 1990 (Same as on the official website of FBR dated 30-06-2026)

metadata.title: Sales Tax Act, 1990
metadata.number: III of 1951 as Amended by Act VII of 1990
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Sales Tax Act, 1990, which governs the scope, payment, and collection of sales tax in Pakistan. It details requirements for registration, record-keeping, invoicing, and the filing of returns by registered persons.

metadata.title: The Saraís Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of public Sarais and Puraos, defining their use for traveller accommodation. It establishes requirements for registering keepers, maintaining registers, and adhering to specific duties regarding cleanliness, security, and reporting infectious diseases.

name: Secretariat Allowance (Rescission of Orders, etc) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Secretariat Allowance (Rescission of Orders, etc.) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance rescinds certain orders and instruments that granted Secretariat Allowance to Federal Government employees. It deems these orders as having been rescinded since July 1, 1988, and prevents the recovery of already paid allowances.

metadata.title: The Securities Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Government securities issued by Federal or Provincial Governments. It defines key terms such as 'Government security' and establishes rules regarding notices of trust, rights of survivors for joint payees, endorsements, and the issuance of duplicate or renewed securities.

metadata.title: The Securities Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the regulatory framework for securities exchanges, clearing houses, and central depository companies in Pakistan. It outlines licensing requirements, duties of regulated entities, standards of conduct, and procedures for public offers and takeovers.

name: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan to regulate capital markets and supervise corporate entities. It outlines the commission's structure, powers, functions, and provisions for investigation, enforcement, and audit oversight.

name: Securities and Exchange Ordinance, 1969 (Repealed by Act XIV of 2016)

metadata.title: Securities and Exchange Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection of investors and the regulation of markets and dealings in securities within Pakistan. It establishes definitions for key terms such as brokers, banks, and central depositories to facilitate uniform federal legislation on these matters.

metadata.title: The Security of Pakistan Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides special measures to deal with persons acting in a manner prejudicial to the defence, external affairs, and security of Pakistan. It grants the Federal Government powers to restrict movements, detain suspected individuals, control subversive associations, and regulate publications.

metadata.title: The Seed Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for controlling and regulating the quality of seeds of various crop varieties in Pakistan. It establishes the National Seed Development and Regulatory Authority, along with Federal and Provincial bodies responsible for certification, registration, and inspection.

metadata.title: The Senate (Election) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conduct of elections to the Senate and related matters. It establishes administrative machinery, outlines election procedures including nomination and polling, defines offences and penalties, and sets up tribunals to handle election disputes.

metadata.title: The Senate Secretariat Services Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment and terms and conditions of service for persons employed in the Senate Secretariat. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'post', and 'pay scales' while establishing that other service conditions follow Federal Government laws unless specified otherwise.

metadata.title: The Service Tribunals Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Service Tribunals to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for civil servants. It defines the composition, appointment, and powers of these tribunals, including provisions for appeals from departmental authorities.

metadata.title: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain orders passed by Settlement Commissioners that were previously declared or rendered invalid. It deems these specific orders to have been validly made and effective from March 26, 1958, notwithstanding any conflicting decrees or the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958.

name: Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University, Islamabad, Act, 2013

metadata.title: The Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University, Islamabad, Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and incorporates the Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University in Islamabad as an autonomous body corporate. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council, while outlining their respective functions and powers.

metadata.title: The Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University at Islamabad as a non-profitable body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, officers, and authorities.

metadata.title: The Short Titles Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act assigns short titles to specific Martial Law Regulations and Martial Law Orders that were deemed Acts under the Interim Constitution. It facilitates legal reference by listing existing titles alongside their new, shorter citations in a schedule.

metadata.title: The Sikh Gurdwaras (Supplementary) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act serves to supplement specific provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925. It validates certain sections of the main Act regarding the jurisdiction and procedure of the High Court at Lahore as if they were passed by the Central Legislature.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to co-operative societies in the Province of Sind. It establishes provisions for registration, member rights and liabilities, duties of societies, liquidation processes, and offences.

metadata.title: The Sind Textile Board Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance incorporates and regulates the Sind Textile Board as a trading corporation in Sind. Its purpose is to improve the procurement and wholesale distribution of cloth within the region.

metadata.title: The Sindh Incumbered Estates Act, 1896
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the relief of jagirdars and zamindars in Sindh who are subject to debts or liabilities. It establishes procedures for applying for relief, conducting inquiries into debts, appointing managers, and creating liquidation schemes for the distribution of assets.

metadata.title: The Sindh Revenue Jurisdiction Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act limits the jurisdiction of Civil Courts in Sindh and the Karachi Division regarding matters connected with land-revenue. It also provides for amending specific sections of the Sindh Civil Courts Act and reviving certain provisions from an earlier Bombay Code regulation.

name: Sir Syed-CASE (Center for Advanced Studies in Engineering) lnstitute of Technology Islamabad Act 2018

metadata.title: The Sir Syed-CASE (Center for Advanced Studies in Engineering) Institute of Technology, Islamabad Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sir Syed-CASE (Center for Advanced Studies in Engineering) Institute of Technology, Islamabad as a body corporate. It provides for the institute's establishment, incorporation, powers, purposes, functions, and its governance structure including various authorities and committees.

name: Small and Medium Exterprises Development Authority Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Small and Medium Enterprises Development Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Small and Medium Enterprises Development Authority as an autonomous body under the Federal Government of Pakistan. Its purpose is to encourage and facilitate the development and growth of small and medium enterprises through policy making and the provision of resources and support services.

name: Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and enacts the law relating to small claims and minor offences to ensure their inexpensive and expeditious disposal. It establishes Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts presided over by a Civil Judge-cum-Judicial Magistrate with jurisdiction over suits not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees and specified offences.

name: Smart Institute of Science and Technology Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Smart Institute of Sciences & Technology Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Smart Institute of Sciences & Technology in the private sector at Rawalpindi. It outlines the institute's structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies such as the Board of Governors and Syndicate.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration Act, 1860
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of literary, scientific, and charitable societies formed by seven or more persons. It outlines requirements for a memorandum of association, registration fees, annual filing of managing body lists, and provisions regarding property, suits, and dissolution of such societies.

metadata.title: The Soldiers (Litigation) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law to provide special protection for soldiers serving under special or war conditions in civil and revenue litigation. It defines specific circumstances under which a soldier is deemed to be serving under such conditions, including service overseas, in designated areas like Kashmir or Northern Areas, or during declared hostilities.

name: South Asian Strategic Stability Institute University Islamabad Act, 2013

metadata.title: The South Asian Strategic Stability Institute University Islamabad Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the South Asian Strategic Stability Institute (SASSI) University in Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities like the Board of Governors and Academic Council, and outlines its powers to acquire property and conduct academic programs.

name: Special Courts for Speedy Trials (Repeal) Act, 1996

metadata.title: The Special Courts for Speedy Trials (Repeal) Act, 1996
metadata.repeals: The Special Courts for Speedy Trials Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Special Courts for Speedy Trials Act, 1992. It provides for the transfer of pending cases and appeals from the repealed Special Courts to respective Courts of Session or High Courts.

metadata.title: The Special Economic Zones Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the creation, development, and efficient operation of special economic zones in Pakistan. It establishes a legal framework to encourage domestic and international investors by defining authorities, approval processes, developer responsibilities, and applicable incentives.

metadata.title: The Special Marriage Act, 1872
metadata.summary: This Act provides a specific form of marriage for persons who do not profess certain religions or for those who do, while also legalizing marriages with doubtful validity. It outlines conditions such as age limits, consent requirements, and prohibitions on consanguinity, along with procedures for notice, registration, and solemnization.

metadata.title: The Special Technology Zones Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Special Technology Zones Authority to develop a scientific and technological ecosystem in Pakistan. It aims to accelerate technology development, attract foreign direct investment, and foster collaboration between academia and industry through designated zones.

metadata.title: The Specific Relief Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to specific relief obtainable in civil suits. It covers topics such as recovering possession of property, specific performance of contracts, rectification of instruments, rescission, cancellation, declaratory decrees, and injunctions.

metadata.title: The Sports (Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the development and control of sports throughout Pakistan. It establishes a Board to promote uniform standards of competition and grants the Board the exclusive right to make rules for sports control.

metadata.title: The Stage-Carriages Act, 1861
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the licensing and regulation of stage carriages used to convey passengers for hire in Pakistan. It establishes powers for Magistrates to grant or refuse licenses, sets charges and durations for such licenses, and defines penalties for operating unlicensed carriages or violating specific conditions.

metadata.title: The Stamp Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to stamps in Pakistan. It defines instruments chargeable with duty, outlines how duties are paid using adhesive or impressed stamps, and establishes procedures for adjudication on unstamped instruments.

metadata.title: The Standard Time (Interpretation of References) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.repeals: The Standard Time (Interpretation of References) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the interpretation of references to Standard Time in enactments currently in force in Pakistan. It stipulates that such references must be interpreted based on the current order of the Federal Government fixing Standard Time, rather than a fixed interval of five and one-half hours from Greenwich Mean Time.

metadata.title: The Standards of Weight Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act establishes standards of weight throughout Pakistan. It defines the standard grain as the primary unit and specifies various derived units such as the tola, seer, maund, pound, ounce, hundredweight, and ton.

metadata.title: The Staple Cotton (Excise Duty) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of excise duty on staple cotton produced by ginning factories and sold to textile mills. It establishes specific rates for public and private sector factories, outlines the manner of payment, and grants exemptions under special circumstances.

metadata.title: The State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the State Bank of Pakistan. It outlines the bank's constitution, functions, and powers to regulate the monetary and credit system while contributing to financial stability.

name: State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) Banking Services Corporation Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The SBP Banking Services Corporation Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the SBP Banking Services Corporation as a subsidiary of the State Bank of Pakistan. It provides for the transfer of specific undertakings and employees from the State Bank to the new corporation and outlines the management, control, and functions of the Bank.

metadata.title: The State Immunity Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the immunity of States from the jurisdiction of Courts in Pakistan. It establishes general immunity rules while defining specific exceptions for commercial transactions, employment contracts, and submissions to jurisdiction.

metadata.title: The State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes principles for the governance and operations of state-owned enterprises owned and controlled by the Federal Government. It aims to ensure effective management, financial efficiency, and accountability in service delivery and fiscal discipline.

name: Stock Exchange (Corporatisation, Demutualization and Integration) Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Stock Exchanges (Corporatisation, Demutualization and Integration) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the corporatisation and demutualization of stock exchanges in Pakistan to facilitate their development. It also establishes provisions for the integration of these exchanges and matters ancillary thereto.

metadata.title: The Succession Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the succession to property of deceased persons in Pakistan, covering both moveable and immoveable assets. It establishes rules for intestate succession for various groups, including Parsis, and provides comprehensive provisions regarding the execution, attestation, revocation, and interpretation of wills.

metadata.title: The Sugar Export Subsidy Fund Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sugar Export Subsidy Fund to promote the export of sugar. It provides for the levy of sales tax and excise duty on sugar-cane and sugar, which are credited to the fund after deducting collection costs. The document also outlines powers for contract registration, information gathering, and penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Sugar-cane Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the price of sugar-cane intended for use in sugar factories to assure growers a fair price. It empowers Provincial Governments to declare controlled areas, fix minimum purchase prices, and prohibit unauthorized purchases.

metadata.title: The Suits Valuation Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes the mode for valuing certain suits to determine the jurisdiction of courts. It specifically addresses suits relating to land and other suits, establishing rules for how relief value is calculated against land value.

name: Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order (Repeal) Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order (Repeal) Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order, 1980. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act determines the number of judges for the Supreme Court of Pakistan. It specifies that the maximum number of judges, excluding the Chief Justice, shall be up to thirty-three.

metadata.title: The Supreme Court (Practice and Procedure) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the practices and procedures for the Supreme Court of Pakistan, including the constitution of Benches and the handling of Constitutional matters. It grants parties the right to appoint counsel of their choice for review applications and mandates the recording of proceedings with certified transcripts.

name: Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates and strengthens the Supreme Court of Pakistan in exercising its powers to review judgments and orders. It enlarges the court's jurisdiction under Article 188, ensures a larger bench for review petitions, grants petitioners the right to appoint counsel, and sets specific limitation periods for filing reviews.

name: Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to certain Tribal Areas) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to certain Tribal Areas) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Ordinance, 1981 (XXVII of 1981)
metadata.summary: This Act extends the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and the Peshawar High Court to specific Provincially Administered Tribal Areas, including Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat, and Malakand Protected Area. It grants these courts the same authority in these tribal regions as they possess in other areas of the North-West Frontier Province.

name: Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act extends the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of Pakistan and the Peshawar High Court to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It grants these courts the same jurisdiction in FATA as they possess in relation to the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

metadata.title: The Surrender of Illicit Arms Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the surrender of illicit arms to improve law and order situations in Pakistan. It defines various types of illicit arms, including cannons, explosives, and firearms, and mandates their surrender by persons in possession or control. The legislation also outlines punishments for contravention, including imprisonment and forfeiture of property.

name: Survey for Documentation of National Economy Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Survey for Documentation of National Economy Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the documentation of the national economy to address large-scale non-reporting and under-reporting of assets, income, and taxable activities. It empowers the Central Board of Revenue to constitute survey teams comprising government officials and other agencies to collect information via specific questionnaires for tax assessment purposes.

metadata.title: The Surveying and Mapping Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and regulation of the Survey of Pakistan. It establishes the legal framework for surveying and mapping activities, including the management and security of geospatial data within the country.

metadata.title: The System of Sardari (Abolition) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The System of Sardari, (Abolition) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the oppressive system of Sardari prevalent in certain parts of Pakistan to uphold human dignity and democratic values. It prohibits recognized Sardars from exercising unauthorized judicial powers, maintaining private jails, arresting individuals, taking free labor, or demanding tribute.

name: Tea (Control of Prices, Distribution and Movement) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Tea (Control of Prices, Distribution and Movement) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides special measures for the control of prices, distribution, and movement of tea within Pakistan. It establishes a registration system for dealers such as bidders, blenders, importers, wholesalers, and retailers, while granting powers to refuse, suspend, or cancel registrations for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Tea Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes measures to expand tea exports and promote the tea industry in Pakistan. It creates bodies like the Pakistan Tea Board and Tea Development Committee to establish new gardens, rehabilitate derelict ones, and levy a cess on tea production.

metadata.title: The Tea Plantations Labour Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the welfare of labour and regulates working conditions specifically within tea plantations in Pakistan. It establishes the roles of inspectors, defines terms related to workers and employment, and sets out provisions regarding hours of work, leave, medical facilities, and penalties for contraventions.

metadata.title: The Telegraph Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to telegraphs in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'telegraph', 'message', and 'telegraph authority', and grants the government exclusive privileges regarding telegraph operations, including the power to grant licenses, take possession of lines, and intercept messages.

name: Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones Act, 1976 (Repealed by Act.XVIII of 2023)

metadata.title: The Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act declares the territorial waters and maritime zones of Pakistan, defining sovereignty over air space, bed, and subsoil. It establishes limits for territorial waters at twelve nautical miles and defines the contiguous zone extending to twenty-four nautical miles. The legislation also outlines rights regarding foreign ship passage, continental shelf resources, and sovereign jurisdiction.

metadata.title: The Terrorist Affected Areas (Special Courts) Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the suppression of acts of terrorism, subversion, and other heinous offences in designated terrorist affected areas. It establishes special courts with specific jurisdictions and grants expanded powers to police and civil armed forces within these zones.

name: THE CENSUS ORDINANCE, 1959(Repealed by Act XiV of 2011 section 63 (w.e.f 31-05-2011)))

metadata.title: The Census Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the periodic taking of a census in Pakistan to gather information regarding the population and housing conditions. It establishes the legal framework for appointing Census Officers, defining their duties, and empowering authorities to assist in data collection.

metadata.title: The Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Family Courts in Pakistan to expedite the settlement of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs. It defines the jurisdiction of these courts, outlines the qualifications for judges, and specifies that certain provisions of other laws do not apply to suits pending before the coming into force of this Act.

name: The International Islamic Institute for Peace (IIIP) Act, 2024

metadata.title: The International Islamic Institute for Peace (IIIP) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the International Islamic Institute for Peace (IIIP) as a body corporate in the private sector with campuses at Islamabad and Narowal. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, officers, and governing authorities.

name: THE MARKETING OF PETROLEUM PRODUCTS (FEDERAL CONTROL) ACT, 1974.(Repealed by ord.89 of 02 s.3)

metadata.title: The Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and development of marketing facilities in petroleum products under federal control. It empowers the Federal Government to take over the management or acquire shares of marketing companies deemed necessary for public interest.

metadata.title: The Tolls (Army and Air Force) Act, 1901
metadata.amends: law relating to the exemption from tolls of persons and property belonging to the Army or Air Force
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the exemption from the payment of certain duties or tolls for officers, soldiers, airmen, and their property belonging to the Pakistan Army or Air Force. It defines specific terms such as 'carriage', 'ferry', and 'tolls' within the context of military logistics and establishes penalties and compensation mechanisms.

metadata.title: The Tolls Act, 1851
metadata.repeals: Repealed by the Repealing Act, 1870 (XIV of 1870)
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Government to levy tolls on public roads and bridges made or repaired at the expense of the Federal Government. It outlines the powers for collecting and recovering these tolls, including seizure and sale of property for non-payment, as well as exemptions and penalties for offenses.

name: Torture and Custodial Death (Prevention and Punishment) Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Torture and Custodial Death (Prevention and Punishment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides protection to persons during custody from acts of torture perpetrated by public officials. It defines key terms such as torture, custodial death, and public official, and establishes provisions for the inadmissibility of statements extracted through torture.

metadata.title: The Toshakhana (Management and Regulation) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and regulation of the Toshakhana, which serves as a repository for gifts received by public office holders and private members of official delegations. It mandates that such gifts be deposited within thirty days and establishes rules for their disposal through open auction, with proceeds designated to promote female primary education in backward areas.

name: Trade Development authority of Pakistan Act, 2013

metadata.title: The Trade Development Authority of Pakistan Act, 2013
metadata.repeals: Export Promotion Bureau
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan within the Ministry of Commerce to promote and develop exports. It defines the structure of the Authority, including its Board, Chief Executive, and Secretary, while outlining their powers, functions, and financial provisions.

metadata.title: The Trade Dispute Resolution Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive regime in Pakistan for the swift and effective resolution of disputes relating to the export and import of goods and services, including e-commerce. It creates the Trade Dispute Resolution Commission (TDRC) with exclusive jurisdiction over international trade disputes and provides for alternative dispute resolution mechanisms such as conciliation and arbitration.

metadata.title: The Trade Marks Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This document outlines the legal framework for the registration, protection, and enforcement of trademarks in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for application, opposition, renewal, and remedies for infringement, including provisions for customs seizure and unfair competition.

metadata.title: The Trade Organizations Act, 2013
metadata.repeals: The Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and regulation of trade organizations in Pakistan. It aims to ensure appropriate representation of all genders and business sectors while defining the operational framework and code of corporate governance for these entities.

metadata.title: The Traffic Offences (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Special Courts in Pakistan to ensure the speedy disposal of cases related to traffic offences. It defines the composition of these courts, which can include local dignitaries, council members, advocates, or magistrates, and grants them specific powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure.

metadata.title: The Trained Paramedical Staff Facility Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the facility of trained paramedical staff in public and private educational institutions to ensure immediate medical assistance and first aid. It mandates that both Federal and private institutions must provide such staff, outlines penalties for non-compliance including fines and imprisonment, and grants the Federal Government powers to make rules and remove difficulties.

metadata.title: The Tramways Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the construction and regulates the working of tramways. It defines local authorities, roads, and road-authorities, and outlines procedures for obtaining orders to construct tramways.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transfer to India of certain deposits belonging to evacuees and the reception in Pakistan of similar deposits belonging to refugees. It establishes the appointment of a Custodian and Assistant Custodians to manage these transfers and defines key terms such as 'deposit', 'evacuee', and 'refugee'.

name: Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transfer of certain evacuee land to the occupants thereof in Katchi Abadi areas. It cancels previous allotments and transfers, grants proprietary rights to eligible occupants upon payment of a determined price, and allows for the resumption of any remaining land.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Offenders Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of citizens convicted in foreign countries to Pakistan and vice versa. It establishes the Competent Authority within the Ministry of Interior to manage applications and warrants related to these transfers based on mutual agreements.

name: Transfer of Population Welfare Programme (Field Activities) Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: The Transfer of Population Welfare Programme (Field Activities) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of field activities of the Population Welfare Programme from the Federal Government to the Provincial Governments. It defines specific responsibilities, ensuring that while provinces handle field implementation, the federal government retains control over national policy, planning, and coordination.

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act defines the legal framework for transferring property, whether moveable or immoveable, by act of parties. It specifically governs sales, mortgages, and leases of immovable property while establishing rights and liabilities for buyers, sellers, mortgagors, and mortgagees.

name: Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissue Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of removal, storage, and transplantation of human organs and tissues for therapeutic purposes in Pakistan. It establishes definitions for key terms like 'donor' and 'brain dead', regulates donation by living persons and after death, and sets up an Evaluation Committee and Monitoring Authority to oversee the process.

metadata.title: The Travel Agencies Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development, regulation, and control of the profession of travel agencies in Pakistan. It establishes a regulatory committee, sets out licensing requirements, defines exemptions, and outlines penalties for operating without a license.

metadata.title: The Treasure-trove Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to treasure-trove found in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for notifying collectors when treasure is found, determining ownership rights, and handling cases where claimants fail to appear or disputes arise over ownership.

metadata.title: The Tribal Areas (Restoration of Jurisdiction) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act restores the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and the High Court in relation to the Tribal Areas of the Quetta Division. It also extends limitation periods for matters concerning these areas by excluding the time between January 10, 1964, and the date the Act came into force.

metadata.title: The Trusts Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to private trusts and trustees in Pakistan. It establishes rules for the creation, duties, liabilities, and powers of trustees, as well as the rights of beneficiaries.

name: Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the qualifications and provides for the registration of practitioners of Unani, Ayurvedic, and Homoeopathic systems of medicine in Pakistan. It establishes National Councils to oversee education, research, and the administration of these medical systems.

name: United Nations (Declaration of Death of Missing Persons) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The United Nations (Declaration of Death of Missing Persons) Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the United Nations Convention on the Declaration of Death of Missing Persons within Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to make declarations of death for persons who disappeared after 1945 under circumstances similar to those covered by the Convention, and it incorporates the Convention's provisions into Pakistani law.

metadata.title: The United Nations (Privileges and Immunities) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the Convention on the Privileges and Immunities of the United Nations within Pakistan. It confers specific privileges and immunities upon the UN, its representatives, and officers, while also empowering the Federal Government to extend similar protections to other international organizations.

metadata.title: The United Nations (Security Council) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Federal Government to apply measures under Article 41 of the Charter of the United Nations without using armed force. It grants powers to make rules and delegate authority to Pakistani persons or entities for enforcing these measures.

metadata.title: The University of Islamabad Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Executive Committee, while outlining their respective powers and functions.

metadata.title: The Usurious Loans Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act provides additional powers to courts to handle cases involving usurious loans of money or in kind. It allows courts to reopen transactions, adjust accounts, and relieve debtors from liability regarding excessive interest if the transaction is deemed substantially unfair.

metadata.title: The Vaccination Act, 1880
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Ordinance 27 of 1958
metadata.summary: This Act grants the power to prohibit inoculation and makes the vaccination of children compulsory in specific municipalities and cantonments. It defines key terms such as 'unprotected child' and establishes procedures for vaccination circles, vaccinators, and certificates of insusceptibility.

metadata.title: The Vagrancy (Karachi Division) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal mechanisms for dealing with vagrancy specifically within the Karachi Division. It defines terms such as 'vagrant', 'child', and 'Poor House', and outlines procedures for arrest, inquiry by Special Magistrates, and the subsequent detention or release of individuals found to be vagrants.

metadata.title: The Validation of Laws Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act validates specific President's Orders, Martial Law Regulations, and Ordinances made between March 25, 1969, and December 19, 1971. It declares these laws to have been validly made by the competent authority under clause (I) of Article 270 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Virtual Assets Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a dedicated Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority to license, regulate, and supervise virtual assets and service providers in Pakistan. It provides a comprehensive legal framework aimed at ensuring investor protection, transparency, market integrity, and combating illicit activities such as money laundering and terrorist financing.

metadata.title: Virtual University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the Virtual University of Pakistan with its principal seat at Islamabad. It defines the structure, powers, and functions of the University, including its various councils, boards, and officers.

name: Voluntary Declaration of Domestic Assets Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Voluntary Declaration of Domestic Assets Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the voluntary declaration of undisclosed domestic assets held in Pakistan by citizens and entities, excluding holders of public office. It establishes procedures for declaring assets acquired before April 10, 2018, including valuation methods and tax charges applicable to such declarations.

name: Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and control of voluntary social welfare agencies in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for applying for registration, sets conditions that registered agencies must comply with regarding accounts and reports, and outlines powers for suspension or dissolution.

metadata.title: The War Injuries (Compensation Insurance) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a liability on employers to pay compensation to workmen who sustain war injuries. It also provides for the insurance of employers against such liability and establishes a specific fund for these purposes.

metadata.title: The War Injuries Ordinance, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the grant of relief regarding personal injuries sustained during hostilities. It empowers the Federal Government to make schemes for such relief and defines terms related to civil defence volunteers and war injuries.

metadata.title: The War Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the insurance of certain goods and property in Pakistan against war risks. It establishes a scheme for compulsory insurance of goods, factories, and buildings while defining key terms such as 'factory', 'goods', and 'Fund'.

metadata.title: The Waste Lands (Claims) Act, 1863
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the speedy adjudication of claims to waste lands proposed to be sold or otherwise dealt with by the Provincial Government. It establishes procedures for enquiring into such claims, postponing sales pending enquiry, and determining compensation if a claim is established after the land has been sold.

metadata.title: The Weights and Measures (International System) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes standards of weights and measures based on the International System. It defines various units, instruments, and officials responsible for verification and regulation within Pakistan.

name: West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides facilities to the Agricultural Bank for recovering its dues through the disposal of pledged or mortgaged property. It empowers agriculturists and cooperative societies to pledge movable or immovable property to secure loans advanced by the bank.

name: West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides facilities to the Agricultural Development Finance Corporation for recovering its dues. It allows agricultural concerns to pledge property to secure loans and empowers the Corporation to recover dues by disposing of such property.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the eradication of agricultural pests in West Pakistan. It grants specific powers to the Government and appointed Inspectors to prohibit harmful cultivation methods, seize infested crops, and enforce preventive measures on land occupiers.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1951; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1955; Agriculturists' Loans (Sind Amendment) Act, 1941; Khairpur State Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1952; West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws regarding the advancement and recovery of taccavi loans for agricultural purposes in West Pakistan. It establishes provisions for government rules on loan types, defines how loans and seed prices are recoverable as land revenue arrears, and outlines the liability of joint borrowers.

name: West Pakistan and Control of Loudspeakers sound Amplifiers, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Regulation of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1964 (W.P. Ord. XIII of 1964)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of loudspeakers and sound amplifiers in the Province of West Pakistan to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits their use in residential areas, near hospitals or schools during working hours, and within places of worship at volumes that disturb others or spread controversial sectarian utterances.

name: West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: Act LXVI of 1950
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the slaughter of useful animals and regulates the slaughter of other animals in West Pakistan. It establishes requirements for animal examination, defines specific terms like 'useful animal' and 'slaughter-house', and outlines penalties and powers for entry and search.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: The Sind Prevention of Bribery and Corruption Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a special agency known as the Anti-Corruption Establishment in West Pakistan to investigate specific corruption offences by public servants. It grants the establishment powers of search, arrest, and seizure similar to police officers for conducting preliminary inquiries and investigations.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to Civil Courts in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes classes of civil courts, defines their jurisdiction limits, and outlines provisions for appointments and powers of District Judges and Civil Judges.

name: West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the consolidation of holdings in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes procedures for applications, schemes, compensation, and the transfer of rights associated with land redistribution.

name: West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the control of disorderly persons commonly known as goondas in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes Tribunals with specific judicial powers to conduct inquiries, issue summonses or warrants, and declare individuals as goondas based on prescribed practices.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act confers powers on officers conducting departmental inquiries against government servants in West Pakistan to compel witness attendance and document production. It grants these officers the same powers exercisable by civil courts under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, while specifying that processes must be served and executed by the relevant civil court.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897; Khairpur State Epidemic Diseases Act, 1941; Epidemic Diseases (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the prevention of the spread of dangerous epidemic diseases in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers the Provincial Government to take special measures and prescribe regulations when an outbreak is threatened or occurring, while also defining penalties for non-compliance and protecting officials acting in good faith.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Essential Services (Maintenance) Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance of certain essential services in West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to order persons engaged in essential employments to remain in specified areas and regulates their wages and conditions of service.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Fisheries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to fisheries in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes regulations for fishing licenses, water leasing, prohibited destructive methods like explosives or poison, and defines penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.number: WEST PAKISTAN ACT No. VIII of 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the supply, distribution, and movement of foodstuffs in West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to regulate trade, commerce, storage, and pricing of specified commodities like wheat, rice, and sugar through notified orders.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to restrict the number of goats in the Province of West Pakistan. It grants the Government powers to regulate grazing, keeping, movement, and slaughter of goats through notifications and rules, while also establishing penalties for contravention.

name: West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of Government dues as arrears of land revenue in the Province of West Pakistan. It allows the Governor to declare specific dues recoverable under the Revenue Recoveries Act, 1890, and empowers the Government to make rules for its implementation.

name: West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Boards of Governors to manage and control government educational and training institutions in West Pakistan. It defines the constitution, powers, and functions of these boards, including their authority over property, staff recruitment, and financial administration.

name: West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Benevolent Fund to provide relief for Government servants and their families in West Pakistan. The fund is divided into two parts for gazetted and non-gazetted servants, financed by contributions, grants, donations, and investment income. It outlines the constitution of management boards responsible for administering the fund and utilizing it for financial assistance in cases such as death, invalidity, or exceptional circumstances.

name: West Pakistan Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and maintenance of graveyards in West Pakistan, specifically establishing a Committee to investigate encroachments and define graveyard limits. It outlines procedures for excluding land from graveyard areas if title is established, acquiring necessary land via compensation, and setting up a Tribunal to adjudicate such applications.

name: West Pakistan Hindu Women�s Rights to Agricultural Land Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultural Land Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1942; The Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Sind Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the Hindu Law governing women's rights to agricultural land in West Pakistan. It establishes that widows of Hindus dying intestate are entitled to the same share of agricultural land as a son, subject to specific conditions regarding different schools of Hindu law and customary rules.

name: West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the raising of funds through a specific cess to support the repair, maintenance, and endowment of historically significant mosques and shrines in West Pakistan. The collected funds are placed under a dedicated authority to cover operational expenses and construction projects.

name: West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of taxes on horse-race betting in West Pakistan. It establishes provisions for the totalizator tax and betting tax, defining terms such as 'backer', 'book-maker', and 'manager' while outlining duties for assessment and collection.

name: West Pakistan Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the organized and planned growth of industries in West Pakistan. It restricts the establishment or enlargement of industrial undertakings without prior written permission from the Government.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking (Repeal) Act, 2018
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959 to the extent of its applicability in Islamabad Capital Territory. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land-Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for land revenue administration in West Pakistan, including the division of provinces into districts and the appointment of revenue officers. It outlines procedures for assessing land revenue, maintaining records of rights, and collecting payments through various legal processes.

name: West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to preventive detention and the control of persons and publications in West Pakistan. It provides powers for arrest, detention, search warrants, and controlling publications to maintain public safety and order.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the employment of women in establishments within the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes rights for maternity benefits, prohibits employment during specific periods surrounding childbirth, and outlines procedures for payment and employer liabilities.

name: West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the imposition of tax on motor vehicles in West Pakistan. It establishes obligations for vehicle owners to make declarations, pay quarterly taxes, and obtain licenses, while also defining penalties for non-compliance and procedures for tax recovery.

name: West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962
metadata.amends: The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Limitation (Custom) Act, 1920; The Punjab Custom (Power to Contest) Act, 1920; The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937; The North-West Frontier Province Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1935; The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1948; The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Sind Amendment) Act, 1950; The Bahawalpur State Shariat (Muslim Personal Law) Application Act, 1951; The Khairpur State Muslim Female Inheritance (Removal of Customs) Act, 1952
