metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the provisions regarding the application of Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) in West Pakistan. It establishes Shariat as the rule of decision for various personal matters, including succession, marriage, divorce, and wills, where the parties are Muslims.

name: West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance and restoration of order in areas affected by specific calamities such as floods, famines, and fires. It empowers a designated Relief Commissioner to take necessary steps for prevention, control, and relief, including requisitioning property and services.

name: West Pakistan Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control and management of private colleges in West Pakistan. It establishes a Governing Body for each college, defines its constitution, powers, and duties, and regulates conditions of service for teachers.

name: West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the prohibition of opium smoking in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms, prohibits the manufacture, possession, or use of opium and related appliances, and outlines penalties for offences along with powers granted to excise officers for search and arrest.

name: West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the redemption and restitution of certain mortgages of land in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes procedures for mortgagors to apply to a Collector for orders directing mortgage redemption and the delivery of possession, including provisions for depositing due amounts and handling ejectment.

name: West Pakistan Registration of Unrecognized Educational Institutions Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Registration of Unrecognized Educational Institutions Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration of unrecognized private educational institutions in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes requirements for applications, defines the roles of registering authorities, and sets conditions for the continuation or establishment of such institutions.

name: West Pakistan Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960
metadata.number: W. P. Ord. No. VII of 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the relief of indebtedness in the Province of West Pakistan. It grants specific protections to agricultural debtors, including limits on recoverable interest, immunity from arrest, and exemptions for certain assets from attachment or sale.

name: West Pakistan Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary) Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the temporary requisitioning of stage carriages in West Pakistan to maintain passenger transport services. It grants powers to District Magistrates to requisition vehicles, manage their maintenance and taxes, and pay compensation to owners at a rate of fifty rupees per diem.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of certain powers regarding requisitioned land in West Pakistan. It outlines procedures for releasing land from requisition, acquiring such land by the government under specific circumstances, and determining compensation payments.

name: West Pakistan Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the cultivation of rice in the Province of West Pakistan to check water-logging, salinity, and seepage damage. It empowers the Board of Revenue to prohibit or restrict rice cultivation in specified areas while allowing for relaxation of these restrictions to aid land reclamation operations.

name: West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the hours and other conditions of work and employment for persons in shops, commercial, industrial, and other establishments in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'commercial establishment' while establishing regulations for weekly holidays, overtime wages, leave entitlements, and the prohibition of child employment.

name: West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1965; The Province of West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order, 1970; The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the dissolution of the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation and the transfer of its projects, properties, and employees to the Provinces. It also repeals previous Ordinances related to the Corporation and grants the President powers to manage the transition.

name: West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the survey and rectangulation of lands in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers the Board of Revenue to direct these operations, outlines the assessment and recovery of costs from affected landholders, and establishes penalties for obstruction while barring civil court jurisdiction over acts done under it.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the regulation of retail sales of manufactured tobacco in urban areas within West Pakistan. It aims to establish a uniform basis for these regulations in the interest of public health by requiring dealer's licences and defining offences related to unlicensed dealing.

name: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the levy of tolls on public roads and bridges in West Pakistan. It grants the government powers to set up toll gates, lease out toll collection rights, and impose penalties for non-payment or unlawful levies.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the registration of companies carrying on business for certain undesirable purposes within West Pakistan. It also provides legal mechanisms for the winding up and dissolution of existing undesirable companies, including provisions for asset preservation and penalties for contravention.

name: West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of a tax on urban immovable property in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'assessing authority', 'owner', and 'urban area', and establishes the rates for tax levied on buildings and lands based on their annual value.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Usurious Loans Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to usurious loans in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers courts to re-open transactions, relieve debtors of excessive interest liability, and set aside unfair agreements or securities.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to vaccination in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes duties for local authorities and Smallpox Eradication Officers to ensure all unprotected children and persons are vaccinated against smallpox.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to vagrancy in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes welfare homes for the custody, training, and maintenance of vagrants while defining specific offenses such as soliciting alms in public places.

metadata.title: The White Phosphorus Matches Prohibition Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the importation, manufacture, and sale of matches made with white phosphorus. It grants inspectors the power to take samples from manufacturers and imposes penalties for violations or refusal to cooperate.

name: Wild Birds and Animals Protection Act, 1912

metadata.title: The Wild Birds and Animals Protection Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better protection and preservation of certain wild birds and animals in their natural state. It empowers the Provincial Government to declare close times, grant exemptions for scientific research, and imposes penalties for unauthorized capture, killing, or trade of protected species.

metadata.title: The Wireless Telegraphy Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the possession of wireless telegraphy apparatus within Pakistan. It establishes the authority for issuing licenses, defines prohibited acts regarding unlicensed possession, and outlines penalties for offenses.

name: Witness Protection, Security and Benefit Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Witness Protection, Security and Benefit Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive Witness Protection Programme to ensure the safety and security of witnesses involved in serious offences. It creates a Witness Protection Advisory Board and a dedicated Unit to manage policies, oversight, and operational functions such as identity changes, relocation, and financial assistance for protected persons.

name: Women in Distress and Detention Fund Act, 1996 (Repealed by Act XVI of 2020)

metadata.title: The Women in Distress and Detention Fund Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a fund specifically for women in distress and detention who require financial and legal assistance. It outlines the sources of the fund, the composition and functions of the Board of Governors, and provisions regarding tax exemptions and auditing.

metadata.title: Women's University Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Women's University with its principal seat at Islamabad. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its powers to provide instruction, conduct examinations, and confer degrees.

metadata.title: The Workers' Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the education of workers' children and matters ancillary thereto. It establishes a levy of education cess on employers to fund free education up to Matric level for one child per worker.

metadata.title: The Workers' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Workers' Welfare Fund to provide residential accommodation and other facilities for workers. It defines the composition of the fund, including initial government contributions and payments from industrial establishments, and outlines the constitution and functions of the Governing Body.

metadata.title: The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of compensation to workmen by certain classes of employers for injuries sustained due to accidents. It defines key terms such as employer, workman, and dependent, and establishes the liability of employers along with methods for calculating wages and compensation amounts.

metadata.title: The Works of Defence Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act provides for imposing restrictions on the use and enjoyment of land near defence works to keep such areas free from buildings and obstructions. It also establishes the procedure for determining and awarding compensation to persons affected by these restrictions.

name: Zainab Alert, Response and Recovery Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Zainab Alert, Response and Recovery Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Zainab Alert, Response and Recovery Agency (ZARRA) to manage cases involving missing and abducted children in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as abduction, child, and recovery, and outlines the powers and functions of ZARRA and related advisory boards to coordinate efforts among federal and provincial agencies.

metadata.title: The Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr in Pakistan. It establishes the legal framework for these Islamic obligations, defining the entities liable to pay and the state's role in managing the funds to assist the needy.

metadata.title: The Carriage by Air Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the Warsaw Convention for the unification of rules relating to international carriage by air within Pakistan. It also provides provisions for applying these rules, with exceptions and modifications, to non-international air carriage.

metadata.title: The Federal Court Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Federal Court to make rules for regulating the service of processes issued by the Court. It specifically grants supplemental power to enable the Court to exercise jurisdiction conferred under the Government of India Act, 1935.

metadata.title: The Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act provides further provisions regarding the law of arbitration in Pakistan to give effect to specific international protocols and conventions. It defines foreign awards, outlines conditions for their enforcement, and establishes procedures for staying legal proceedings when matters are subject to arbitration.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Census Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taking of an agricultural census in Pakistan to comply with decisions by the Food and Agricultural Organization of the United Nations. It establishes the appointment of census officers, defines the scope of information to be collected regarding land, crops, livestock, and employment, and outlines powers for crop-cutting experiments and access to premises.

metadata.title: The Census Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the periodic taking of a census in Pakistan to gather information regarding the population and housing conditions. It establishes the roles of Census Officers, outlines their duties, and grants powers to call upon various persons and institutions to assist in the data collection process.

metadata.title: The Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of trade organizations in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for licensing, registration, and the appointment of a Director to oversee these organizations.

metadata.title: The Carriage by Air (International Convention) Act, 1966
metadata.repeals: The Carriage by Air Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Warsaw Convention as amended at The Hague in 1955 regarding international carriage by air. It establishes rules for carrier liability, including cases involving passenger death, and applies these rules to both international and non-international carriage with specified modifications.

metadata.title: The Carriage by Air (Supplementary Convention) Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Supplementary Convention to the Warsaw Convention regarding international carriage by air performed by a person other than the contracting carrier. It establishes that the rules in the Schedule have the force of law and clarifies the relationship between contracting carriers and actual carriers, including liability limits and the application of Warsaw Convention provisions.

metadata.title: The War Risks Insurance Continuance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of the War Risks Insurance Fund established under the War Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1965. It ensures that all sums paid into or out of the fund and liabilities incurred before its commencement remain valid, even after the 1965 Ordinance ceases to have effect due to the National Assembly not being in session.

metadata.title: The Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Equity Participation Fund as a body corporate to promote investment in the private sector, particularly in less developed areas of Pakistan. It outlines the fund's share capital structure, management administration, and borrowing powers while exempting it from certain taxes and duties.

metadata.title: The Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Ordinance xxxvi of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters relating to the development of industries under Federal control in Pakistan. It establishes a Board of Industrial Management with specific functions, powers, and a dedicated fund to ensure efficient management of establishments.

metadata.title: The National Development Finance Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Development Finance Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the Corporation's share capital, board composition, and powers regarding borrowing and transacting business with eligible enterprises.

name: Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Act,1974

metadata.title: The Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and development of marketing facilities in petroleum products under federal control. It empowers the Federal Government to take over the management or acquire shares of marketing companies deemed necessary for public interest.

name: President's Salary Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975

metadata.title: The President's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salary, allowances, and privileges of the President of Pakistan to enable them to discharge their duties conveniently and with dignity. It provides specific provisions for annual salary, equipment allowances, official residence usage, travel costs, and various other benefits including medical facilities and tax exemptions.

metadata.title: The Representation of the People Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conduct of elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies in Pakistan. It also establishes measures to guard against corrupt and illegal practices, determine election disputes, and regulate related matters.

metadata.title: The Capital Territory Local Government Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of Local Government institutions in the Capital Territory. It establishes the framework for union councils, including their composition, elections, executive powers, and functions.

name: National Tariff Commission Act, 1990 (Repealed by Act XII of 2015)

metadata.title: The National Tariff Commission Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Tariff Commission as a body corporate with perpetual succession. Its primary function is to advise the Federal Government on tariff measures, assistance for indigenous industries, and export promotion.

name: Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997

metadata.title: The Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997
metadata.summary: This Order determines the privileges, allowances, rights regarding leave of absence, and pension for every Judge of the Supreme Court. It establishes rules for various types of leave, leave accounts, salary rates during leave, and conditions for pension entitlement.

metadata.title: The Marriages (Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses) Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits wasteful and ostentatious expenses associated with marriages and related ceremonies in Pakistan. It specifically bans the decoration of buildings or streets with lights, the use of fireworks or explosives, and the serving of meals at public venues like hotels and restaurants during wedding events.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1998

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1998
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the specific monthly salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It sets the salary for the Chief Justice of Pakistan at Rs.43,000 and for other Supreme Court judges at Rs.40,000, while setting the salary for High Court Chief Justices at Rs.39,000 and other High Court judges at Rs.38,000.

name: Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) (Repeal) Order, 1998

metadata.title: Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) (Repeal) Order, 1998
metadata.repeals: Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1975
metadata.summary: This Order was issued by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1975. It came into force immediately upon issuance.

metadata.title: The Insurance Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the regulatory framework for insurance business in Pakistan, dividing it into life and non-life categories. It outlines requirements for insurer registration, capital adequacy, solvency maintenance, statutory funds, and market conduct rules.

name: Adhoc Members of the shariat Appellate Bench (Allowance for Attending of Sittings) Order, 2000

metadata.title: ad hoc members of the Shariat Appellate Bench (Allowance for Attending of Sittings) Order, 2000
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the payment of allowances to ad hoc members of the Shariat Appellate Bench appointed from the panel of Ulema. It specifies sitting and travelling allowances, as well as other privileges such as rent-free accommodation and official car usage while attending sittings.

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000 to insert new sections regarding indemnity and jurisdiction. It grants immunity from legal proceedings for actions taken in good faith under the Ordinance and bars courts from questioning orders made by competent authorities.

name: Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic of Minorities Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Unani, Ayurvedic and Homeopathic Practitioners (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: Unani, Ayurvedic and Homeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Unani, Ayurvedic and Homeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965 to update various sections regarding council composition, examination qualifications, and financial controls. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan under emergency powers on October 4, 2002.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2002

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts, Order, 2002
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1998 (P. O. No. 1 of 1998)
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It sets specific monthly amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels while repealing the previous 1998 Order.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the framework for local governments within the Islamabad Capital Territory, defining the composition and functions of district, union, and village councils. It outlines the powers of key officials such as the Zila Nazim, procedures for elections, financial management rules, and mechanisms for dispute resolution.

name: Islamabad Capital Territory Compulsory Primary Education Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Compulsory Primary Education Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for compulsory primary education within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It mandates that parents ensure their children attend primary school and defines the powers of a constituted Authority to enforce attendance and penalize non-compliance.

name: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in- Aid Order, 2002

metadata.title: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid (Amendment) Order, 2002
metadata.amends: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1997
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1997 to update the allocation shares for Provincial Governments. It substitutes Article 4 with new percentages based on population for Punjab, Sindh, North-West Frontier Province, and Baluchistan.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2004

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2004
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2003 (P.O. No. 1 of 2003)
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the monthly salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It specifies distinct salary amounts for the Chief Justice versus other judges within these courts.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2005

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2005
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2004 (P.O. No. 3 of 2004)
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It specifies monthly amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels while repealing the previous 2004 Order.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2006

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2006
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2005 (P. O. No. 2 of 2005)
metadata.summary: This Order determines the monthly salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It sets specific amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels while repealing the previous 2005 Order.

name: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in- Aid Order, 2006

metadata.title: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid (Amendment) Order, 2006
metadata.amends: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1997
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1997 to address urgent national importance regarding tax distribution between the Federation and Provinces. It substitutes specific articles to define new percentage shares for provincial revenue from federal taxes and establishes annual grants-in-aid amounts.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2007

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2007
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2006 (P.O.No.3 of 2006)
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It specifies monthly amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels while repealing the previous 2006 Order.

metadata.title: Islamabad High Court (Establishment) Order, 2007
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Islamabad High Court for the Islamabad Capital Territory following an amendment to the Constitution. It defines the court's composition, jurisdiction, and powers while adapting existing laws from the Lahore High Court to apply mutatis mutandis.

metadata.title: Supreme Court Judges (Pensionary Benefits) Order, 2007
metadata.summary: This Order provides for pensionary benefits to Judges of the Supreme Court who have ceased to hold office under specific provisions. It grants entitlement to full pension and retirement benefits, with commutation calculated based on the judge's age as of November 3, 2007.

metadata.title: High Courts Judges (Pensionary Benefits) Order, 2007
metadata.summary: This Order provides for pensionary benefits to Judges of High Courts who have ceased to hold office or retired. It applies provisions regarding full pension and retirement benefits admissible to permanent High Court Judges, including specific rules for District and Sessions Judges appointed as High Court Judges.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Court Order, 2009

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Court Order, 2009
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2007 (P.O.No.1 of 2007)
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It sets specific monthly amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels while repealing the previous 2007 salary order.

name: Salary of Judges Superior Court Order, 2010

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2009 (P.O. No.1 of 2009)
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the monthly salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It also repeals the previous Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2009.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010 (P.O. No.1 of 2010)
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It specifies monthly amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels, effective from July 1, 2010.

name: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 2010

metadata.title: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 2010
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the distribution of revenues and certain grants between the Federation and the Provinces of Pakistan. It establishes the divisible pool taxes, allocates specific shares to provinces based on population and other indicators, and details payments regarding crude oil royalties and natural gas surcharges.

name: Distribution of Revenue and Grants-in-Aid Order, 2010

metadata.title: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 2010
metadata.repeals: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1997 (P.O. No.1 of 1997)
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the framework for distributing net proceeds from federal taxes, royalties on crude oil and natural gas, and development surcharges between the Federal Government and the Provinces of Pakistan. It specifies the percentages allocated to each province, including a guaranteed sum for Balochistan, and provides grants-in-aid to Sindh as compensation for abolished local taxes.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Court Order, 2011

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2011
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It specifies monthly amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels, effective from July 1, 2011.

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Customs Act, 1969; The Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974; The Finance Act, 1989; The Sales Tax Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2011. It also amends several existing laws including the Customs Act, Sales Tax Act, and Members of Parliament Salaries Act.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Court Order, 2013

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2013
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2013 (P.O. No. 1 of 2013)
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It sets specific monthly amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels, effective from July 1, 2013.

name: Salary of Judges of Superior Court Order, 2015

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2015
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2013 (P.O. No. 6 of 2013)
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the monthly salaries for the Chief Justice and other judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It also repeals the previous Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2013.

name: Auditor General (Term and Condition of Service) Order, 2015

metadata.title: Advocate-General (Terms and Conditions of Service) Order, 2015
metadata.summary: This Order appoints an Advocate-General for the Islamabad Capital Territory and defines their qualifications, tenure, and functions. It also specifies the salary, allowances, and other benefits entitled to the office holder.

metadata.title: The Public Interest Disclosures Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal mechanism for public interest disclosures to prevent corruption and protect persons making such disclosures. It defines the roles of the Competent Authority, outlines procedures for preliminary inquiries, and provides protections against adverse actions for complainants and witnesses.

name: Transgender Persons (Protection and Rights) Act, 2018 (Act No_ XIII of 2018)

metadata.title: The Transgender Persons (Protection and Rights) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, relief, and rehabilitation of the rights of transgender persons in Pakistan. It establishes mechanisms for the recognition of self-perceived gender identity and prohibits discrimination against transgender individuals in areas such as education, employment, healthcare, and public services.

metadata.title: The National University of Technology Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National University of Technology at Islamabad to address the increasing demand for technical and skilled manpower in industrial and defense sectors. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession to promote applied research, development, and training for youth in science, engineering, and technology fields.

metadata.title: The National Civic Education Commission Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Civic Education Commission to promote civic competence and awareness among citizens regarding their fundamental rights and obligations. It defines the composition of the Commission's Board of Governors, outlines its functions such as developing constitutional understanding and countering extremism, and stipulates responsibilities for schools in imparting civic education.

metadata.title: The Apprenticeship Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes provisions to promote, develop, and regulate systematic apprenticeship programmes in establishments. It aims to secure minimum standards of skill by defining roles for employers, apprentices, and authorities, including the establishment of an apprenticeship fund and committees.

name: West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses (Repeal)Act, 2019

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses (Repeal) Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960 to the extent of the Islamabad Capital Territory. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: Transfer of Railways (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Transfer of Railways Order, 1962 to facilitate private sector participation in Pakistan Railways. It establishes a framework for track access agreements allowing private parties to operate rolling stock on the national network under specific conditions. The document also defines the regulatory roles of the Board and the Railways Division regarding these new agreements.

name: Defence Industrial Production and Regulatory Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2026

metadata.title: Defence Industrial Production and Regulatory Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Defence Industrial Production and Regulatory Authority to supervise and regulate Pakistan's defence industrial sector. It aims to enhance national security, defence preparedness, and technological sovereignty while improving the country's stature in global defence markets.

name: Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council Ordinance, 2025

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates laws relating to the registration, licensing, and training of nurses, nurse practitioners, midwives, and related health professionals. It establishes the Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council and defines various roles and qualifications within the nursing and midwifery sectors.
